scripts.translation:
[瑪琪]
嘿，你最近見過莫里芬和多諾嗎？我希望他們一切都好。也許我該趁早去見見他們，敘敘舊。

scripts.text:
[Makkie]
Hey, welcome to the
Lighthalzen Pub. Relax,
and make yourself at home~
scripts.translation:
[瑪琪]
嘿，歡迎來到裡希塔樂鎮酒館。放鬆一下，就像在自己家一樣~

scripts.text:
[Shede]
Yay~ are you talking to me? Yay!
Hey, are you from a different city? Wow, nice to see you!
scripts.translation:
[謝德]
耶~你在跟我說話嗎？耶！
嘿，你是從別的城市來的嗎？哇，很高興見到你！

scripts.text:
[Shede]
Ever since the airport was built, Hugel has been so busy to welcome tourists and adventurers.
I am kind of surprised to see Hugel being so crowded like this,
but I think that this is a good change for this town.
scripts.translation:
[謝德]
自從機場建成後，毀葛一直忙著迎接遊客和冒險者。
看到毀葛變得這麼熱鬧，我有點驚訝，
但我覺得這對這個城鎮來說是個好的變化。

scripts.text:
[Shede]
At the same time, I have so many customers to serve...
In fact, I don't even have a time to cht-chat, hohoho.
scripts.translation:
[謝德]
與此同時，我有這麼多顧客要招待...
事實上，我甚至沒有時間和你聊天，呵呵呵。

scripts.text: Do you want me to help you?
scripts.translation: 需要我幫你嗎？

scripts.text: I will leave you alone
scripts.translation: 我就先不打擾你了

scripts.text:
[Shede]
Oh~ how kind of you! Thank you so much~
Then can I ask you a favor?
scripts.translation:
[謝德]
哦~你真好！非常感謝~
那麼，我可以請你幫個忙嗎？

scripts.text:
[Shede]
Uncle Hollun's birthday is coming,
so I want to make "^3131FFMushroom Flavor Cookies^000000" for him.
Unfortunately, I am short of the most important ingredient, the Mushrooms.
scripts.translation:
[謝德]
霍倫叔叔的生日快到了，
所以我想為他做“^3131FF蘑菇味餅乾^000000”。
不幸的是，我最重要的原料——蘑菇，不夠了。

scripts.text:
[Shede]
In fact, Agette and I am competing with each other for the Hugel's best cookie master position.
scripts.translation:
[謝德]
事實上，我和阿格特正在競爭毀葛最佳餅乾大師的位置。

scripts.text:
[Shede]
In fact, I gave my heart to a gentleman.
I think that the time has come to let him know
how I feel about him.
scripts.translation:
[謝德]
事實上，我把心交給了一位紳士。
我覺得是時候讓他知道我對他的感覺了。

scripts.text:
[Shede]
[Shede]
No, it is fine. Somehow I needed a break, hohoh!
scripts.translation:
[謝德]
[謝德]
不，沒關係。我本來就需要休息一下，呵呵呵！

scripts.text:
[Shede]
Ordinary mushrooms don't smell that good, but
"^3131FFMoks Mushrooms^000000" which only grow in Hugel have such appetizing scent.
So, when they are added to cookies, they enhance the taste of cookies so much better.
scripts.translation:
[謝德]
普通的蘑菇沒有那種香味，
但只在毀葛生長的“^3131FF莫克斯蘑菇^000000”有著令人垂涎的香氣。
所以，把它們加進餅乾裡，能極大地提升餅乾的美味。

scripts.text:
[Shede]
Can you please go gather "^3131FF5 Moks Mushroom Solution^000000" from "^3131FFMoks Mushrooms^000000"?
You will find the mushrooms in fields near Hugel.
I hope that you will bring their solution as quickly as you can!
scripts.translation:
[謝德]
請去“^3131FF莫克斯蘑菇^000000”那裡採集“^3131FF5 莫克斯蘑菇汁^000000”好嗎？
你可以在毀葛附近的田地裡找到這些蘑菇。
希望你能儘快把它們帶回來！

scripts.text:
[Shede]
Becoming the best cookie mater is not an easy thing to achieve.
Everyone can have the best ingredients and the best cooking utensils,
but that doesn't mean that they can become the best cookie masters.
scripts.translation:
[謝德]
成為最好的餅乾大師並不是一件容易的事。
每個人都可以擁有最好的食材和最好的廚具，
但這並不意味著他們就能成為最好的餅乾大師。

scripts.text:
[Shede]
You need to know how to harmonize your skills and your senses
to make the most delicious cookies.
scripts.translation:
[謝德]
你需要學會如何協調你的技藝與感官，
才能烤出最美味的餅乾。

scripts.text:
[Shede]
I dare to say that my cookies are the best.
However, Agette is also a professional cookie baker.
scripts.translation:
[謝德]
我敢打賭，我的餅乾是最好的。
不過，阿格特也是一位專業的餅乾烘焙師。

scripts.text:
[Shede]
If I hear her name while baking,
it makes me shake my hands in anxiety
so that I make a mistake to measure the right amount of ingredients.
That explains how good she is at baking cookies.
scripts.translation:
[謝德]
如果在烘焙時聽到她的名字，
我會因為緊張而手抖，
從而在稱量食材時出錯。
這也說明了她在烘焙餅乾方面有多厲害。

scripts.text:
[Shede]
Still, I am a proud cookie baker, and
I can hear a voice from deep inside of me saying
that I cannot be beat by her!
Can you hear that?
Can you hear my inner fighting spirit as a cookie baker?
scripts.translation:
[謝德]
儘管如此，我依然是一位自豪的餅乾烘焙師，
我能聽到內心深處有一個聲音在說：
我絕不會輸給她！
你聽到了嗎？
你聽到了我作為餅乾烘焙師的鬥志嗎？

scripts.text:
[Shede]
I am going to compete with her
for the Hugel's best cookie mater position after a while.
So, I have been doing my best in practicing my skills to win her!
scripts.translation:
[謝德]
過段時間，我要和她競爭毀葛最佳餅乾大師的位置。
所以，我一直在努力練習技藝，為了戰勝她！

scripts.text:
[Shede]
There were many obstacles in my way to become the best cookie baker.
But, see? I am still here, alive and kicking! I will never give up! In that sense..
I am going to challenge on baking ^FF0000Clam Cookies^000000 today!
I am going to make them taste tangy and unique. I am sure that they will be a great success!
scripts.translation:
[謝德]
在成為最佳餅乾烘焙師的道路上，我遇到了許多障礙。
但是，看？我還在這裡，活蹦亂跳！我絕不會放棄！從這個意義上說...
今天我要挑戰烘焙^FF0000蛤蜊餅乾^000000！
我要讓它們嚐起來酸爽且獨特。我相信這會大獲成功！

scripts.text:
[Shede]
When you go to the beach, 
you will find clams near the ferry.
Please gather ^3131FF5 Clam Flesh^000000 from the clams.
Please hurry!
scripts.translation:
[謝德]
當你去海灘時，
你會在渡輪附近找到蛤蜊。
請從蛤蜊身上採集^3131FF5 蛤蜊肉^000000。
請快點！

scripts.text:
[Shede]
So, I decided to bake special cookies called...
...... ^3131FFDevil's Cookies^000000!
scripts.translation:
[謝德]
所以，我決定烤一種特別的餅乾，叫做...
...... ^3131FF惡魔餅乾^000000！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Devil's Cookies?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
惡魔餅乾？

scripts.text:
[Shede]
Yes, Devil's Cookies.
When you go outside of Hugel, you will find "^3131FFMoks Bugs^000000"
hiding in the bushes. They breed in this season, so they are plump with eggs.
scripts.translation:
[謝德]
是的，惡魔餅乾。
當你走出毀葛，你會看到“^3131FF莫克斯蟲^000000”
躲在灌木叢裡。這個季節它們正在繁殖，所以身上鼓鼓的，全是卵。

scripts.text:
[Shede]
When you stew their shells and use the broth to kneed flour,
you can make fresh and crunch cookies.
scripts.translation:
[謝德]
把它們的殼燉煮，用湯汁和麵，
就能做出新鮮酥脆的餅乾。

scripts.text:
[Shede]
Devil's Cookies are so delicious, so they are rumored to dazzle the eaters with
the mysteriously crunch texture and the sweetness, and to allure them to hell without them knowing.
Ah~ I hope that he will like them...
scripts.translation:
[謝德]
惡魔餅乾非常美味，據說它們那神秘酥脆的口感和甜味，
會讓品嚐者眼花繚亂，並在不知不覺中引誘他們墮入地獄。
啊~ 希望他會喜歡...

scripts.text:
[Shede]
Would you please help me to bake the cookies? I need 5 Moks Bug Shells~
scripts.translation:
[謝德]
請幫我烤這些餅乾好嗎？我需要5個莫克斯蟲殼~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
'......I am confused...Does she love him or hate him?'
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
'......我很困惑...她是愛他呢，還是恨他？'

scripts.text:
[Shede]
No, it is fine. Somehow I needed a break, hohoh!
scripts.translation:
[謝德]
不，沒關係。我本來就需要休息一下，呵呵呵！

scripts.text:
[Shede]
Can you please go gather "^3131FF5 Moks Mushroom Solution^000000" from "^3131FFMoks Mushrooms^000000"?
You will find the mushrooms in fields near Hugel.
I hope that you will bring their solution as quickly as you can!
scripts.translation:
[謝德]
請去“^3131FF莫克斯蘑菇^000000”那裡採集“^3131FF5 莫克斯蘑菇汁^000000”好嗎？
你可以在毀葛附近的田地裡找到這些蘑菇。
希望你能儘快把它們帶回來！

scripts.text:
[Shede]
Please pick up "^3131FF5 Clams^000000" from a fish trap in the ferry.
I hope that you will bring their solution as quickly as you can!
scripts.translation:
[謝德]
請從渡輪處的漁網中採集“^3131FF5 蛤蜊^000000”。
希望你能儘快把它們帶回來！

scripts.text:
[Shede]
Please bring "^3131FF5 Moks Bug Shells^000000" from outside of Hugel.
I hope that you will bring their solution as quickly as you can!
scripts.translation:
[謝德]
請從毀葛外面帶回“^3131FF5 莫克斯蟲殼^000000”。
希望你能儘快把它們帶回來！

scripts.text:
[Shede]
Oh! You came back earlier than I thought.
Now, I can bake the Mushroom Flavor Cookies for uncle Hollun.
Thank you so much.
scripts.translation:
[謝德]
哦！你回來得比我預想的還要早。
現在，我可以為霍倫叔叔烤制蘑菇風味的餅乾了。
非常感謝你。

scripts.text:
[Shede]
Oh! You came back earlier than I thought.
Now, I can bake the best cookies of mine and compete with Agette!
Thank you so much.
scripts.translation:
[謝德]
哦！你回來得比我預想的還要早。
現在，我可以烤制我最好的餅乾，去和艾格特一較高下了！
非常感謝你。

scripts.text:
[Shede]
Oh! You came back earlier than I thought.
Now, I can bake Devil's Cookies to confess my love to the gentleman.
Thank you so much.
scripts.translation:
[謝德]
哦！你回來得比我預想的還要早。
現在，我可以烤制惡魔餅乾，向那位紳士表白了。
非常感謝你。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(If he knew what ingredients she used for the cookies,)
(I am pretty sure that at least he will remember her face to avoid next time...)'
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（如果他知道她做餅乾用了什麼材料的話，）
（我敢打賭，他至少會記住她的臉，下次好避開她...）

scripts.text:
[Shede]
Have you seen Mr. Herico?
He is a lonesome old man who is staying at Hugel Inn.
scripts.translation:
[謝德]
你見過赫里科先生嗎？
他是一位孤獨的老人，住在毀葛旅館裡。

scripts.text:
[Shede]
If you have some time, why don't you go spend some time with him?
I know that he will appreciate it.
scripts.translation:
[謝德]
如果你有空的話，不妨去陪陪他？
我相信他會很感激的。

scripts.text:
[Shede]
So, how do you like Hugel?
It is a peaceful village, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[謝德]
那麼，你覺得毀葛怎麼樣？
這是一個寧靜的村莊，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Shede]
Mr. Herico has an impediment in movement, so he usually stays in his room.
Please go spend some time with him. I know that he will appreciate it.
scripts.translation:
[謝德]
赫里科先生行動不便，所以通常都待在房間裡。
請去陪陪他吧。我相信他會很感激的。

scripts.text:
[Shede]
So, how do you like Hugel?
It is a peaceful village, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[謝德]
那麼，你覺得毀葛怎麼樣？
這是一個寧靜的村莊，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Herico]
Why don't you go take some load off your shoulder first, and come back?
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
你不妨先去卸下肩上的重擔，然後再回來？

scripts.text:
[Herico]
The weather is beautiful today. *Sigh* But my body aches too badly to go out...
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
今天天氣真好。*嘆氣* 但我的身體疼得厲害，根本出不了門...

scripts.text:
[Herico]
The weather is beautiful today. *Sigh* But my body aches too badly to go out...
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
今天天氣真好。*嘆氣* 但我的身體疼得厲害，根本出不了門...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello!

[Herico]
Shede?
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
謝德？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, hello. Ms. Shede asked me to drop you by. Nice to meet you, I am ^3131FF{1}^000000.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦，你好。謝德小姐讓我給你帶個話。很高興認識你，我是^3131FF{1}^000000。

scripts.text:
[Herico]
Ah, hello. I heard that recently an airport was built in this town. So, are you from a different city?
I like to see new things...although I don't like this chilly wind.
How do you like Hugel?
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
啊，你好。我聽說最近這個城鎮建了一個機場。那麼，你是從別的城市來的嗎？
我喜歡看新事物...雖然我不喜歡這寒冷的風。
你覺得毀葛怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It is a peaceful and beautiful village, although I can tell that it is experiencing a change.
Everyone looks happy, and they feel very different than people in the other areas.
So I feel like that I am in a different land.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這是一個寧靜美麗的村莊，雖然我能感覺到它正在發生變化。
每個人看起來都很快樂，他們和其他地方的人感覺非常不同。
所以我感覺像是來到了另一個國度。

scripts.text:
[Herico]
Everyone has worries and happyness at the same time.
You must have travelled many cities of this country,
and have figured out many things on your own.
Am I right?
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
每個人同時擁有煩惱和快樂。
你一定在這個國家的許多城市旅行過，
並且自己領悟了許多事情。
我猜得對嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, you are right.
scripts.translation: 是的，你說得對。

scripts.text: I am not so sure.
scripts.translation: 我不太確定。

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Herico]
I think that my senses are still working fine.
People's eyes tell many things to me.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
我想我的感官還運作正常。
人們的眼睛會告訴我很多事情。

scripts.text:
[Herico]
Your eyes are telling me your admiration and astonishment
toward what you have seen in Hugel,
which is a totally different experience for you.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
你的眼睛告訴我，你對在毀葛看到的一切充滿了欽佩和驚歎，
這對你來說是一段完全不同的經歷。

scripts.text:
[Herico]
People of Hugel don't question anyone.
It is an unwritten law of this village.
That is why I could have been resting in this village without worries.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
毀葛的人們從不質疑任何人。
這是這個村莊不成文的規矩。
正因如此，我才能在這個村莊無憂無慮地休息。

scripts.text:
[Herico]
However, as I see you, I suddenly have an urge to ruminate on my past
that I have never spoken to anyone.
May I have a moment of your time, if you don't mind?
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
然而，看著你，我突然有一種衝動，想要回顧我從未對任何人提起的過去。
如果不介意的話，能佔用你一點時間嗎？

scripts.text:
[Herico]
Perhaps we will learn something from each other's story.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
也許我們能從彼此的故事中學到些什麼。

scripts.text:
[Herico]
Then I guess that you have not been deeply impressed by this country.
Haha, alright, that's fine.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
那麼看來，這個國家並沒有給你留下太深的印象。
哈哈，沒關係，這樣也好。

scripts.text:
[Herico]
Oh, am I not?
Haha, I am sorry for hazarding a conjecture.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
噢，難道不是嗎？
哈哈，抱歉，是我妄加揣測了。

scripts.text:
[Herico]
Hmm...can you tell me your name once again?
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
嗯...能再告訴我一次你的名字嗎？

scripts.text:
[Herico]
^3131FF{0}^000000, I have many interesting stories for you.
However, before I tell you my stories, I would like to ask you something. Do you mind?
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
^3131FF{0}^000000，我有許多有趣的故事要講給你聽。
不過，在講述我的故事之前，我想問你一個問題。你介意嗎？

scripts.text:
[Herico]
As you see, ever since an airport was built in this Hugel, many strangers are coming in and going out this village.
It may be a good change for Hugel, so that more people will know about its existence.
However, I have this bad feeling about the airport and airships.
I do not think that this country is not extending their airlines only for the transportation purposes.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
正如你所見，自從毀葛建了機場，就有許多陌生人進出這個村莊。
這對毀葛來說可能是一件好事，讓更多人知道它的存在。
然而，我對機場和飛空艇有一種不好的預感。
我不認為這個國家開設航線僅僅是為了運輸目的。

scripts.text:
[Herico]
Did you know that more and more people are using the ferry after the airport was built?
Can't you see the reason of my doubt?
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
你知道嗎，自從機場建成後，越來越多的人開始使用渡輪。
你能看出我懷疑的原因嗎？

scripts.text:
[Herico]
Please find out the secret about the airship and the island.
Then I will tell you my stories.
I hope that you will do your best to find out the secret.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
請查明飛空艇和這座島嶼的秘密。
然後我會告訴你我的故事。
我希望你能盡力查明這個秘密。

scripts.text:
[Herico]
Welcome back. I have been waiting for you with eager anticipation to hear about the secret.
Now, please tell me what you have found out.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
歡迎回來。我一直滿懷期待地等著聽你講述那個秘密。
現在，請告訴我你發現了什麼。

scripts.text:
- You told him what you have seen and heard from the Odin Shirine, -
- such as Giantes, Ymir's Heart and Rekenber. -
scripts.translation:
- 你告訴他你在奧丁神殿看到和聽到的事情，-
- 例如巨人族、尤彌爾之心和雷肯貝爾。 -

scripts.text:
[Herico]
Rekenber...So, they have expanded
their power even to this small village, Hugel.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
雷肯貝爾...所以，他們的勢力甚至擴充套件到了毀葛這個小小的村莊。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do you know about them?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你瞭解他們嗎？

scripts.text:
[Herico]
Of course, I know them too well.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
當然，我對他們再熟悉不過了。

scripts.text:
[Herico]
Thank you so much for your effort.
I am afraid that your dangerous journey has not been ended.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
非常感謝你的努力。
恐怕你危險的旅程還沒有結束。

scripts.text:
[Herico]
Well, this is time for me to tell you my story.
I hope that you will enjoy it.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
好了，現在是我講述我故事的時候了。
希望你能喜歡。

scripts.text:
[Herico]
Please find out the secret about the airship and the island.
Then I will tell you my stories.
I hope that you will do your best to find out the secret.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
請查明飛空艇和這座島嶼的秘密。
然後我會告訴你我的故事。
我希望你能盡力查明這個秘密。

scripts.text:
[Herico]
Hmm...I don't know where to start.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
嗯...我不知道從哪裡開始說起。

scripts.text:
[Herico]
As you know, we have bionic machines called
^FF0000Guardians^000000.
We are using Guardians to protect important facilities
or to avoid meaningless murders.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
如你所知，我們擁有被稱為
^FF0000守衛^000000的仿生機器。
我們使用守衛來保護重要設施，
或者避免無謂的殺戮。

scripts.text:
[Herico]
Have you ever thought about how the people in old times
would protect their important facilities without guardians?
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
你有沒有想過，在沒有守衛的時代，
古人是如何保護重要設施的？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Perhaps, they hired many men to do that?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
也許，他們僱傭了許多人來執行這項任務？

scripts.text:
[Herico]
Yes, you are right.
For the longest time, Schwarzwald Republic had had
^3131FFMercenary Soldiers^000000 who exchanged their lives
with the good money, and they used to take care of
all the dirty jobs in the past.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
沒錯，你說得對。
長期以來，修瓦魯茲巴魯德共和國一直擁有
^3131FF傭兵士兵^000000，他們以生命換取豐厚的報酬，
在過去負責處理所有骯髒的工作。

scripts.text:
[Herico]
They lost their jobs when Rekenber successfully invented and publicized guardians.
Guardians were made for humans, but sadly it was the worst thing that could happen to them.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
當雷肯貝爾成功發明並公開守衛後，他們失去了工作。
守衛是為人類製造的，但可悲的是，這對他們來說是最糟糕的事情。

scripts.text:
[Herico]
As they lost their jobs to guardians, they rose in rebellion called ^FF0000Mercenary Rebellion^000000.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
由於工作被守衛取代，他們發動了被稱為^FF0000傭兵叛亂^000000的起義。

scripts.text:
[Herico]
This Mercenary Rebellion was greatly responded to by the public.
However, they lost people's trust by choosing ^3131FFa violent method^000000
to fight, instead of appealing to the public in a convincible way.
In other words, they lost their game by making a critical mistake.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
這次傭兵叛亂曾得到公眾的強烈響應。
然而，他們選擇以^3131FF暴力手段^000000進行鬥爭，
而不是以令人信服的方式向公眾呼籲，從而失去了人們的信任。
換句話說，他們因犯下嚴重錯誤而輸掉了這場遊戲。

scripts.text:
[Herico]
Ever since their rebellion was failed,
survivors of the rebellion have disappeared beyond history.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
自從叛亂失敗以來，
叛亂的倖存者在歷史中消失了。

scripts.text:
[Herico]
Not only that, they held a fight with guardians in
^FF0000the Sage Varmunt's birthplace^000000
which was our proud national treasure!
So the house was completely destroyed by the battle, and
since then, no one knows where Sage Varmunt is.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
不僅如此，他們還在
^FF0000賢者瓦爾蒙特的出生地^000000
與守衛發生了一場戰鬥，
那是我們引以為傲的國家瑰寶！
因此，那棟房子在戰鬥中完全被摧毀了，
從那以後，沒有人知道賢者瓦爾蒙特在哪裡。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Sage Varmunt.....!

[Herico]
Oh...I must have been really upset about it.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
噢...我一定是對此感到非常沮喪。

scripts.text:
[Herico]
To be honest with you,
Sage Varmunt is partially responsible on guardians.
You know that he was the one
who created their motive power.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
老實告訴你，
賢者瓦爾蒙特對守衛負有部分責任。
你知道是他
創造了它們的動力源。

scripts.text:
[Herico]
It is riduculous that the mercenary soldiers were trying to
make their revenge on Sage Varmunt
for inventing guardians, you know.
But, it is understandable because they lost their jobs to guardians.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
傭兵士兵試圖
向賢者瓦爾蒙特復仇，
因為他發明了守衛，這很荒謬，你知道嗎。
但這也合情合理，因為他們的工作被守衛奪走了。

scripts.text:
[Herico]
I heard about the Mercenary Rebellion after everything was ended,
so there was nothing that I could do about Sage Varmunt.
He disappeared, and I couldn't figure out more
than what I found from his birth place...so...
I came to Hugel and settled down here.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
我在一切結束後才聽說傭兵叛亂，
所以我對賢者瓦爾蒙特無能為力。
他消失了，我無法從他的出生地
找到更多線索...所以...
我來到了毀葛並定居在這裡。

scripts.text:
[Herico]
I tried to find at least a little bit of his documents from his laboratory...
but everything was gone...huh?
Hold on, I just remember something very important!
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
我試圖從他的實驗室裡找到至少一點他的檔案...
但一切都消失了...嗯？
等等，我突然想起了一件非常重要的事！

scripts.text:
[Herico]
Where are all of his research documents?
No...did mercenary soldiers took them or...possibly dispose them?
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
他的所有研究檔案在哪裡？
不...是傭兵士兵拿走了它們，還是...可能銷燬了它們？

scripts.text:
[Herico]
Damn it! I am so stupid! Grrr...
How couldn't I think about this earlier?
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
該死！我真蠢！咕嚕...
我怎麼沒想到這一點呢？

scripts.text:
[Herico]
{0}, can you see what I want to tell you now?
I have to take a long time to remember everything
about the incident, but you must understand
that this is an extremely important matter.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
{0}，你能明白我現在想告訴你的事嗎？
我花了很長時間才想起
關於這件事的一切，但你必須明白
這是一件極其重要的事情。

scripts.text:
[Herico]
Mercenary Rebellion was a huge issue back then.
Hopefully, there will be at least one news reporter
who remembers about the rebellion.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
傭兵叛亂當時是一個巨大的事件。
希望至少有一位新聞記者
還記得這次叛亂。

scripts.text:
[Herico]
Please go to Lighthalzen and find a news reporter
who still remembers about the rebellion.
If you find him, please ask him if he knows whereabouts of the rebellion survivors,
so that you can find out what happened to Sage Varmunt and his research documents.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
請去裡希塔樂鎮，找到一位
還記得這次叛亂的新聞記者。
如果你找到他，請問他是否知道叛亂倖存者的下落，
這樣你就可以查明賢者瓦爾蒙特和他的研究檔案發生了什麼。

scripts.text:
[Herico]
Please go to Lighthalzen and find a news reporter
who still remembers about the rebellion.
If you find him, please ask him if he knows whereabouts of the rebellion survivors,
so that you can find out what happened to Sage Varmunt and his research documents.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
請去裡希塔樂鎮，找到一位
還記得這次叛亂的新聞記者。
如果你找到他，請問他是否知道叛亂倖存者的下落，
這樣你就可以查明賢者瓦爾蒙特和他的研究檔案發生了什麼。

scripts.text:
[Herico]
How have you been doing?
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
最近過得怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Herico]
Did you find Sage Varmunt's research documents?
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
你找到賢者瓦爾蒙特的研究檔案了嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, about the documents...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，關於那些檔案...

scripts.text: I ate them.
scripts.translation: 我吃了。

scripts.text: Rekenber has taken them into their possession.
scripts.translation: 雷肯貝爾已經將它們收走了。

scripts.text: I ate them.
scripts.translation: 我吃了。

scripts.text:
[Herico]
Hahaha! That's funny!
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
哈哈哈哈哈！真有趣！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, it is not funny.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不，這並不好笑。

scripts.text:
[Herico]
Then...SPIT THEM OUT!
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
那麼...把它們吐出來！

scripts.text:
[Herico]
SPIT THEM OUT!
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
吐出來！

scripts.text:
[Herico]
I SAID, SPIT THEM OUUUUUT!
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
我說，把它們吐出來！！！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Err...I was just kidding...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
呃...我只是開個玩笑...

scripts.text:
[Herico]
Haha, the first part was funny,
but the second part was kind of scary, you know?
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
哈哈，前半部分確實挺有趣的，
但後半部分有點嚇人，你知道嗎？

scripts.text:
[Herico]
So, tell me, where are all of his research documents?
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
那麼，告訴我，他的研究檔案都在哪裡？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Rekenber has taken them into their possession.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
雷肯貝爾已經將它們收走了。

scripts.text: Rekenber has taken them into their possession.
scripts.translation: 雷肯貝爾已經將它們收走了。

scripts.text:
[Herico]
It was expected.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
這是意料之中的事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What do you have in mind?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你在想什麼？

scripts.text:
[Herico]
First, I think that I should inform you about my true identity.
I may now be an old man whose days are numbered,
but I used to work at ^3131FFthe Ymir's Heart imitation research department
 in Regenschirm laboratory^000000 under Sage Varmunt's supervision.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
首先，我想告訴你我的真實身份。
我現在可能只是一個時日無多的老人，
但我曾在^3131FF雷根修蘆實驗室的伊米爾之心仿製研究部門^000000工作，
當時是在賢者瓦爾蒙特的指導下。

scripts.text:
[Herico]
You look very surprised.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
你看起來很驚訝。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Does it mean that you are the one
who created the Ymir's Heart imitation?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
難道說，你就是那個
製造伊米爾之心仿製品的人？

scripts.text:
[Herico]
Well, I was a mere assistant of Sage Varmunt,
so I can't say that I created it.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
我只是賢者瓦爾蒙特的助手，
所以不能說是我創造了它。

scripts.text:
[Herico]
Rekenber has been secretly gathering ^FF0000Ymir's Heart Pieces^000000.
They are very obsessed with Ymir's Heart Pieces,
and I guess that it is because of the enormous power that the heart pieces possess within..
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
雷肯貝爾一直在秘密收集^FF0000依美樂心臟堆積物^000000。
他們對依美樂心臟堆積物非常痴迷，
我想這大概是因為心臟堆積物內部蘊含著巨大的力量。

scripts.text:
[Herico]
However, the power of the original heart pieces
are too strong for humans to control.
Thus, it is not fiseable to manipulate the power
as energy sources.
That is why ^3131FFthe imitations of Ymir's Heart
Pieces^000000 have been created.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
然而，原始心臟堆積物的力量
對人類來說過於強大，無法控制。
因此，將其作為能源來操縱
是不可行的。
所以才製造了^3131FF依美樂心臟堆積物的仿製品^000000。

scripts.text:
[Herico]
We, researchers including Sage Varmunt, endeavoured
our effort in studying and analyzing the revolutionary energy source
for a long time.
And our effort has gained a fruitful result; the Imitations of Ymir's Heart Piece.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
包括賢者瓦爾蒙特在內的我們研究人員，
長期以來致力於研究和解析這種革命性的能源。
我們的努力終於結出了碩果：依美樂心臟堆積物的仿製品。

scripts.text:
[Herico]
With the invention, we could create guardians.
We were so happy for the fact that we
finally made our dream come true.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
憑藉這項發明，我們創造了守衛者。
我們非常高興，因為
我們終於實現了夢想。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But, Sage Varmunt was against the idea of using guardians
for militant purposes, and I heard that he also participated
in the Mercenary Rebellion.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
但是，賢者瓦爾蒙特反對將守衛者
用於軍事目的，我聽說他也參與了
傭兵反叛。

scripts.text: - You told him what you knew about the Mercenary Rebellion. -
scripts.translation: - 你告訴他你所知道的關於傭兵反叛的事。 -

scripts.text:
[Herico]
Hmm...now I see.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
嗯...我明白了。

scripts.text:
[Herico]
After we succeeded in creating the imitations of Ymir's Heart Piece,
Sage Varmunt looked pretty depressed for some reason.
After all, he left the laboratory and said that ^3131FFby him
staying with Regenschirm laboratory
will make everyone miserable^000000.
I still don't figure out why he said that.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
在我們成功製造出依美樂心臟堆積物的仿製品後，
賢者瓦爾蒙特不知為何看起來很沮喪。
最後，他離開了實驗室，說^3131FF如果他繼續留在雷根修蘆實驗室
會讓所有人都很痛苦^000000。
我至今不明白他為什麼這麼說。

scripts.text:
[Herico]
He was a really great scholar.
He always tried to use his knowledge in science for humankind.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
他是一位非常偉大的學者。
他總是試圖將科學知識用於造福人類。

scripts.text:
[Herico]
As expected, after Sage Varmunt left Regenschirm,
almost every research process started stagnating.
Even many projects were canceled or postponed.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
不出所料，賢者瓦爾蒙特離開雷根修蘆後，
幾乎所有的研究程序都開始停滯。
許多專案也被取消或推遲了。

scripts.text:
[Herico]
The upper management were threatened by the phenomenon,
so they yelled at people to ^FF0000continue
with their research by all means^000000.
They even allowed people to experiment
on anything that is alive.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
高層被這種現象所威脅，
於是他們大聲命令人們^FF0000不惜一切代價
繼續研究^000000。
他們甚至允許人們
對任何活物進行實驗。

scripts.text:
[Herico]
......................
That gave me a reason to leave Regenschirm.

[Herico]
Rekenber will do anything to achieve their goals.
They have become too powerful to just be considered a big corporation.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
雷肯貝爾為了達成目標會不擇手段。
他們變得太過強大，已經不能僅僅被視為一家大公司了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That was why they founded the "Bio Lab"
in order to continue with their research without Sage Varmunt.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這就是為什麼他們建立了“生物實驗室”，
以便在沒有賢者瓦爾蒙特的情況下繼續他們的研究。

scripts.text:
[Herico]
What? "Bio Lab"? I didn't image that they could
even think of that! I can't express enough of my resentment toward them!
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
什麼？“生物實驗室”？我沒想到他們
竟然會想到這一點！我對他們的怨恨無法言表！

scripts.text:
[Herico]
Science is to benefit humankinds,
not to harm them. I think that something must be done.
Can you bring me a glass of water?
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
科學是為了造福人類，
而不是傷害他們。我認為必須做點什麼。
你能給我倒杯水嗎？

scripts.text:
[Herico]
Can you guess what I am thinking right now?
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
你能猜到我現在的想法嗎？

scripts.text:
[Herico]
I am thinking about ^3131FFdestroying Regenschirm^000000.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
我在想^3131FF摧毀雷根修蘆^000000。

scripts.text:
[Herico]
Rekenber has become as powerful as this Schwarzwald Republic.
I don't think that I could destroy the entire corporation.
But even if I could, it could also lead to the fall of my country,
because that's who big Rekenber means to this country.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
雷肯貝爾已經強大到足以支撐修瓦魯茲巴魯德共和國的程度。
我不認為我能摧毀整個公司。
但即使我能做到，這也可能導致我的國家滅亡，
因為龐大的雷肯貝爾對這個國家來說至關重要。

scripts.text:
[Herico]
So, instead, I am thinking to destroy "Regenschirm".
Because the laboratory may not be as big as the corporation,
but at the same time, it has a great meaning to them.
I want to stop their inhumane and dangerous practice in research.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
所以，我轉而考慮摧毀“雷根修蘆”。
雖然實驗室可能不像公司那樣龐大，
但與此同時，它對它們有著重大的意義。
我想阻止它們那些非人道且危險的研究行為。

scripts.text:
[Herico]
...*Sigh*...Unfortunately, I do not possess any power to
proceed with my plan. Thus, I need your help, desperately.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
...嘆息...不幸的是，我沒有能力獨自執行我的計劃。
因此，我迫切需要你的幫助。

scripts.text:
[Herico]
Let me hear your opinion.
Will you join me in destroying Regenschirm?
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
讓我聽聽你的意見。
你願意加入我，一起摧毀雷根修蘆嗎？

scripts.text: Sorry, I won't
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我不願意

scripts.text: Yes, I will.
scripts.translation: 是的，我願意。

scripts.text:
[Herico]
I respect your decision since this is not something
that is okay for you to make a quick judgement.
I appreciate everything that you have done for me so far.
And if you change your mind, feel free to come back any time.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
我尊重你的決定，因為這不是你能輕易做出判斷的事情。
我很感激你之前為我所做的一切。
如果你改變主意，隨時歡迎回來。

scripts.text:
[Herico]
I knew that you are too righteous to
neglect lies and injustice.
I have seen that through your eyes.
I don't know how much we can achieve with this mission,
but it is very meaningful for us to at least try.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
我知道你太正直了，
不會忽視謊言和不公。
我從你的眼中看到了這一點。
我不知道這次任務我們能取得多少成果，
但至少嘗試一下對我們來說非常有意義。

scripts.text:
[Herico]
Let's discuss further what we should do.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
讓我們進一步討論該怎麼做。

scripts.text:
[Herico]
We must find out how we can stop them
from doing more evil things, at least for a while.
Regenschirm is a historic laboratory, and thus
an enormous amount of accumulated research data
has been saved within the laboratory.
Without the research data,
all the researching activity within Regenschirm
will not be progressed.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
我們必須找出如何阻止它們繼續作惡，至少暫時如此。
雷根修蘆是一個歷史悠久的實驗室，因此
實驗室裡儲存著大量積累的研究資料。
沒有這些資料，
雷根修蘆內部的所有研究活動
都將無法推進。

scripts.text:
[Herico]
Regenschirm is located at the underground level
of Rekenber's Lighthalzen headquarters.
It is where their filthy ambitions are reflected on.
Please sneak into the laboratory
and bring ^FF0000their research data^000000 to me.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
雷根修蘆位於雷肯貝爾裡希塔樂鎮總部的地下層。
那裡反映了它們骯髒的野心。
請潛入實驗室，
把^FF0000它們的研究資料^000000帶給我。

scripts.text:
[Herico]
Regenschirm is located at the underground level
of Rekenber's Laighthalzen headquarters.
Can you sneak into the place and bring me their research data?
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
雷根修蘆位於雷肯貝爾裡希塔樂鎮總部的地下層。
你能潛入那裡，把他們的研究資料帶給我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Herico]
Ah, you are back.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
啊，你回來了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I had a little bit of trouble because I was caught by a guard.
But I took care of it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我遇到了一點麻煩，因為被衛兵抓住了。
但我已經處理好了。

scripts.text:
[Herico]
Thank you so much for your trouble.
Haha, since they lost their research data,
they wouldn't be able to continue with their research
at least for a while, I hope.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
非常感謝你的辛苦。
哈哈，既然他們失去了研究資料，
我希望他們至少暫時無法繼續研究了。

scripts.text:
[Herico]
Now, let's get into the next step, shall we?
I know that you have gone through many difficulties so far,
but this might be the most difficult thing that you've ever done.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
現在，讓我們進入下一步，好嗎？
我知道你之前經歷了很多困難，
但這可能是你做過的最困難的事情。

scripts.text:
[Herico]
In my opinion, the bio lab is the most important facility in Regenschirm.
We must not let that kind of inhumane place exist in this world any longer.
I am so horrified by the thought that they have been doing all sorts of evil things
under an excuse of scientific research.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
在我看來，生物實驗室是雷根修蘆最重要的設施。
我們必須不讓這種非人道的地方在這個世界上繼續存在。
想到它們以科學研究為藉口做了各種邪惡的事情，我感到非常震驚。

scripts.text:
[Herico]
As I analyzed the research data which you have brought to me,
the bio lab is consisted of 3 levels,
and I suspect that the 2nd level is used to
perform experimental research on living bodies.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
根據我對你帶來的研究資料的分析，
生物實驗室由3層組成，
我懷疑第2層被用於
對活體進行實驗研究。

scripts.text:
[Herico]
I am pretty sure that we can find
a miner who knows how to make
Marine Sphere Bottles in ^3131FFEinbech^000000,
since the Marine Sphere Bottles are needed to
blast tunnels inside mines.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
我相當確定我們可以在^3131FF艾音貝赫^000000找到
知道如何製作刺錘瓶的礦工，
因為刺錘瓶被用於
炸開礦洞內的隧道。

scripts.text:
[Herico]
Haha...you know what I am going to ask you now, don't you?
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
哈哈...你知道我現在要讓你做什麼，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Herico]
Please go meet with ^3131FFthe Marine Sphere Bottle manufacturer^000000,
and purchase some Marine Sphere Bottles.
And explode ^3131FFthe bio experiment equipment^000000 in the 2nd level of bio lab!
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
請去見^3131FF刺錘瓶製造商^000000，
購買一些刺錘瓶。
然後炸燬生物實驗室第2層的^3131FF生物實驗裝置^000000！

scripts.text:
[Herico]
I know that this is a difficult task. But, please understand
that you are the only hope that I have.
Please stop them from performing experimental research on living bodies!
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
我知道這很困難。但請理解，
你是我唯一的希望。
請阻止他們對活體進行實驗研究！

scripts.text:
[Herico]
Please go meet with ^3131FFthe Marine Sphere Bottle manufacturer^000000,
and purchase some Marine Sphere Bottles.
And explode ^3131FFthe bio experiment equipment^000000 in the 2nd level of bio lab.
You are the only hope that I have.
Let's hope that it will work out well.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
請去見^3131FF刺錘瓶製造商^000000，
購買一些刺錘瓶。
然後炸燬生物實驗室第2層的^3131FF生物實驗裝置^000000。
你是我唯一的希望。
希望一切順利。

scripts.text:
[Herico]
If you know anyone
who can create Marine Sphere Bottles for you,
you may use his instead.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
如果你認識任何
能為你製作刺錘瓶的人，
也可以用他的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The machine was blown up.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
機器被炸燬了。

scripts.text:
[Herico]
Excellent! Excellent!
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
太棒了！太棒了！

scripts.text:
[Herico]
Now, I am relieved that they won't be able to
proceed with their bio research at least for a while.
You did a great job, and I am so proud of you.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
現在，至少有一段時間，
他們無法繼續進行生物研究了，這讓我鬆了一口氣。
你做得很好，我為你感到驕傲。

scripts.text:
[Herico]
I assume that there are
some failed experimental objects remaining within the laboratory.
According to the research document,
those experimental objects are identified with ^3131FFHandcuffs^000000.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
我想實驗室裡
可能還剩下一些失敗的實驗物件。
根據研究檔案，
這些實驗物件被標記為^3131FF犯人的手煉^000000。

scripts.text:
[Herico]
From now on, I will reward you every time when you bring me
a certain amount of the Handcuffs.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
從現在開始，每次你帶給我
一定數量的犯人的手煉，我都會獎勵你。

scripts.text:
[Herico]
And...even though we succeeded in stopping them for now,
it will not last that long.
We need someone who has a power to stop them permanently.
Sadly, I am not the one.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
而且...雖然我們現在暫時阻止了他們，
但這不會持續太久。
我們需要一個有能力永久阻止他們的人。
遺憾的是，我不是那個人。

scripts.text:
[Herico]
By any chance, do you know a man who can aid his power in stopping them?
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
碰巧，你認識一個
能協助我們阻止他們的人嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I think that I know one...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想我知道一個...

scripts.text:
[Herico]
Okay, tell me who he is.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
好的，告訴我他是誰。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Mr. President.....!
Mr. President must be the one who can help us.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
總裁先生.....！
總裁先生一定能幫到我們。

scripts.text:
[Herico]
You mean Karl...something something?
I may well say that Rekenber owns this country.
I don't think that he has not been influenced by them.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
你是說卡爾...什麼的？
我可以說雷根修蘆擁有這個國家。
我不認為他沒有受到他們的影響。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, Mr. President, who I know,
has been trying to free this country from Rekenber.
Even if he was frustrated by a ridiculous reason at the last time,
I believe that he has not given up in his hope.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不，我認識的總裁先生，
一直在試圖讓這個國家擺脫雷根修蘆的控制。
即使他上次因為荒謬的原因感到沮喪，
我相信他沒有放棄希望。

scripts.text:
[Herico]
Hmm...I see. Then I must count on your word.
I am giving the research data back to you,
so please bring it to Mr. President.
Let's see how well he can handle it.
I appreciate you for doing everything for me so far,
I really appreciate it.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
嗯...我明白了。那麼我只能相信你的話了。
我把研究資料還給你，
請把它帶給總裁先生。
讓我們看看他能處理得如何。
非常感謝你為我做的一切，
真的非常感謝。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Umm...no, I don't think that I know anyone.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...不，我想我不認識任何人。

scripts.text:
[Herico]
Oh...okay. Hmm...we certainly need someone
with a power who can stop them permanently.
Why don't you go to different cities and find the one
who can help us? I am pretty sure that
you will find one.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
哦...好吧。嗯...我們確實需要
一個有能力永久阻止他們的人。
你為什麼不去不同的城市找找看，
找到那個能幫到我們的人呢？我相當確定
你會找到一個。

scripts.text:
[Herico]
Why are you still here?
That research data will aid a great help to Mr. President.
Please deliver it to him as soon as you can.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
你為什麼還在這裡？
那份研究資料對總裁先生會有很大的幫助。
請儘快把它交給他。

scripts.text:
[Herico]
Hey, welcome back.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
嘿，歡迎回來。

scripts.text: I brought Handcuffs
scripts.translation: 我帶來了犯人的手煉

scripts.text: Regarding Sage Varmunt's documents
scripts.translation: 關於賢者瓦爾蒙特的檔案

scripts.text:
[Herico]
I am willing to exchange 1 of level 4 food with 100 Handcuffs.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
我願意用1份4級食物交換100個犯人的手煉。

scripts.text: Exchange
scripts.translation: 兌換

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Herico]
There you go, thank you for your trouble.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
給你，謝謝你的辛苦。

scripts.text:
[Herico]
I don't think that you have brought me 100 Handcuffs.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
我覺得你沒有給我帶來100個犯人的手煉。

scripts.text:
[Herico]
When I checked the research data that you have brought to me,
it seemed that Sage Varmunt wrote his documents in cipher,
so they could not decode them.
That explains why they have been obsessed
with bionic researches to figure out on their own.
scripts.translation:
[赫里科]
當我檢查你帶來的研究資料時，
發現賢者瓦爾蒙特是用密碼寫的檔案，
所以無法解讀。
這解釋了為什麼他們如此痴迷於仿生研究，
試圖自己破解。

scripts.text:
[Enquro Carson]
Hello, everyone. This is Enquro Carson
from Light News.
scripts.translation:
[恩庫羅·卡爾森]
大家好，我是來自《光明新聞》的恩庫羅·卡爾森。

scripts.text:
[Enquro Carson]
People want to hear prompt and accurate news.
I feel proud of myself as a news reporter
especially when people are astonished by the news
which I am delivering to them.
scripts.translation:
[恩庫羅·卡爾森]
人們希望聽到及時且準確的新聞。
作為一名新聞記者，我感到非常自豪，
尤其是當人們對我報道的新聞感到驚訝時。

scripts.text:
[Enquro Carson]
Hello, everyone. This is Enquro Carson
from Light News.
scripts.translation:
[恩庫羅·卡爾森]
大家好，我是來自《光明新聞》的恩庫羅·卡爾森。

scripts.text:
[Enquro Carson]
People want to hear prompt and accurate news.
I feel proud of myself as a news reporter
especially when people are astonished by the news
which I am delivering to them.
scripts.translation:
[恩庫羅·卡爾森]
人們希望聽到及時且準確的新聞。
作為一名新聞記者，我感到非常自豪，
尤其是當人們對我報道的新聞感到驚訝時。

scripts.text: Mercenary Rebellion
scripts.translation: 傭兵反叛者

scripts.text: News reporter job
scripts.translation: 新聞記者的工作

scripts.text:
[Enquro Carson]
Hmm...Mercenary Rebellion...?
It happened pretty long time ago.
Mercenary soldiers lost their jobs
after guardians were invented.
And they insisted their social security
through a violent method, so the government had to stop them with force.
scripts.translation:
[恩庫羅·卡爾森]
嗯...傭兵反叛者...？
那已經是很久以前的事了。
在守衛被髮明後，傭兵士兵們失去了工作。
他們堅持通過暴力手段爭取社會保障，
所以政府不得不使用武力制止他們。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do you know any survivor of Mercenary Rebellion?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你認識任何傭兵反叛者的倖存者嗎？

scripts.text:
[Enquro Carson]
Welll...I was not assigned to the case,
and the news reporter who kept the coverage of the case
retired long time ago...
Oh, I think that I can check
if he has left any documents about the rebellion.
Give me a moment.
scripts.translation:
[恩庫羅·卡爾森]
嗯...我並沒有被指派負責這個案件，
而且一直跟蹤報道該案件的記者
早就退休了...
哦，我想我可以查一下
他是否留下了關於反叛者的檔案。
請給我一點時間。

scripts.text:
- *Rummage Rummage* -
- *Rummage Rummage* -
- *Rummage Rummage* -
scripts.translation:
- *翻找翻找* -
- *翻找翻找* -
- *翻找翻找* -

scripts.text:
[Enquro Carson]
Oh! I found it.
scripts.translation:
[恩庫羅·卡爾森]
哦！我找到了。

scripts.text:
[Enquro Carson]
Mr. Balparan, yes, he is the news reporter,
must be greatly intrigued by the rebellion.
According to this documents, he tried to
contact with the rebellion survivors
after the rebellion ended in failure.
scripts.translation:
[恩庫羅·卡爾森]
巴爾帕蘭先生，是的，他是新聞記者，
肯定對反叛者很感興趣。
根據這份檔案，他在反叛者失敗後
試圖聯絡反叛者的倖存者。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Can you tell me the survivors' locations?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你能告訴我倖存者的位置嗎？

scripts.text:
[Enquro Carson]
Well, I am not supposed to release
any kind of personal information to outside.
Hmm...but it happened a long time ago, and
I don't know if they are still alive or not...
scripts.translation:
[恩庫羅·卡爾森]
嗯，我不應該向外界透露
任何個人資訊。
嗯...但那已經是很久以前的事了，
而且我不知道他們是否還活著...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Thank you so much!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
非常感謝你！

scripts.text:
[Enquro Carson]
Wait, wait, I didn't say that I would release their information yet.
Actually my motto is that
"^3131FFEvery bit of information must be shared^000000".
scripts.translation:
[恩庫羅·卡爾森]
等等，等等，我還沒說我會透露他們的資訊呢。
實際上，我的座右銘是
"^3131FF每一條資訊都必須分享^000000"。

scripts.text:
[Enquro Carson]
I hope that you are willing to share any information
that you will find from the survivors with me.
Oh yes, do you know what? "Commutative contract".
scripts.translation:
[恩庫羅·卡爾森]
希望你能將從倖存者那裡打聽到的任何資訊都與我分享。
哦對了，你知道“交換契約”嗎？

scripts.text:
[Enquro Carson]
I heard of a private pub in Morocc,
a city of Rune-Midgarts Kingdom
that is not open to the public.
People keep talking about the pub's best drink,
and I wonder how delicious the drink will be.
Can you please get me the drink? Hahaha, thanks!
scripts.translation:
[恩庫羅·卡爾森]
我聽說在盧恩·米德加茲王國的摩洛克城，
有一家不對外開放的私人酒吧。
人們都在談論那裡最好喝的酒，
我很好奇那酒到底有多美味。
能請你幫我帶一杯回來嗎？哈哈，謝謝！

scripts.text:
[Enquro Carson]
.......Hmmm...Hmmm...Hmmm.
- Enquro Carson looks you up and down with squinting his eyes. -
scripts.translation: - 恩庫羅·卡爾森眯著眼睛上下打量著你。 -

scripts.text:
[Enquro Carson]
You are not saying that you want to be a news reporter, are you?
scripts.translation:
[恩庫羅·卡爾森]
你不會是想當新聞記者吧？

scripts.text:
[Enquro Carson]
I heard of a private pub in Morocc,
a city of Rune-Midgarts Kingdom
that is not open to the public.
People keep talking about the pub's best drink,
and I wonder how delicious the drink will be.
Can you please get me the drink? Hahaha, thanks!
scripts.translation:
[恩庫羅·卡爾森]
我聽說在盧恩·米德加茲王國的摩洛克城，
有一家不對外開放的私人酒吧。
人們都在談論那裡最好喝的酒，
我很好奇那酒到底有多美味。
能請你幫我帶一杯回來嗎？哈哈，謝謝！

scripts.text:
[Enquro Carson]
Wow, this is that famous drink!
Let's see...*Gulp*
scripts.translation:
[恩庫羅·卡爾森]
哇，這就是那款著名的酒！
讓我嚐嚐...*咕咚*

scripts.text:
[Enquro Carson]
Wow! This is awsome!
It is as delicious as I heard!
Its taste is still lingering on my tongue,
and it is like Wow!
scripts.translation:
[恩庫羅·卡爾森]
哇！太棒了！
果然和傳聞中一樣美味！
餘味還留在舌尖上，
真是令人驚歎！

scripts.text:
[Enquro Carson]
Anyways, according to Mr. Balparan's documents,
errr....yes, this must be the name of the last mercenary soldier.
Mr. Balparan contacted with
^3131FFWintzil Trony^000000,
the last mercenary soldier for the last time in...
^FF0000Hugel^000000. Wait, Hugel?
Isn't that the small country at the corner of Schwarzwald Republic?
scripts.translation:
[恩庫羅·卡爾森]
總之，根據巴爾帕蘭先生的檔案，
呃...是的，這應該是最後一名傭兵的名字。
巴爾帕蘭先生最後一次聯絡
^3131FF溫齊爾·特羅尼^000000，
也就是最後一名傭兵，是在...
^FF0000毀葛^000000。等等，毀葛？
那不是位於修瓦魯茲巴魯德共和國角落的小國嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What? Hugel?

[Enquro Carson]
Previously, it was very difficult to get to Hugel
because there was no safe route.
Basically, the village was like an island within the continent,
but ever since an airport was built there,
the village is now having its period of prosperity.
scripts.translation:
[恩庫羅·卡爾森]
以前去毀葛非常困難，
因為沒有安全的路線。
基本上，那個村莊就像大陸上的一座孤島，
但自從那裡建了機場之後，
村莊現在正處於繁榮時期。

scripts.text:
[Enquro Carson]
You are lucky, you know that?
Mr. Balparan gave up on meeting with the mercenary soldier
in Hugel because it was too tough to just get there.
But you, all you need to do is just getting on to the airship.
scripts.translation:
[恩庫羅·卡爾森]
你很幸運，你知道嗎？
巴爾帕蘭先生因為去毀葛太困難，
所以放棄了在那裡見傭兵的計劃。
但你只需要登上飛空艇就行了。

scripts.text:
[Enquro Carson]
Oh, by the way, I hope that you will keep
this secret between you and me.
I released the personal information at my discretion,
and I know that I am not allowed to do that. Hehe.
scripts.translation:
[恩庫羅·卡爾森]
哦，順便說一句，我希望你能把這個秘密
只留在你我之間。
我擅自透露了個人資訊，
我知道這是不被允許的。嘿嘿。

scripts.text:
[Enquro Carson]
Just get on to the airship and go to Hugel.
Hopefully you will meet with ^3131FFWintzil Trony^000000
or his son...or something.
Oh, be careful not to provoke him though.
He used to be a mercenary soldier, and they were famed for their violence.
scripts.translation:
[恩庫羅·卡爾森]
只要登上飛空艇去毀葛就行了。
希望你能見到^3131FF溫齊爾·特羅尼^000000
或者他的兒子...或者什麼人。
哦，小心別挑釁他。
他曾經是傭兵，他們以暴力著稱。

scripts.text:
[Enquro Carson]
This is very shameful for me to confess,
but I tend to make lots and lots of spelling mistakes.
Yeah, I know, it is a shame.
scripts.translation:
[恩庫羅·卡爾森]
這對我來說很丟臉，但我不得不承認，
我經常會犯很多很多拼寫錯誤。
是的，我知道，這很丟人。

scripts.text:
[Girl]
Bah, I am bored.
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
哼，真無聊。

scripts.text:
[Girl]
Hehe...are you from another city?
Heheh.
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
嘿嘿...你是從別的城市來的嗎？
嘿嘿嘿。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hey, little lady?
By any chance, do you know a man named "Wintzil Trony"?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嘿，小姐？
請問你認識一個叫“溫齊爾·特羅尼”的人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Girl]
There is no man named Wintzil Trony.
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
沒有叫溫齊爾·特羅尼的男人。

scripts.text:
[Girl]
I am the Wintzil Trony.
I am a girl, not a man.
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
我就是溫齊爾·特羅尼。
我是女孩，不是男人。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(^3131FFOh dear Odin, am I on a test?
Or are you trying to make sure that I still have a good memory?
How could...how could...how could this little child
is the last mercenary soldier?! This is absurd!)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
(^3131FF哎呀，奧丁啊，我是不是在做測試？
還是說你在考驗我的記憶力？
怎麼...怎麼會...這個小女孩
竟然是最後的傭兵士兵？！這太荒唐了！)

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well...lady,

[{0}]
Are you sure that you are the last mer....no, no.
Then do you have any family member who shares the same name as yours?
Like your father, for instance.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你確定你是最後的傭...不，不。
那你有沒有和你同名的家人？
比如你的父親。

scripts.text:
[Wintzil Trony]
I said, I am the only Wintzil Trony in my family.
And I don't have a father.
My mom is out of Hugel to sell Hugel's principal products.
scripts.translation:
[溫齊爾·特羅尼]
我說了，我是家裡唯一的溫齊爾·特羅尼。
我沒有父親。
我媽媽去毀葛外面賣毀葛的特產了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Did...did your father pass away?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你...你父親去世了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Wintzil Trony]
I can't help it. He was too old.
scripts.translation:
[溫齊爾·特羅尼]
沒辦法。他太老了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well...do you remember what your father
used to do when he was alive?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那個...你還記得你父親
生前是做什麼的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Wintzil Trony]
My father sowed seeds.
scripts.translation:
[溫齊爾·特羅尼]
我父親播種。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(^3131FFGosh, she is not helping! This is not good!^000000)

[{0}]
Well, lady, I think that people usually
say "cultivate a field" instead of saying "sowing seeds".
Did you know that?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那個，女士，我覺得人們通常
會說“耕種田地”，而不是說“播種”。
你知道嗎？

scripts.text:
[Wintzil Trony]
^3131FFBut my father had only one arm,
so he couldn't do such a hard work like cultivating a field.^000000
But, it was alright. I could help him because I am strong enough.
I cultivated fields with my mom and my father.
Do you want to know how strong I am? Look at this! Yap!
scripts.translation:
[溫齊爾·特羅尼]
^3131FF但我父親只有一隻手臂，
所以他做不了耕種田地這種重活。^000000
不過沒關係。我夠強壯，可以幫他。
我和爸爸媽媽一起耕種田地。
想知道我有多強壯嗎？看這個！耶！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Umm...lady, can you show me your father's picture
or something that used to belong to him?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...女士，你能給我看看你父親的照片
或者他以前用過的東西嗎？

scripts.text:
[Wintzil Trony]
Beh~ You are just like the guy who came by a long time ago.
He kept asking me things over and over again,
then he became upset and left.
scripts.translation:
[溫齊爾·特羅尼]
哼~ 你就像很久以前來過的那個傢伙。
他不停地問我問題，
然後生氣地走了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(He might be the news reporter from the Light News.)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
(他可能是《光明新聞》的記者。)

scripts.text:
[Wintzil Trony]
My father was a farmer. That's all I can say.
Beeeeh~
scripts.translation:
[溫齊爾·特羅尼]
我父親是個農民。我只能說這麼多。
哼~

scripts.text:
[Wintzil Trony]
I am living in a house that is pretty empty.
All my father left to us is the shelf at the upstairs.
scripts.translation:
[溫齊爾·特羅尼]
我住在一間很空蕩的房子裡。
我父親留給我們的只有樓上的架子。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do you mind if I take a look at your father's shelf?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
介意我看一下你父親的架子嗎？

scripts.text:
[Wintzil Trony]
Sure!
It is filled with books, and they don't look that interesting.
But, can you be careful to treat the shelf? It is a keepsake from my father.
scripts.translation:
[溫齊爾·特羅尼]
當然！
裡面裝滿了書，看起來不太有趣。
但是，請小心對待架子。這是我父親的紀念品。

scripts.text:
[Wintzil Trony]
I am bored and bored! When is my mom coming back?
scripts.translation:
[溫齊爾·特羅尼]
我好無聊好無聊！媽媽什麼時候回來？

scripts.text:
[Wintzil Trony]
If you promise me that you will not break it,
you can take a look at the shelf.
scripts.translation:
[溫齊爾·特羅尼]
如果你答應我不弄壞它，
你可以看看那個架子。

scripts.text:
Date: **month **day
I was told that Rekenber succeeded
in creating a type of machine called ^FF0000Guardian^000000.
I have a bad feeling about that, so I decided to write a journal
starting from today and keep everything in record.
 
"^FF0000Guardian^000000" is an android
that was created based on the idea of "^3131FFGiantes^000000",
the giant tribe that was said to live in an ancient age.
It is memorized with various commands,
so it is said to handle difficult things for humans as protecting
important facilities and such.
 
However, those things are our job, the mercenary soldiers' job.
Mercenary soldier groups in many areas
are already agitated by the news of the Guardian creation.
I am worried what is going to happen to us.
scripts.translation:
日期：**月**日
我聽說雷肯貝爾成功製造了一種名為^FF0000守衛^000000的機器。
對此我有一種不好的預感，所以我決定從今天開始寫日記，記錄一切。
 
“^FF0000守衛^000000”是一種基於“^3131FF巨人族^000000”理念製造的人形機器人，
據說是生活在古代的巨大部落。
它被植入了各種指令，
據說可以替人類處理困難的事情，比如保護重要設施等。
 
然而，那些本應是我們的工作，是傭兵士兵的工作。
許多地區的傭兵士兵團體
已經因為守衛製造的訊息而躁動不安。
我很擔心我們會發生什麼。

scripts.text: - You started reading the 2nd page of the book. -
scripts.translation: - 你開始閱讀書的第二頁。 -

scripts.text:
Date: **month **day
Everybody in this place seems to be very confused and upset as well as me.
I made a stupid mistake to slip on one of the stairs
while absent-mindedly walking down. I really need to straighten myself out.
scripts.translation:
日期：**月**日
這個地方里的每個人似乎都和我一樣非常困惑和不安。
我走樓梯時心不在焉，不小心滑倒了，真是犯了個愚蠢的錯誤。我真的需要振作起來。

scripts.text: - You started reading the 3rd page of the book. -
scripts.translation: - 你開始閱讀書的第三頁。 -

scripts.text:
Date: **month **day
Today, we, "Republic Garrison",
were introduced to ^3131FF2 Guardians.
Those machines joined us for their test operation^000000.
Everyone seemed to be intimidated by their big and heavy frames.
I thought that these machines were supposed to aid humans in doing
hard works. But it doesn't seem to be true.
To me, they are nothing but "^FF0000weapons of mass destruction^000000".
Perhaps, they might be intended to be that way from the beginning.
 
What is going to be next after we finish testing the machines?
No matter how bad other people criticize us for being greedy toward money,
we always take pride in what we are doing, and we always do our best.
We must try our best to do our job, otherwise we will be dead right away.
But, now, we are losing our place to the lifeless machines.
Many people have quit this job after the machines were introduced.
I must admit that I am also being shaken by the thought.
 
Bah, god damn you, Rekenber! You just have created the worst invention in history!
scripts.translation:
日期：**月**日
今天，我們“共和國衛隊”被介紹了^3131FF兩臺守衛者^000000。
這些機器加入了我們，進行試執行。
大家都被它們巨大而沉重的身軀嚇到了。
我以為這些機器本該幫助人類做繁重的工作。但事實似乎並非如此。
對我來說，它們不過是“^FF0000大規模殺傷性武器^000000”。
也許，它們從一開始就是被設計成這樣的。
 
在我們完成機器測試之後，接下來會發生什麼？
無論別人如何批評我們貪財，
我們總是為自己所做的工作感到自豪，並總是全力以赴。
我們必須盡力做好工作，否則我們就會立刻喪命。
但現在，我們正在被這些沒有生命的機器取代。
自從引入這些機器後，許多人已經辭去了這份工作。
我必須承認，我也被這種想法動搖了。
 
該死，該死的雷肯貝爾！你創造了歷史上最糟糕的發明！

scripts.text: - You started reading the 4th page of the book. -
scripts.translation: - 你開始閱讀書的第四頁。 -

scripts.text:
Date: **month **day
No one wouldn't know how boring it is to mount guard with a machine.
scripts.translation:
日期：**月**日
沒有人不知道和機器一起站崗是多麼無聊。

scripts.text: - You started reading the 5th page of the book. -
scripts.translation: - 你開始閱讀書的第五頁。 -

scripts.text:
Date: **month **day
Damn it! Finally it happened today!
Today, our troops was in total disorder.
One of the guardians caused an error and brought havoc.
While we were terrified and didn't know what to do, that broken guardian
crushed the commander of 'Blade Canine Mercenary' to death.
 
I can't remember how we could regain control over the broken guardian.
My mind is still baffled for the fact that that machine actually killed an innocent guy as I was kind of worried about.
Many people were dispatched from Rekenber to investigate this matter, so hopefully they will figure out
what the hell was wrong with that machine.
But, it is not going to change the fact that one of our comrade was taken his life by that merciless machine,
and no once can replace his place for his family.
scripts.translation:
日期：**月**日
該死！終於在今天發生了！
今天，我們的部隊陷入了徹底的混亂。
其中一臺守衛者發生了故障，造成了破壞。
當我們驚恐萬分、不知所措時，那臺故障的守衛者
將“刃犬傭兵”的指揮官壓死了。
 
我不記得我們是如何重新控制那臺故障的守衛者的。
我的大腦仍然因那臺機器真的殺死了一個無辜的人而感到困惑，正如我之前擔心的那樣。
雷肯貝爾派了許多人來調查此事，希望他們能弄清楚
那臺機器到底出了什麼問題。
但這並不能改變一個事實：我們的一個同志被那臺無情的機器奪去了生命，
而且沒有人能代替他在家人心中的位置。

scripts.text: - You started reading the 6th page of the book. -
scripts.translation: - 你開始閱讀書的第六頁。 -

scripts.text:
Date: **month **day
We received a message from upper management.
"^3131FFKeep our mouth from spreading the story to outside.^000000", that's the content of message.
Rekenber must have bribed the upper management of our troops with money.
Otherwise, why would they want us to keep our mouth sealed about a such shocking incident?
We, angry mercenary soldiers burst into rage right after the morning session was over.
 
We went ahead and spread the story about the shocking incident to every mercenary troops.
And then we destroyed every guardian which we found in hangars.
The sounds of hammering metal and sirens were echoing everywhere, everywhere you went.
 
...We took refuge in a safe place out of our unit because of what happened.
We are planning to assert our social security to the public and inform the public with
the danger of the guardians and the negligence of the government and Rekenber toward the incident.
Our leader told us that he has sent out letters to every mercenary troop
to encourage them to participate in what we are trying to do.
 
I feel like...that I have just turn into a no-way-out.
I am facing my future with a deep sense of gloom.
scripts.translation:
日期：**月**日
我們收到了來自上級的訊息。
“^3131FF不要把這件事傳出去。^000000”，這就是訊息的內容。
雷肯貝爾一定用金錢收買了我們部隊的高層。
否則，他們為什麼要我們對如此震驚的事件守口如瓶？
我們憤怒的傭兵士兵在早會後立刻爆發了。
 
我們繼續將這一震驚事件傳播給每一個傭兵部隊。
然後我們摧毀了在機庫中發現的每一臺守衛者。
金屬敲擊聲和警報聲到處迴盪，無論你去哪裡都能聽到。
 
...由於發生的事，我們躲在單位外的一個安全地方。
我們計劃向公眾主張我們的社會保障，並告知公眾
守衛者的危險以及政府和雷肯貝爾對這一事件的疏忽。
我們的首領告訴我們，他已向每個傭兵部隊發出信件，
鼓勵他們參與我們正在做的事情。
 
我覺得...我好像已經走投無路了。
我帶著深深的絕望面對著我的未來。

scripts.text: - You found a folded note between the pages that you were reading. -
scripts.translation: - 你在正在閱讀的頁面間發現了一張摺疊的紙條。 -

scripts.text: Check the note.
scripts.translation: 檢視紙條

scripts.text: Read the next page.
scripts.translation: 閱讀下一頁

scripts.text:
^3131FF...I am so sorry for hearing such devastating news and for your loss.
Every member of our troops are already aware of the shocking incident,
and all of us are uncontrollably enraged.
The government has been bribed 
with Rekenber's filthy money and has become nothing but a puppet.
We must take control over our life once again. Our future depends on us.
We will join you, 'Blade Canine Mercenary' to fight for our rights.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3131FF...聽到如此令人悲痛的訊息和你們的損失，我感到非常抱歉。
我們部隊的每個成員都已經知道了這一震驚事件，
我們所有人都憤怒得無法控制。
政府被雷肯貝爾骯髒的金錢收買，已經變成了一個傀儡。
我們必須重新掌控我們的生活。我們的未來取決於我們自己。
我們將加入你們，“刃犬傭兵”，為我們的權利而戰。^000000

scripts.text: - You started reading the 7th page.-
scripts.translation: - 你開始閱讀書的第七頁。 -

scripts.text:
Date: **month **day
Our firm will was not enough.
Our desperate effort was not enough!
Many mercenary groups joined us to fight with the government and Rekenber.
But we were too weak to compete with their invincible guardians. We were literally swept away.
They were quicker than we expected in taking action, and lines and lines of guardians were coming after us.
There was nothing that we could do. We met with a disastrous defeat in the battle with guardians.
 
Everybody is still in shock, but we can't give up now.
I think that we are going to visit a house of a sage called "Varmunt" early in the morning.
I don't know why, but it seems that the sage is against the use of guardians.
People say that his mansion is rather like a fortress.
I also don't know why someone would want to build his house
as strong as a fortress. Regardless, I am pretty sure that his support will be a great help for us.
It was a really tiring day today. It was also a very chaotic day.
To be honest, I don't know what is going to happen now.
I am scared if I would die helplessly. I am scared and depressed.
Why must this happen to us, and what have we done to deserve such a horrible treatment?
scripts.translation:
日期：**月**日
我們的力量還不夠。
我們絕望的努力還不夠！
許多傭兵團加入我們，與政府和雷肯貝爾作戰。
但我們太弱了，無法與他們無敵的守衛者競爭。我們被徹底掃蕩了。
他們採取行動比我們預期的要快，一排排守衛者追著我們。
我們無能為力。我們在與守衛者的戰鬥中遭遇了慘敗。
 
每個人仍然處於震驚中，但我們現在不能放棄。
我想我們明天一早要去拜訪一位名叫“瓦爾蒙特”的賢者的房子。
我不知道為什麼，但似乎這位賢者反對使用守衛者。
人們說他的宅邸更像是一座堡壘。
我也不知為什麼有人要把房子建得像堡壘一樣堅固。無論如何，我相當確定他的支援將對我們有很大幫助。
今天真是累人的一天。也是非常混亂的一天。
老實說，我不知道接下來會發生什麼。
我害怕我會無助地死去。我害怕且沮喪。
為什麼這種事必須發生在我們身上，我們做了什麼才配得上如此可怕的對待？

scripts.text: - You started reading the 8th page. -
scripts.translation: - 你開始閱讀書的第八頁。 -

scripts.text:
Date: **month **day
Our leader became desperate, so he sent a request to Schwarzwald Republic for ^3131FFa cease-fire agreement^000000.
I guess that he was frightened by guardians around the Varmunt mansion.
Sadly, Schwarzwald Republic declined our request without hesitation.
They stated through their reponse that ^FF0000they would not tolerate this kind of unacceptable rebellion by any means,
and thus, they would take strong action against the rebellion this time.^000000.
I guess that the government is determined to eliminate us, the mercenary soldiers through this event.
People now started showing their resentment toward us, who brought disorder to their country.
This is not right. Something has went wrong. We just wanted the government to secure our lives, that was all.
Since we were declined for a cease-fire agreement, we are planning to hold the last fight tomorrow in this place.
scripts.translation:
日期：**月**日
我們的首領變得絕望，因此他向修瓦魯茲巴魯德共和國發出了^3131FF停火協議^000000的請求。
我想他是被瓦爾蒙特宅邸周圍的守衛者嚇到了。
不幸的是，修瓦魯茲巴魯德共和國毫不猶豫地拒絕了我們。
他們在回覆中宣告，^FF0000他們絕不容忍這種不可接受的叛亂，
因此，他們將針對這次叛亂採取強硬行動。^000000。
我想政府決心通過這次事件消滅我們，這些傭兵士兵。
人們現在開始對我們表現出怨恨，因為我們給他們的國家帶來了混亂。
這不公平。某些事情出了錯。我們只是希望政府保障我們的生活，僅此而已。
既然停火協議被拒絕，我們計劃明天在這裡進行最後一戰。

scripts.text: - You started reading the 9th page. -
scripts.translation: - 你開始閱讀書的第九頁。 -

scripts.text:
Date: **month **day
It has been a while since I wrote a journal last time.
I am in Hugel, a small town at the border of Schwarzwald Republic.
Because of the locational penalty, people of this town seldom see outsiders, and if they see one, they treate them warmheartedly.
Although I didn't have a time to write a journal that time, the last fight in the Varmunt mansion turned out to be our miserable defeat...as I was worried.
I was told that Sage Varmunt disappeared after the fight, and all of his documents were taken by Rekenber.
I am afraid that they might create a more powerful version of the existing guardian by using his documents.
 
I lost one arm during the last fight, and I barely escaped to Hugel.
I feel so lucky to be in Hugel, because when I arrived, I was a total mess with only one arm,
but the people in this town did not ask me anything but welcomed me.
 
I have nowhere to go any longer. I am planning to live my life here as long as nothing happens soon.
 
My arm is throbbing with pain again. The history of mercenary soldiers ended, and I need to rest.
I hope that this will be the last page of my journal.
scripts.translation:
日期：**月**日
自上次寫日記以來已經過了一段時間。
我在毀葛，修瓦魯茲巴魯德共和國邊境的一個小鎮。
由於地理位置的劣勢，這個鎮子的人很少見到外人，如果見到一個，他們會熱情地對待他們。
雖然當時我沒有時間寫日記，但瓦爾蒙特宅邸的最後一戰結果如我所擔心的那樣，是我們悲慘的失敗...
我聽說賢者瓦爾蒙特在戰鬥後失蹤了，他所有的檔案都被雷肯貝爾拿走了。
我擔心他們可能會利用他的檔案製造出比現有守衛者更強大的版本。
 
我在最後一戰中失去了一隻手臂，勉強逃到了毀葛。
我覺得很幸運能在毀葛，因為當我到達時，我只有一隻手臂，渾身是傷，
但這個鎮子的人沒有問我任何問題，而是歡迎了我。
 
我再也沒有地方可去了。我計劃在這裡生活，只要很快沒有事情發生。
 
我的手臂又開始疼痛了。傭兵士兵的歷史結束了，我需要休息。
我希望這將是我日記的最後一頁。

scripts.text: - The journal was ended at the page. -
scripts.translation: - 日記在這一頁結束了。 -

scripts.translation: - 你合上了書。 -

Do you want me to help you?
scripts.translation:

嘿，你看起來挺重的嘛？
需要我幫你嗎？

scripts.text:

Hey, what's up?
I am a professional Marine Sphere Bottle maker.
You can call me Boomer.
scripts.translation:
[布默]
嘿，你好啊？
我是專業的刺錘瓶製造者。
你可以叫我布默。

scripts.text: Buy Marine Sphere Bottle.
scripts.translation: 購買刺錘瓶

scripts.text: End conversation.
scripts.translation: 結束對話

scripts.text:
[Boomer]
Heh, you want my Marine Sphere Bottles, huh?
You know, my bomb never fail to blow things away.
Do you want to cut a tunnel?
You've got the right choice for the bomb here!
scripts.translation:
[布默]
嘿嘿，你想買我的刺錘瓶啊？
你知道的，我的炸彈從不失手，能把東西炸得粉碎。
你想挖個隧道嗎？
選我的炸彈就對了！

scripts.text:
[Boomer]
One Marine Sphere Bottle is 3,000 zeny.
You must understand that I am providing the bomb at such a low price
considering its amazing performance!
You will regret if you miss this chance. Hahaha!
scripts.translation:
[布默]
一個刺錘瓶只要3,000 Zeny。
你應該明白，考慮到它驚人的威力，
我給出的價格已經非常低了！
如果你錯過這個機會，肯定會後悔的。哈哈哈！

scripts.text: Buy.
scripts.translation: 購買

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Boomer]
Errr...You must have been so hurry to carry your wallet with you.
scripts.translation:
[布默]
呃...你一定很著急，才會隨身帶著錢包吧。

scripts.text:
[Boomer]
Just make sure that you are not going to
blow yourself away with this bomb, hahah!

- You found a pile of paper that was tied up with a thick ribbon.
On the very top paper, a period and a title saying 'Report of the **th Research'
were written.
scripts.translation:
- 你發現了一疊用粗絲帶捆著的紙張。
最上面的一張紙上，寫著一個句號和標題“**次研究報告”。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Good, I must take this with me.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
很好，我必須把這個帶走。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This must be it...whoa, it looks very spooky.
Today, I am going to destroy you
for making innocent people's lives miserable!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這應該就是它了...哇，看起來好可怕。
今天，我要消滅你，
讓你不再讓無辜的人受苦！

scripts.text: - You threw a Marine Sphere Bottle toward the machine. -
scripts.translation: - 你向機器扔出了一個刺錘瓶。 -

scripts.text: BOOM!
scripts.translation: 轟！

scripts.text:
- You were staggered for the fact that
you forgot to bring the Marine Sphere Bottle with you. -
scripts.translation: - 你因為忘記帶刺錘瓶而感到一陣眩暈。 -

Recently we have many tourists visiting our town.
They make me pretty busy, but I am so happy to see them enjoying my food. Hohoho!

最近有很多遊客來到我們的城鎮。
這讓我挺忙的，但看到他們享受我的食物，我很高興。呵呵呵！
