scripts.text:
[Manainne]
This tree means so much
to everyone in this town,
and we all have special
memories of this place. But
that El Schatt fellow plans to
chop it down for his shop...
scripts.translation:
[瑪娜茵]
這棵樹對鎮上的每個人來說都意義非凡，
我們都在這裡留下了特別的回憶。
但那個艾爾·沙特竟然打算
為了他的商店把它砍掉...

scripts.text:
[Manainne]
You see him? That's
El Schatt right there.
I've never met anyone
so cruel and selfish!
Right now he's surveying
the land for construction...
scripts.translation:
[瑪娜茵]
你看到了嗎？
那就是艾爾·沙特。
我從來沒見過
比他更殘忍、更自私的人！
他現在正在勘察
用於施工的土地...

scripts.text:
[Manainne]
This tree means so much
to everyone in this town,
and we all have special
memories of this place. But
that El Schatt fellow plans to
chop it down for his shop...
scripts.translation:
[瑪娜茵]
這棵樹對鎮上的每個人來說都意義非凡，
我們都在這裡留下了特別的回憶。
但那個艾爾·沙特竟然打算
為了他的商店把它砍掉...

scripts.text:
[Manainne]
You see him? That's
El Schatt right there.
I've never met anyone
so cruel and selfish!
Right now he's surveying
the land for construction...
scripts.translation:
[瑪娜茵]
你看到了嗎？
那就是艾爾·沙特。
我從來沒見過
比他更殘忍、更自私的人！
他現在正在勘察
用於施工的土地...

scripts.text:
[Manainne]
You know, El Schatt and
I used to get along when
he dated my older sister,
Kanainne. In fact, they'd
always spend time together right under that tree. Weird, huh?
scripts.translation:
[瑪娜茵]
你知道嗎，艾爾·沙特
和我以前相處得還不錯，
當時他還在追求
我的姐姐卡娜茵。
事實上，他們總是
在那棵樹下共度時光。真奇怪，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Manainne]
Then, well, Kanainne
got really sick, and we...
We couldn't help her. She
passed away, and then El Schatt
just disappeared. It was only
recently that he's come back.
scripts.translation:
[瑪娜茵]
後來，卡娜茵
病得很重，我們...
我們沒能救下她。
她去世後，艾爾·沙特
就消失了。直到最近
他才回來。

scripts.text:
[Manainne]
Now El Schatt is just a
heartless, money grubbing...!
He's completely changed.
My sister would be rolling
in her grave, seeing him now...
scripts.translation:
[瑪娜茵]
現在的艾爾·沙特
就是個無情、唯利是圖的...！
他完全變了一個人。
我姐姐看到現在的他，
恐怕在九泉之下都要氣得轉圈了...

scripts.text:
[Manainne]
Now El Schatt is just a
heartless, money grubbing...!
He's completely changed.
My sister would be rolling
in her grave, seeing him now...
scripts.translation:
[瑪娜茵]
現在的艾爾·沙特
就是個無情、唯利是圖的...！
他完全變了一個人。
我姐姐看到現在的他，
恐怕在九泉之下都要氣得轉圈了...

scripts.text:
[Manainne]
What? That's...
That's an incredible
story. You met my dead
sister in Niflheim?! You
must be lying to me!
scripts.translation:
[瑪娜茵]
什麼？那是...
那是個不可思議的故事。
你在尼弗海姆遇到了
我死去的姐姐？！
你肯定是在騙我！

scripts.text:
[Manainne]
Let's... Let's just
stop talking about this,
okay? I appreciate that you
want to stop El Schatt from
cutting down our tree, but
this is almost too much.
scripts.translation:
[瑪娜茵]
我們...
我們別再談這個了，
好嗎？我很感激你
想阻止艾爾·沙特
砍掉我們的樹，
但這真的有點太過分了。

scripts.text:
[Manainne]
Gosh, all that talk
about Niflheim is...
It's giving me the chills!
A-aren't you cold?
scripts.translation:
[瑪娜茵]
天哪，剛才那些
關於尼弗海姆的話題...
聽得我直打寒顫！
你...你不覺得冷嗎？

scripts.text:
[Manainne]
......
.........
Huh? You're...
Still here...?

[Manainne]
Y-you know what's
weird? The weather's
perfectly fine, but I...
I feel so cold all of a
sudden. You don't feel
it at all, don't you?
scripts.translation:
[瑪娜茵]
你...你知道奇怪的是什麼嗎？
天氣明明很好，但我...
我突然覺得好冷。你完全
沒感覺到，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Manainne]
I think I'm coming down
with something. My head
feels so numb, and I c-can't
focus any of my thoughts.
This is freakin' me out...
scripts.translation:
[瑪娜茵]
我覺得我好像要生病了。
我的頭好暈，我...我完全
無法集中注意力。
這真的嚇到我了...

scripts.text:
[Manainne]
...!

[Manainne]
...I'm here. I'm really
back! Oh, it's been so
long! Hello, adventurer,
remember me? I'm Kanainne,
the spirit you saw down in
Niflheim. Let me explain...
scripts.translation:
[瑪娜茵]
...我在這裡。我真的
回來了！好久不見！你好，冒險者，
還記得我嗎？我是卡娜茵，
你在尼弗海姆見到的那個精靈。
讓我解釋一下...

scripts.text:
[Manainne]
My spirit was able to follow
you here, and now that I'm
here, I only have so much time
to possess my sister's body,
and then talk to El Schatt.
El Schatt? El Schatt...?
scripts.translation:
[瑪娜茵]
我的靈魂能夠
跟隨你來到這裡，
而現在我既然在這裡，
我就只有這麼點時間
附身在我姐姐的身體裡，
去和艾爾·沙特談談。
艾爾·沙特？艾爾·沙特...？

scripts.text:
[El Schatt]
Manainne...?
What do you want?
Quit bugging me,
I'm busy right now...
scripts.translation:
[艾爾·沙特]
瑪娜茵...？
你想幹什麼？
別煩我了，
我現在很忙...

scripts.text:
[Manainne]
It's... It's me,
El Schatt, it's Kanainne.
Of course you remember
me, right? Listen, I need to--
scripts.translation:
[瑪娜茵]
是我...
是我，艾爾·沙特，
我是卡娜茵。
你當然記得我，對吧？
聽著，我需要--

scripts.text:
[El Schatt]
Manainne...?!
I'm shocked...
Don't you respect
your own sister?!
I can't believe you'd...
Knock it off right now!
scripts.translation:
[艾爾·沙特]
瑪娜茵...？！
我震驚了...
你不尊重你自己的姐姐嗎？！
我簡直不敢相信你會...
立刻給我閉嘴！

scripts.text:
[El Schatt]
Look, out of my respect
for you and the relationship
that me and your sister had,
I'm going to forget you said
that. But don't you dare use
her name that way again!
scripts.translation:
[艾爾·沙特]
聽著，出於對你的尊重，
以及我和你姐姐曾經的關係，
我會假裝沒聽到你剛才說的話。
但你絕對不許
再那樣用她的名字！

scripts.text:
[Manainne]
Wait, El Schatt!
It's really me, but
I can only speak to you
through my sister for
a short time. L-listen...
scripts.translation:
[瑪娜茵]
等等，艾爾·沙特！
真的是我，但我只能通過我姐姐
和你短暫地對話。聽...聽我說...

scripts.text:
[El Schatt]
Manainne...
You don't make jokes
like that about the departed,
especially if it's Kannaine.
You know better than that!
Where the hell's your respect?!
scripts.translation:
[艾爾·沙特]
瑪娜茵...
你不可以拿逝者開玩笑，
尤其是卡娜茵。
你明明比誰都清楚！
你的尊重呢？！

scripts.text:
[Manainne]
''If you're the wind,
I'll be the sky, so that you
can fly freely in my arms...''
scripts.translation:
[瑪娜茵]
“如果你是一陣風，
我願化作天空，
讓你在我的懷抱中自由飛翔...”

scripts.text:
[El Schatt]
Huh...?!

[Manainne]
''My soul is just
for you, the shining
sun that brightens
up my whole world.''
scripts.translation:
[瑪娜茵]
“我的靈魂只屬於你，
你是照亮我整個世界的
那輪耀眼的太陽。”

scripts.text:
[El Schatt]
How do you...
How do you know
those words...?
scripts.translation:
[艾爾·沙特]
你怎麼...
你怎麼會知道
那些話...？

scripts.text:
[Manainne]
''In my dream, your
eyes held the reflection
of the ocean's clear waters... Someday I'll show them to you.''
scripts.translation:
[瑪娜茵]
“在我的夢裡，
你的眼眸映照著海洋清澈的水光...
總有一天我會把它們展示給你看。”

scripts.text:
[Manainne]
''Your lovely face,
your enticing smile...
They're forever be in my
heart, so I'll never be lonely.''
scripts.translation:
[瑪娜茵]
“你可愛的臉龐，
你迷人的微笑...
它們永遠留在我心中，
所以我永遠不會感到孤單。”

scripts.text:
[El Schatt]
Manainne...
How do you
know that song?
scripts.translation:
[艾爾·沙特]
瑪娜茵...
你怎麼
知道那首歌？

scripts.text:
[Manainne]
El Schatt...
It's me, Kanainne.
You wrote this song
just for me. But I died
before you could finish it.
scripts.translation:
[瑪娜茵]
艾爾·沙特...
是我，卡娜茵。
你專門為我寫了這首歌。
但我在你寫完之前就去世了。

scripts.text:
[Manainne]
That was your dream,
wasn't it? To play your
beautiful music to make
people happy? Did you ever
finish our song for me?
scripts.translation:
[瑪娜茵]
那是你的夢想，
對吧？用你美妙的音樂
讓人們感到幸福？
你最終為我們完成了那首歌嗎？

scripts.text:
[El Schatt]
Hahahah, Manainne, alright.
Your sister must have told
you about that song. Ha ha...
You're t-taking it too far...
Please, just... Just stop.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾·沙特]
哈哈哈哈哈，瑪娜茵，好吧。
你姐姐一定跟你提過那首歌。
哈...哈...
你...你太過分了...
求求你...停下來吧。

scripts.text:
[Manainne]
El Schatt...
Listen to me.
Look at me. It's
really your Kanainne.
scripts.translation:
[瑪娜茵]
艾爾·沙特...
聽我說。
看著我。真的是
你的卡娜茵。

scripts.text:
[El Schatt]
Kanainne...?
It's too much to
believe. I want to
believe it so badly...
Is it really you?
scripts.translation:
[艾爾·沙特]
卡娜茵...？
這太難以置信了。
我多麼希望能相信...
真的是你嗎？

scripts.text:
[Manainne]
El Schatt...
scripts.translation:
[瑪娜茵]
艾爾·沙特...

scripts.text:
^3355FFManainne is sobbing
uncontrollably, and there's
nothing you can do to comfort
her. Nothing at all. You must
leave her alone to her despair
and unfathomable sense of loss.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF瑪娜茵無法控制地哭泣，
你什麼都做不了來安慰她。
什麼都做不了。你只能
讓她獨自面對絕望和無盡的失落。^000000

scripts.text:
[Manainne]
You know, even though
it's not a wealthy area,
I really love this small
and quiet town. Even if
I could live anywhere in
the world, I'd live right here~
scripts.translation:
[瑪娜茵]
你知道嗎，雖然這裡
不是富裕的地方，
但我真的很喜歡這個
小而安靜的城鎮。即使
我可以住在世界的任何角落，
我還是會選擇住在這裡~

scripts.text:
[Spirit]
El Schatt...
Manainne...
I miss them...
scripts.translation:
[精靈]
艾爾·沙特...
瑪娜茵...
我想念他們...

scripts.text:
[Spirit]
Those names... Yes,
I remember now. Manainee
was... my younger sister.
El Schatt was... my lover.
M-my name was... Kanainne!
scripts.translation:
[精靈]
那些名字...是的，
我想起來了。瑪娜茵是...
我的妹妹。
艾爾·沙特是...我的愛人。
我...我的名字是...卡娜茵！

scripts.text:
[Kanainne's Spirit]
Now I know why I'm here
in this realm. El Schatt...
I've been watching him.
He isn't able to let me go...
But I can't directly intervene
with the affairs of the living.
scripts.translation:
[卡奈恩之魂]
現在我知道我為什麼
會出現在這個領域了。艾爾·沙特...
我一直在注視著他。
他無法放下我...
但我不能直接干涉
生者的事務。

scripts.text:
[Kanainne's Spirit]
I... I can borrow my
sister's body? Yes, if she
cooperates, maybe... Maybe
it will work. I must... must do
something before he does
he hurts himself even more...
scripts.translation:
[卡奈恩之魂]
我...我可以借用
我妹妹的身體嗎？是的，
如果她配合的話，也許...
也許行得通。我必須...
必須在他傷害自己之前
做點什麼...

scripts.text:
[Kanainne's Spirit]
You... You can help
me... Just go back to 
the living... to Hugel...
Let me send you there...
scripts.translation:
[卡奈恩之魂]
你...你可以幫
我的忙...回到
生者的世界...去毀葛...
讓我送你去那裡...

scripts.text:
[Kanainne's Spirit]
You...! You can help
me... Just go back to 
the living... to Hugel...
Let me send you there...
scripts.translation:
[卡奈恩之魂]
你...！你可以幫
我的忙...回到
生者的世界...去毀葛...
讓我送你去那裡...

scripts.text:
[Spirit]
The living shouldn't
be here in Niflheim...
Go back! Go back to your
own world before it's too late!
scripts.translation:
[精靈]
生者不應該
出現在尼弗爾海姆...
回去吧！回到
你自己的世界，
不然就來不及了！

scripts.text:
[Spirit]
El Schatt...
Manainne...
I miss them...
scripts.translation:
[精靈]
艾爾·沙特...
瑪娜茵...
我想念他們...

scripts.text:
[Perfitz]
I'm pleased that my son has
finally set his mind on the
family business. I didn't know
he had it in him to become
such a proactive entrepreneur.
scripts.translation:
[佩爾菲茨]
我很高興我的兒子
終於下定決心
接手家業了。我沒想到
他居然有成為
如此積極的創業者的潛質。

scripts.text:
[Perfitz]
It's funny... He used to
deperately fight me when it
came to building shops where
that tree has planted. Yes, I'm
proud that he's grown as a
business person. Heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[佩爾菲茨]
真有趣...以前他
總是拼命和我爭辯，
反對在那棵樹旁邊
建商店。是的，
我為他作為一個
商人的成長感到驕傲。呵呵~

scripts.text:
[Perfitz]
Although I'm pleased,
I get this gut feeling that
something's not right, like
he's too excited about cutting
that tree down. Maybe this old
man is just too suspcious~
scripts.translation:
[佩爾菲茨]
雖然我很高興，
但我有種直覺
覺得不對勁，
好像他對砍倒
那棵樹太興奮了。
也許是我這個
老頭子太疑神疑鬼了~

scripts.text:
[Perfitz]
It's funny how things
change. You know, El Schatt
actually used to protest against my idea of building shops in the
area when that tree grows. Hmm... I wonder, what happened to him?
scripts.translation:
[佩爾菲茨]
世事真是變化莫測。
你知道嗎，艾爾·沙特
以前其實反對過
我在那棵樹生長的
區域建商店的想法。
嗯...我想知道，
他後來怎麼樣了？

scripts.text:
[Perfitz]
Money is very dependable...
But it's value is relative, and
can change at any moment.
Still, at my age, you can't
live without it. Make sure you
financially prepare of old age.
scripts.translation:
[佩爾菲茨]
金錢是非常可靠的...
但它的價值是相對的，
隨時都可能改變。
不過，到了我這個年紀，
沒有錢是活不下去的。
一定要為晚年
做好財務準備。

scripts.text:
[Perfitz]
Now, most people assume that
I have very few friends because
I trust money more than people.
That's somewhat true: money
will never betray you, and few
friends can be so dependable.
scripts.translation:
[佩爾菲茨]
現在，大多數人認為
我朋友很少，因為
我信錢勝過信人。
這倒是有幾分道理：
金錢永遠不會背叛你，
而能如此可靠的朋友
寥寥無幾。

scripts.text:
[Perfitz]
However, friends that can
be trusted for life are worth
more than all the money in the
world. To a rich man like me,
those are the only friends
that are worth having.
scripts.translation:
[佩爾菲茨]
然而，能託付終身的
朋友比世界上所有的
金錢都更有價值。
對於像我這樣的
富人來說，
只有這樣的朋友
才值得結交。

scripts.text:
[El Schatt]
What? What's that look for?
Oh, you must have spoken to
Manainne. Look, memories are
nice and all, but I don't dwell
on the past. I think about the
future. That's what's best.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾·沙特]
什麼？你這是什麼表情？
哦，你肯定是和
瑪娜茵聊過了。聽著，
回憶固然美好，
但我不會沉溺於過去。
我思考的是未來。
這才是最重要的。

scripts.text:
[El Schatt]
Hey, I've got some great
memories of this place too,
but you know what? I've decided
to let go of them before they
get too painful. That's life.
Besides, it's not all bad.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾·沙特]
嘿，我對這個地方
也有很多美好的回憶，
但你知道嗎？
我決定在它們變得
太痛苦之前放下它們。
這就是生活。
況且，也不是全是壞事。

scripts.text:
[El Schatt]
My father's been wanting to
build a shop here for so long,
and now, I think it's about time. And this business will help the
entire community. We should've
done this a long time ago...
scripts.translation:
[艾爾·沙特]
我父親一直想
在這裡建商店，
現在，我覺得時機到了。
而且這個生意會幫助
整個社群。我們早該
這麼做了...

scripts.text:
[El Schatt]
C'mon... Take a look
around. I won't deny that
this is a quaint and lovely
town, but how much money do
you think these people enjoy?
I need to look to the future...
scripts.translation:
[艾爾·沙特]
來吧...四處看看。
我不否認這是一個
古樸而美麗的小鎮，
但你覺得這些人
能享受多少金錢？
我需要展望未來...

scripts.text:
[El Schatt]
This is the perfect
location for shops.
Yeah, I'll build a whole
plaza, and rent it out to the
merchants. Build up some
commerce, attract businesses...
scripts.translation:
[艾爾·沙特]
這裡是建商店的
絕佳位置。
是的，我要建一個
大型廣場，
租給商人們。
發展商業，吸引企業...

scripts.text:
[El Schatt]
Everyone should just
forget about that tree.
When you think about it,
it's just a waste of space...
scripts.translation:
[艾爾·沙特]
大家應該
忘掉那棵樹。
仔細想想，
它只是浪費空間...

scripts.text:
[El Schatt]
You've spoken with my father?
Hmpf! Don't tell me you're here
to change my mind. I'm building
those shops, and that's final.
It's useless to try to convince
me otherwise. Understand?
scripts.translation:
[艾爾·沙特]
你和我父親談過了？
哼！別告訴我你是來
改變我主意的。
我要建那些商店，
這是最終決定。
試圖說服我改變主意
是沒用的。明白嗎？

scripts.text:
[El Schatt]
It's true that I used
to think differently...
I'd protect that old tree
with my life, I won't deny
it. But that's an old story that should be buried in the past...
scripts.translation:
[艾爾·沙特]
確實，我以前
想法不同...
我會拼了命保護
那棵老樹，我不否認。
但那是應該被埋藏在
過去的舊事...

scripts.text:
[El Schatt]
The past is behind me
as it should be. Now
I must focus on building
my family's businesses.
Father was right all along...
scripts.translation:
[艾爾·沙特]
過去就該留在
過去。現在
我必須專注於
發展家族的事業。
父親一直是對的...

scripts.text:
[El Schatt]
What did you say...?
You met Kanainne?
Listen, that's not funny.
I won't tolerate that kind
of sick joke, so get out
of here before I get angry.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾·沙特]
你剛才說什麼...？
你見過瑪娜茵？
聽著，這不好笑。
我無法容忍這種
噁心的玩笑，
趁我發火之前
趕緊滾出去。

scripts.text:
[El Schatt]
No way...!
Kanainne is dead!
There's no way
I can believe this!
scripts.translation:
[艾爾·沙特]
不可能...！
瑪娜茵已經死了！
我絕不可能
相信這件事！

scripts.text:
[El Schatt]
K-Kanainne! ^333333*Sob*^000000
I've missed you so much!
Why did you leave me?
scripts.translation:
[艾爾·沙特]
瑪...瑪娜茵！ ^333333*抽泣*^000000
我好想你！
你為什麼要離開我？

scripts.text:
[Manainne]
Oh, my dear,
sweet El Schatt...
I'm so sorry. But
that was my fate...
It was my time to go...
You have to let me go...
scripts.translation:
[瑪娜茵]
親愛的，
可愛的艾爾·沙特...
我很抱歉。但
那是我的命運...
是我該走的時候了...
你必須讓我離開...

scripts.text:
[El Schatt]
I can't take it anymore!
It hurts too much without you!
I can't stop thinking about us,
and all the memories... all of
the memories hurt so much...
scripts.translation:
[艾爾·沙特]
我受不了了！
沒有你太痛苦了！
我忍不住想起我們，
還有那些回憶... 所有的
回憶都讓我好痛...

scripts.text:
[Manainne]
Is that why you want to
cut down that tree? Because
it reminds you too much of
all of our days together?
scripts.translation:
[瑪娜茵]
這就是你想
砍掉那棵樹的原因嗎？因為
它讓你想起了
我們在一起的所有日子？

scripts.text:
[El Schatt]
Y-yes! Seeing it makes
me so angry and so sad!
I wanted to get rid of it!
If I don't forget you, then
what will I do? I c-can't
forget about you, c-can I?
scripts.translation:
[艾爾·沙特]
是...是的！看到它
讓我又氣又難過！
我想把它除掉！
如果我不忘記你，
那我該怎麼辦？我...我
忘不了你，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Manainne]
Will destroying that tree
make you happy? Do you think
you'll be happy if you forget
all about me? I know you're
not like that, El Schatt.
You're not that cold...
scripts.translation:
[瑪娜茵]
砍掉那棵樹
會讓你快樂嗎？你覺得
如果你完全忘記我，
你會快樂嗎？我知道
你不是那樣的人，艾爾·沙特。
你沒有那麼冷酷...

scripts.text:
[El Schatt]
No... I don't want
to forget you. All of
our good times. But I miss
you so much... I think I'm
going to go insane! I don't
know if I can endure this pain!
scripts.translation:
[艾爾·沙特]
不...我不想
忘記你。我們
所有美好的時光。但我好想你... 我覺得我
快要瘋了！我不知道
我能不能忍受這種痛苦！

scripts.text:
[Manainne]
Please be strong for me,
El Schatt. Someday, time
will heal your wounds, and
your memories of me will only
bring you fondness, not pain.
I miss you El Schatt, and I...
scripts.translation:
[瑪娜茵]
請為了我堅強起來，
艾爾·沙特。總有一天，時間
會治癒你的傷口，
你對我的回憶只會
帶來懷念，而不是痛苦。
我想你，艾爾·沙特，我...

scripts.text:
[El Schatt]
Kanainne...?
K-Kanaine?
What's happening?
scripts.translation:
[艾爾·沙特]
瑪娜茵...？
瑪...瑪娜茵？
發生什麼事了？

scripts.text:
[Manainne]
El Schatt, I'm so sorry...
But I have to go now. I can't
stay in the world of the living
for too long, and my time limit
is almost up. I still... I...
scripts.translation:
[瑪娜茵]
艾爾·沙特，我很抱歉...
但我現在必須走了。我不能
在人間停留太久，
我的時間快到了。我還... 我...

scripts.text:
[El Schatt]
N-no! Please, stay with
me! I'm not ready to lose
you again! D-don't leave
me again! Nooo! Kanainne!
I need you here with me!
scripts.translation:
[艾爾·沙特]
不...！求你，留下來
陪我！我還沒準備好
再次失去你！別...別再次
離開我！不...！瑪娜茵！
我需要你在這裡陪我！

scripts.text:
[Manainne]
I can't do that...
But please, El Schatt...
Promise that you'll be
yourself from now on...
Be kind... And follow
your true dreams...
scripts.translation:
[瑪娜茵]
我做不到...
但是請，艾爾·沙特...
答應我從今以後
做回你自己...
要善良... 並且追隨
你真正的夢想...

scripts.text:
[Manainne]
Don't cut down
that tree... And make...
make beautiful music.
Please finish the song
that you made for me for...
for both of our sakes...
scripts.translation:
[瑪娜茵]
不要砍掉
那棵樹... 並且... 並且
創作美妙的音樂。
請完成那首
你為我寫的歌，為了...
為了我們兩個...

scripts.text:
[El Schatt]
Anything for you,
Kanainne. I vow it...
scripts.translation:
[艾爾·沙特]
為了你，
瑪娜茵。我發誓...

scripts.text:
[Manainne]
El Schatt...
I still... I still...
scripts.translation:
[瑪娜茵]
艾爾·沙特...
我還... 我還...

scripts.text:
[El Schatt]
Y-yes...
Kanainne...?
scripts.translation:
[艾爾·沙特]
是...是的...
瑪娜茵...？

scripts.text:
[El Schatt]
Kanainne...?
Kanainne!
scripts.translation:
[艾爾·沙特]
瑪娜茵...？
瑪娜茵！

scripts.text:
[Manainne]
...I...
...El Schatt...
She's gone again.
It's... I'm Manainne...
^333333*Sniff*^000000 She had to go back...
scripts.translation:
[瑪娜茵]
...我...
...艾爾·沙特...
她又走了。
我是...我是瑪娜茵...
^333333*抽泣*^000000 她不得不回去了...

scripts.text:
[El Schatt]
Oh... Oh dear
sweet God... My...
My dear Kanainne...
No.... No... Please...
scripts.translation:
[艾爾·沙特]
噢...噢，天哪...
我的...
我親愛的瑪娜茵...
不...不...求求你...

scripts.text:
[El Schatt]
...Would you please
leave me alone? I have...
I have an awful lot to
think about. And there's
music that I have to write...
scripts.translation:
[艾爾·沙特]
...請讓我一個人待著好嗎？我有很多...
有很多事情要思考。而且我還有音樂要寫...

scripts.text:
[El Schatt]
Father was right...
This area is the perfect
place to build some stores.
All that's left is to chop down
that old tree. It's in the way
of a whole lot of things...
scripts.translation:
[艾爾·沙特]
神父說得對...
這個地方非常適合建商店。
剩下的就是砍掉那棵老樹了。它擋了很多東西的路...

scripts.text:
[Torpy]
D-Daddy...!
Daddy where
are you?! Wah~!
scripts.translation:
[托爾皮]
爸...爸爸...！
爸爸你在哪裡？！哇~！

scripts.text: What's wrong?
scripts.translation: 怎麼了？

scripts.text: Ignore
scripts.translation: 無視

scripts.text:
[Torpy]
My Daddy hasn't
been home for a few
day now. I'm afraid that
something must have
happened to him. *Sniff*
scripts.translation:
[托爾皮]
爸爸已經好幾天沒回家了。我很擔心他是不是出什麼事了。*抽泣*

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Your Dad is missing?
Why don't you tell me
about the last time
that you saw him?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你爸爸失蹤了？
為什麼不告訴我你最後一次見到他是什麼時候呢？

scripts.text:
[Torpy]
Well, we were playing
Hide-and-Seek, and then
it was his turn to hide,
and then, a-and then...
I never found him!
scripts.translation:
[托爾皮]
嗯，我們在玩捉迷藏，然後輪到爸爸藏起來，然後，然後...
我就再也找不到他了！

scripts.text: Really? Tell me more...
scripts.translation: 真的嗎？再多告訴我一些...

scripts.text: What, is that all...?
scripts.translation: 就這些嗎...？

scripts.text:
[Torpy]
Th-then my Mom got
mad at Dad for hiding
for so long. But when
she went to find him, she
disappeared too! I-I'm all
alone now! Waaaaaah~!
scripts.translation:
[托爾皮]
然後媽媽因為爸爸藏太久生氣了。但媽媽去找他的時候，她也消失了！我現在一個人了！哇啊啊啊~！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Don't worry, I'll look
for your parents. I'm
sure that I can find at
least one of them just
outside of town.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
別擔心，我會幫你找父母的。我相信我能在城外找到至少其中一個。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Don't worry, your
Dad will probably
show up sooner
or later. Well, lots
of luck, kid.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
別擔心，你爸爸很快就會回來的。祝你好運，小孩。

scripts.text:
[Torpy]
D-Daddy...!
Mommiiiiiiiiie!
Where are yoooou?!
Wuh-Waaaaaaaaaah!
scripts.translation:
[托爾皮]
爸...爸爸...！
媽媽~！
你們在哪裡？！嗚-哇啊啊啊！

scripts.text:
[Torpy]
Oh...
Mommy was just
outside of town?
*Sob* Okay, I hope my
Daddy comes back soon...
scripts.translation:
[托爾皮]
噢...
媽媽就在城外？
*抽泣* 好吧，希望爸爸快點回來...

scripts.text:
[Torpy]
Y-you found my Daddy!
Hooray! I was so worried
about him! Th-thank you
so much for your help!
scripts.translation:
[托爾皮]
你...你找到我爸爸了！
太好了！我好擔心他！非常感謝你的幫助！

scripts.text:
[Torpy]
Um, um, where is my
Daddy hiding anyway?
Oh? A barrel? Where
was it again? Heh heh!
Now I can find him!
scripts.translation:
[托爾皮]
嗯，嗯，爸爸到底藏在哪裡呢？
噢？一個桶？在哪裡來著？嘿嘿！
現在我可以找到他了！

scripts.text:
[Torpy]
Oh, would you go talk
to my Mom, and tell her
to come here please? And
also tell her that Daddy
is safe! See you later~
scripts.translation:
[托爾皮]
你能去跟我媽媽說一聲，讓她來這裡嗎？
順便告訴她爸爸很安全！再見~

scripts.text:
[Torpy]
^333333...............................
Hee hee~ Once I find
my Daddy, he has to get me
a girlfriend! He promised~!^000000

[Torpy]
Would you please hurry
and talk to my Mom? She
should be just outside of?
this town, where you last
saw her. Bye bye for now~
scripts.translation:
[托爾皮]
你能快點去跟我媽媽說一聲嗎？
她應該就在城外，你上次見到她的地方。拜拜~

scripts.text:
[Torpy]
^333333...............................
Oh yeah! Should I have
Mom help me pick out my
new girlfriend? Hmm, I dunno.
Wh-what if they become friends?
Um, that might not be good...^000000
scripts.translation:
[托爾皮]
^333333...............................
對了！要不要讓媽媽幫我挑女朋友呢？嗯，不知道。
萬...萬一她們成了朋友怎麼辦？
嗯，那樣可能不太好...^000000

scripts.text:
[Torpy]
Daddy promised to get
me a girlfriend if I beat him
at Hide-and-Seek! Hahaha!
I won, so now he has to do it!
scripts.translation:
[托爾皮]
爸爸答應過，如果我贏了他捉迷藏，就給我找個女朋友！哈哈哈！
我贏了，所以他必須兌現承諾！

scripts.text:
[Torpy]
Wait, but should I let
my Dad pick my girlfriend?
Maybe I should pick her...
Yeah, I'll pick the perfectest
girl that I can find! Yaaay~
scripts.translation:
[托爾皮]
等等，但我應該讓爸爸幫我挑女朋友嗎？
也許我應該自己挑...
沒錯，我要找到最完美的女孩！耶~

scripts.text:
[Torpy]
Maybe I should wait until
I'm older to have a girlfriend.
I mean, what if the girl I pick
now gets uglier when she
grows up? Or what if she gets really fat? I better be careful...
scripts.translation:
[托爾皮]
也許我應該等長大一點再交女朋友。
我是說，萬一我現在挑的女孩長大後變醜了怎麼辦？
或者萬一她變得很胖呢？我得小心點...

scripts.text:
^3355FFTorpy is still a young,
naive child that has much
to learn about girlfriends,
or just people, in general.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF托爾皮還是個年幼天真的孩子，
他對女朋友，或者對一般人，
還有很多要學習的地方。^000000

scripts.text:
[Torpy]
^333333*Sniff*^000000 D-Daddy's gone!
Will you help me find my
Daddy please? I h-have
to find him now! H-Hurry!
scripts.translation:
[托爾皮]
^333333*抽泣*^000000 爸...爸爸不見了！
你能幫我找找爸爸嗎？
我...我必須馬上找到他！快...快點！

scripts.text:
[Torpy]
Waaah~!
I have to find
my Daddy! Daddy...!
Where are yooooou?!
scripts.translation:
[托爾皮]
哇啊~！
我必須找到爸爸！爸爸...！
你在哪...哪裡呀？！

scripts.text:
[Torpy's Mom]
Where did he go this time?!
If my husband doesn't have
a good excuse for not coming
home, then he better come
up with one or he'll be sorry!
scripts.translation:
[托爾皮的媽媽]
他這次又去哪了？！
如果我丈夫沒有正當理由不回家，
那他最好想出一個，否則他會後悔的！

scripts.text:
[Torpy's Mom]
Hmm? Oh, you talked to
my little Torpy? He thinks his
father and I just vanished?
Oh, I'm so sorry, I think there's been some misunderstanding!
scripts.translation:
[托爾皮的媽媽]
嗯？哦，你跟我的小托爾皮說話了？
他以為我和他爸爸都失蹤了？
哦，真抱歉，我想這裡有些誤會！

scripts.text:
[Torpy's Mom]
Although Torpy's father has
been missing for a little
while, I just stepped out of
the house this morning. So
I haven't even been gone for
a few hours, much less a day.
scripts.translation:
[托爾皮的媽媽]
雖然托爾皮的爸爸確實失蹤了一會兒，
但我今天早上才剛出門。
所以我還沒離開幾個小時，更別提一天了。

scripts.text:
[Torpy's Mom]
You see, my husband is
a hunter, so it's usual for him
not to come home for a few
days. Still, he's never been
gone for this long before,
so I've been looking for him...
scripts.translation:
[托爾皮的媽媽]
你看，我丈夫是個獵人，
所以他幾天不回家是很正常的。
不過，他以前從沒失蹤這麼久過，
所以我一直在找他...

scripts.text:
[Torpy's Mom]
I've been getting a little
worried myself, honestly.
He's not in any of his usual
hunting grounds. Hopefully,
if I wait here long enough,
he'll show up sooner or later.
scripts.translation:
[托爾皮的媽媽]
說實話，我也開始有點擔心了。
他不在他通常打獵的地方。
希望我在這裡等得夠久，
他遲早會出現的。

scripts.text:
[Torpy's Mom]
If he doesn't show up
today, I better search
for him inside town. Maybe
he's hiding somewhere,
like at his friend's house.
Why is like always like this?
scripts.translation:
[托爾皮的媽媽]
如果他今天還不出現，
我最好去鎮子裡找找。
也許他躲在某個地方，
比如他朋友家裡。
為什麼總是這樣？

scripts.text:
[Torpy's Mom]
Listen, would you please
tell my son Torpy that I'm
fine and will be coming back
home soon? Also, if you see
my husband inside town, tell
him that he better come home!
scripts.translation:
[托爾皮的媽媽]
聽著，你能幫我告訴兒子托爾皮，
我很好，很快就會回家嗎？
還有，如果你在鎮子裡看到我丈夫，
告訴他他最好回家！

scripts.text:
[Torpy's Mom]
Listen, would you please
tell my son Torpy that I'm
fine and will be coming back
home soon? Also, if you see
my husband inside town, tell
him that he better come home!
scripts.translation:
[托爾皮的媽媽]
聽著，你能幫我告訴兒子托爾皮，
我很好，很快就會回家嗎？
還有，如果你在鎮子裡看到我丈夫，
告訴他他最好回家！

scripts.text:
[Torpy's Mom]
What?! He was hiding
inside a barrel this
entire time?! Oh, no.
I'm sorry, my husband has
caused you so much trouble.
scripts.translation:
[托爾皮的媽媽]
什麼？！他整個時間都躲在桶裡？！
哦，不。
對不起，我丈夫給你們添了這麼多麻煩。

scripts.text:
[Torpy's Mom]
I really appreciate
everything you've done
to help us find him. I know
it's not much, but I hope
you accept this as our thanks.
Goodbye for now, adventurer~
scripts.translation:
[托爾皮的媽媽]
我非常感謝你們為我們找到他所做的一切。
我知道這不算什麼，
但希望你們能收下這份感謝。
再見，冒險者~

scripts.text:
[Torpy's Mom]
Sometimes I wonder if
Torpy is too mature for
his age, or if my husband
is too immature. In a strange
way, those two really take
after each other. Oh, well...
scripts.translation:
[托爾皮的媽媽]
有時候我會想，
是托爾皮太成熟了，
還是我丈夫太幼稚了。
以某種奇怪的方式，
這兩人真的很像。哦，算了...

scripts.text:
[Torpy's Mom]
When is that husband
of mine going to come
out of that barrel? He
didn't make another weird
bet with Torpy, did he? Oh,
the trouble with those two...
scripts.translation:
[托爾皮的媽媽]
我那個丈夫什麼時候才能從桶裡出來？
他是不是又跟托爾皮打賭了？
哦，這兩人真讓人頭疼...

scripts.text:
[Torpy's Mom]
Where did he go this time?!
If my husband doesn't have
a good excuse for not coming
home, then he better come
up with one or he'll be sorry!
scripts.translation:
[托爾皮的媽媽]
他這次又去哪了？！
如果我丈夫沒有正當理由不回家，
那他最好想出一個，否則他會後悔的！

scripts.text:
[Strange Man]
So... hun...gry...
F-food... Give me...
F-food... Must... replenish...
h-health... with... Steamed...
Crab... Nippers... Please...

^3355FFIt sounds like
this barrel wants
Steamed Crab Nippers.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF聽起來這個桶想要蒸蟹螯。^000000

scripts.text: I'll bring you Steamed Crab Nippers
scripts.translation: 我會給你帶蒸蟹螯

scripts.text: Ignore
scripts.translation: 無視

scripts.text:
[Strange Man]
Please... cook me...
Steamed... Crab Nippers...!
You... n-need.... 10 Green
Herbs... 1 Yellow Potions...
and 10... N-Nippers... to
c-cook th-them. Ugh...
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的男子]
請...給我做...
蒸...蟹螯...！
你...需...需要...10個綠草...
1瓶黃色藥水...
和10個...蟹螯...
來...烹飪。呃...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hold on,
I have to cook
them for you?!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等一下，
我要為你烹飪它們？！

scripts.text:
[Strange Man]
Y-yes...
It's... It's the
o-only... possible...
Way... P-please help...
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的男子]
是...是的...
這是...這是唯一...
可能的...方法...請...請幫幫我...

scripts.text:
[Strange Man]
D-don't... leave...
me... Here... Th-the...
hunger...! It... It can't...
It c-can't be... d-denied!
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的男子]
別...別走...
留...我在這裡...那...那...
飢餓...！它...它無法...
它...無法被...忽視！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Weirdo! Why don't you
get out of that barrel,
and get your Steamed
Crab Nippers yourself?!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
怪人！你為什麼不
從那個桶裡出來，
自己去弄蒸蟹螯？！

scripts.text:
[Strange Man]
Th-that... tantalizing...
scent... It's S-Steamed...
Crab... Nippers... Oh God...
It's b-been so... l-long...
G-Give me! G-Give me now!
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的男子]
那...那...誘人的...
香味...是蒸...
蟹...螯...天哪...
已經...很久...
沒...沒吃了...
給...給我！現在...給我！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou dumped the
Steamed Crab Nippers
into the barrel where
it was quickly devoured.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你把蒸蟹螯倒進了桶裡，
它很快就被吃光了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Strange Man]
Ha ha ha!
Back in the game, baby!
Man, it's been, about what,
3 days since I last ate?
It's good to be alive!
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的男子]
哈哈！
遊戲繼續，寶貝！
天哪，我大概
有3天沒吃東西了？
活著真好！

Please... cook me...

scripts.text:
^3355FFFor now, you should
tell Torpy and his mom
where Torpy's father is
hiding so they won't
worry about him so much.
scripts.translation: ^3355FF現在，你應該告訴托爾皮和他的媽媽，托爾皮的父親藏在哪裡，這樣他們就不會那麼擔心他了。

scripts.text:
^800080Torpy's mom might want to know about^000000
^800080this extraordinary barrel.^000000
^800080How long does Torpy's father plan to stay within the barrel?^000000
scripts.translation: ^800080托爾皮的父親打算在桶裡待多久？^000000

scripts.text:
^800080That barrel will become a symbolic object^000000
^800080that pays tribute to the firm will of Torpy's father^000000
^800080who is trying hard to avoid keeping the promise with his son to find his wife.^000000
scripts.translation:
^800080那個桶將成為一個象徵物，^000000
^800080致敬托爾皮父親堅定的意志，^000000
^800080他正努力避免履行與兒子尋找妻子的承諾。^000000

scripts.text:
^800080You hear something bustling from the hole in the barrel.^000000
^800080However, it doesn't seem to be a big deal.^000000
scripts.translation:
^800080你聽到桶的洞裡傳來一陣騷動。^000000
^800080不過，這似乎沒什麼大事。^000000

scripts.text:
[Strange Man]
Ahhhh... Thanks for
the free meal! It was
so invigorating! Well,
I better climb back
inside that barrel. See
ya round, adventurer~
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的男子]
啊...謝謝你的
免費餐！真讓人
精神煥發！好吧，
我得爬回那個桶裡了。
再見，冒險者~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hold it!
Why are you hiding
inside that barrel?!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等！
你為什麼躲在
那個桶裡？！

scripts.text:
[Strange Man]
Huh? Oh, I'm just
playing Hide-and-Seek
with my son, that's all.
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的男子]
嗯？哦，我只是
在和我兒子玩捉迷藏，
僅此而已。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But you haven't
eaten in days! Wait,
hold on, you wouldn't
happen to be Torpy's
father now, would you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
但你已經好幾天
沒吃東西了！等等，
你該不會是托爾皮的
父親吧？

scripts.text:
[Strange Man]
Oh, you ran into my boy?
Has he given up on our
little wager yet? Because
I'd really hate to lose...
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的男子]
哦，你遇到我兒子了？
他放棄我們的小賭注了嗎？
因為我真的不想輸...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Um, your wife and son
are really worried about
you. Shouldn't you be going
home as soon as you can?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，你的妻子和兒子
真的很擔心你。
你不應該儘快回家嗎？

scripts.text:
[Strange Man]
No, I can't! Not until
Torpy gives up! I made
a really silly promise
with my son, and if I lose
this game of Hide-and-Seek...
Well, I just can't lose! Bye!
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的男子]
不行，我不能！
除非托爾皮放棄！
我和兒子開了一個很傻的玩笑，
如果我輸掉這場捉迷藏...
總之，我絕對不能輸！再見！

scripts.text:
^3355FFTorpy's father has
hidden himself again,
but at least now you
can go back to Torpy's
Mom and Torpy, and let them
both know where he is hiding.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF托爾皮的父親又躲起來了，
但至少現在你可以回到托爾皮
和他媽媽那裡，
告訴他們他躲在哪裡了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Strange Man]
Hahahaha!
Steamed Crab Nippers!
That really hit the spot!
I ate so much, I won't
have to eat again for days!
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的男子]
哈哈哈哈哈！
蒸蟹螯！
真是一絕！
我吃得太多，
好幾天都不用再吃東西了！

scripts.text:
[Cellette]
Hi there, thanks for
visiting our lovely town!
Why don't you come in and
have a taste of authentic
Hugel cuisine? I guarantee
that you won't regret it~
scripts.translation:
[塞萊特]
你好，感謝光臨我們美麗的城鎮！
何不進來嚐嚐正宗的毀葛美食呢？
我保證你不會後悔的~

scripts.text:
[Cellette]
My name is Cellette Lavit,
and I proudly serve Fish Cake
Soup, Hugel's specialty dish.
All the tourists that've tried
it have loved it, and I have
many regular customers~
scripts.translation:
[塞萊特]
我叫塞萊特·拉維特，
我很自豪地提供串湯，
這是毀葛的特色菜。
所有嘗試過的遊客都喜歡它，
而且我有很多常客~

scripts.text:
[Cellette]
This dish has something
of a cult following, and it's
not widely popularized, but I'm
sure that it'll be considered
representative of Schwarzwald
Republic cuisine someday.
scripts.translation:
[塞萊特]
這道菜擁有一群忠實的追隨者，
雖然它還沒有廣泛流行，
但我相信總有一天，
它會被視為修瓦魯茲巴魯德共和國的代表美食。

scripts.text:
[Cellette]
Listen, you look like an
able adventurer, so would
you consider working part time
for me? I have many orders for
Fish Cake Soup, so there's
no way I can make deliveries...
scripts.translation:
[塞萊特]
聽著，你看起來像個能幹的冒險者，
你願意考慮為我做兼職嗎？
我有很多串湯的訂單，
所以我沒辦法親自送貨...

scripts.text:
[Cellette]
If you work for me, I'll
waive the price: I'll give you
1 Fish Cake Soup for each
delivery that you complete.
But if you're not interested,
you can just buy some now~
scripts.translation:
[塞萊特]
如果你為我工作，我會免除費用：
每完成一次送貨，我就給你一碗串湯。
但如果你不感興趣，
現在也可以直接買一些~

scripts.text: Sure, I'll work for you!
scripts.translation: 好的，我願意為你工作！

scripts.text: I want to buy Fish Cake Soup.
scripts.translation: 我想買串湯。

scripts.text: See ya.
scripts.translation: 再見。

scripts.text:
[Cellette]
Oh, thank you so much!
You can't imagine how busy
I've been, and how much I need the help! Now, let's get started~
scripts.translation:
[塞萊特]
哦，太感謝你了！
你無法想像我有多忙，
我多麼需要你的幫助！
好了，讓我們開始吧~

scripts.text:
[Cellette]
Alright, please take this
order of Fish Cake Soup to
my friend Neha. I'm grateful
that she's a regular customer--
she's a good friend, but I'm sure that she loves the soup as well.
scripts.translation:
[塞萊特]
好的，請把這碗串湯
送到我的朋友內哈那裡。
我很感激她是我的常客——
她是個好朋友，但我相信她也喜歡這湯。

scripts.text:
[Cellette]
Right, take this next order
of Fish Cake Soup to Maewan,
another one of my regulars.
He's been buying my soup ever
since I helped him start his business. Nice of him, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[塞萊特]
好的，把這碗串湯
送到梅萬那裡，
他也是我的常客之一。
自從我幫他創業以來，
他就一直買我的湯。他真好，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Cellette]
Okay, this order of Fish
Cake Soup is ready! Please
take it to my roommate Layoma.
But... Be careful. She's got
a thing about punctuality.
Just try not to be late...
scripts.translation:
[塞萊特]
好的，這碗串湯準備好了！
請送到我的室友拉約瑪那裡。
但是...小心點。她非常注重準時。
儘量別遲到...

scripts.text:
[Cellette]
Quick, take this Fish
Paste Soup to Erjan. Um,
but be careful, he's really
nitpicky... And he likes to
have everything in such
and such and order...
scripts.translation:
[塞萊特]
快，把這碗魚泥湯送到埃爾揚那裡。
嗯，但是小心點，他真的很挑剔...
而且他喜歡把一切都按特定的順序擺放...

scripts.text:
[Cellette]
Oh, you'd like to try my
Fish Cake Soup, eh? Good
choice, I know you'll enjoy
its delicious, hearty flavor~
Each order costs 100 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[塞萊特]
哦，你想嚐嚐我的串湯，是嗎？
好選擇，我知道你會喜歡它美味濃郁的風味的~
每碗100 Zeny。

scripts.text: Order a Fish Cake Soup
scripts.translation: 點一碗串湯

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Cellette]
Thanks! Enjoy your
bowl of Fish Cake Soup.
I hope you come and 
visit me again, okay?
scripts.translation:
[塞萊特]
謝謝！享用你的串湯吧。
希望你再來光顧，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Cellette]
Oh, what's this?
You don't have enough
money? Well, come back
after you save 100 zeny.
That's a really good price
for my gourmet soup, you know.
scripts.translation:
[塞萊特]
哦，這是什麼？
你錢不夠嗎？
那等你攢夠100 Zeny再來吧。
對於我這樣的美食家做的湯來說，
這真的是很划算的價格，你知道嗎。

scripts.text:
[Cellette]
If you're ever hungry,
or just want to enjoy
a delicious meal, come
and have some of my soup~
scripts.translation:
[塞萊特]
如果你餓了，
或者只是想享受一頓美味的大餐，
就來嚐嚐我的湯吧~

scripts.text:
[Cellette]
Oh? You're not interested
in trying my Fish Cake Soup
at all? Well, if you change
your mind, please come
back. I just know you'll love
the taste if you give it a try.
scripts.translation:
[塞萊特]
哦？你完全不想嚐嚐我的串湯嗎？
好吧，如果你改變主意了，請回來。
我相信只要你試一下，就會愛上它的味道。

scripts.text:
[Cellette]
Haven't you left already?
My friend Neha is waiting
for you to deliver her order
of Fish Cake Soup. Please
try to get it to her before the
soup gets cold, okay?
scripts.translation:
[塞萊特]
你還沒走嗎？
我的朋友內哈正在等你送她的串湯訂單。
請在湯變涼之前送到她那裡，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Cellette]
What's that? You lost
the Fish Cake Soup you're
supposed to deliver to Neha?
Oh well, I suppose I'll have
to give you this fresh bowl
of soup that I just made...
scripts.translation:
[塞萊特]
什麼？你弄丟了應該送給內哈的串湯？
好吧，我想我得把這碗我剛做好的新鮮湯給你...

scripts.text:
[Cellette]
But you need to be
responsible and pay
me for the food you lost.
There, I took 100 zeny
from you. That's fair, so
please don't lose it this time.
scripts.translation:
[塞萊特]
但你得負責任，
為你弄丟的食物付錢。
看，我從你那裡收了100 Zeny。
這很公平，所以這次別再弄丟了。

scripts.text:
[Cellette]
W-wait... You don't
have any money to pay
me for the soup you lost?
Well, I don't think I can
trust somebody like you
with any deliveries...
scripts.translation:
[塞萊特]
等...等等...你沒錢付你弄丟的湯的錢？
嗯，我覺得我不能信任像你這樣的人
去做任何配送...

scripts.text:
[Cellette]
Whoa, whoa, whoa!
You should have left
already to deliver that
soup to Maewan! Hurry,
before it gets too cold!
scripts.translation:
[塞萊特]
哇，哇，哇！
你應該已經出發去給梅萬送湯了！
快去吧，別讓它太涼了！

scripts.text:
[Cellette]
What's that? You lost
the Fish Cake Soup you're
supposed to give to Maewan?
Oh well, I suppose I'll have
to give you this fresh bowl
of soup that I just made...
scripts.translation:
[塞萊特]
什麼？你弄丟了應該送給梅萬的串湯？
好吧，我想我得把這碗我剛做好的新鮮湯給你...

scripts.text:
[Cellette]
But you need to be
responsible and pay
me for the food you lost.
There, I took 100 zeny
from you. That's fair, so
please don't lose it this time.
scripts.translation:
[塞萊特]
但你得負責任，
為你弄丟的食物付錢。
看，我從你那裡收了100 Zeny。
這很公平，所以這次別再弄丟了。

scripts.text:
[Cellette]
W-wait... You don't
have any money to pay
me for the soup you lost?
Well, I don't think I can
trust somebody like you
with any deliveries...
scripts.translation:
[塞萊特]
等...等等...你沒錢付你弄丟的湯的錢？
嗯，我覺得我不能信任像你這樣的人
去做任何配送...

scripts.text:
[Cellette]
I thought you left to
deliver that soup to
Layoma. You should hurry
and bring it to her, before
it doesn't taste good after
it gets cold, you know.
scripts.translation:
[塞萊特]
我以為你出發去給拉約瑪送湯了。
你應該趕緊送給她，
你知道的，湯涼了就不好喝了。

scripts.text:
[Cellette]
What's that? You lost
the Fish Cake Soup you're
supposed to give to Layoma?
Oh well, I suppose I'll have
to give you this fresh bowl
of soup that I just made...
scripts.translation:
[塞萊特]
什麼？你弄丟了應該送給拉約瑪的串湯？
好吧，我想我得把這碗我剛做好的新鮮湯給你...

scripts.text:
[Cellette]
But you need to be
responsible and pay
me for the food you lost.
There, I took 100 zeny
from you. That's fair, so
please don't lose it this time.
scripts.translation:
[塞萊特]
但你得負責任，
為你弄丟的食物付錢。
看，我從你那裡收了100 Zeny。
這很公平，所以這次別再弄丟了。

scripts.text:
[Cellette]
W-wait... You don't
have any money to pay
me for the soup you lost?
Well, I don't think I can
trust somebody like you
with any deliveries...
scripts.translation:
[塞萊特]
等...等等...你沒錢付你弄丟的湯的錢？
嗯，我覺得我不能信任像你這樣的人
去做任何配送...

scripts.text:
[Cellette]
Oh, dear, you better
leave now and deliver
that Fish Cake Soup to
Erjan before he can think
of something to complain about. Although it's probably too late...
scripts.translation:
[塞萊特]
哎呀，抱歉，
我不能和一個被證明不負責任的人做生意。
這不是針對你個人，只是我的規定。

scripts.text:
[Cellette]
What's that? You lost
the Fish Cake Soup you're
supposed to deliver to Erjan?
Oh well, I suppose I'll have
to give you this fresh bowl
of soup that I just made...
scripts.translation:
[塞萊特]
什麼？你弄丟了應該送給埃爾揚的串湯？
好吧，我想我得把這碗我剛做好的新鮮湯給你...

scripts.text:
[Cellette]
But you need to be
responsible and pay
me for the food you lost.
There, I took 100 zeny
from you. That's fair, so
please don't lose it this time.
scripts.translation:
[塞萊特]
但你得負責任，
為你弄丟的食物付錢。
看，我從你那裡收了100 Zeny。
這很公平，所以這次別再弄丟了。

scripts.text:
[Cellette]
W-wait... You don't
have any money to pay
me for the soup you lost?
Well, I don't think I can
trust somebody like you
with any deliveries...
scripts.translation:
[塞萊特]
等...等等...你沒錢付你弄丟的湯的錢？
嗯，我覺得我不能信任像你這樣的人
去做任何配送...

scripts.text:
[Cellette]
Ah, I'm sorry, but
I can't do any business
with somebody that's proven
to be irresponsible. Nothing
personal, it's just my policy.
scripts.translation:
[塞萊特]
幹得好！我聽說你成功送出了湯。
我就知道我可以信任你！啊，差點忘了，
這是你的串湯。非常感謝你的幫助~

scripts.text:
[Cellette]
Good work! I hear that
you successfully delivered
the soup. I knew I could trust
you! Ah, before I forget, here
is your Fish Cake Soup. Thank
you so much for your help~
scripts.translation:
[塞萊特]
和你合作真的很愉快，
希望你有空再來幫我。
哦，還有，請告訴所有朋友
我美味的串湯。回頭見~

scripts.text:
[Cellette]
It was really nice working
with you, and I hope you come
by and help me again sometime.
Oh, and please tell all your
friends about my delicious
Fish Cake Soup. See you later~
scripts.translation:
[塞萊特]
來嚐嚐正宗的毀葛料理吧！
享用一大碗熱氣騰騰的美味串湯~

scripts.text:
[Cellette]
Come and taste some
authentic Hugel cuisine!
Enjoy a big steaming bowl
of delicious Fish Cake Soup~
scripts.translation:
[內哈]
哦，你有塞萊特的送貨，嗯？哼！
你遲到了！你不知道這湯不熱的話就不好吃嗎？

scripts.text:
[Neha]
Oh, you have a delivery
from Cellette, hm? Hmpf!
You're late! Don't you know
this soup isn't good if it
isn't steaming hot?
scripts.translation:
[內哈]
哦，你是來送塞萊特的湯的，是嗎？哼！
你遲到了！難道你不知道湯不趁熱喝就不好喝嗎？

scripts.text:
[Neha]
But... You're a handsome
fellow, so I'll forgive you...
On one condition. Bring me
^FF00001 Whip^000000 with which to spank 
you. You better hurry, boy, or
I won't let you off that easy.
scripts.translation:
[內哈]
是的，是的...你應該受罰。
你應該被抽打。如果你想完成你的送貨，
那就給我帶^FF00001根鞭子^000000來，讓我抽你
以懲罰你的無禮，女孩！

scripts.text:
[Neha]
Yes, yes... You should
be punished. You should be
spanked. If you want to finish
your delivery, then bring me
^FF00001 Whip^000000 so that I can spank you
for your impertinence, girl!
scripts.translation:
[內哈]
是是是...你應該受到懲罰。
應該被打屁股才對。如果你想完成這次配送，
那就給我^FF00001根鞭子^000000，好讓我懲罰你的無禮，女孩！

scripts.text:
[Neha]
Oh ho ho ho ho ho~
I just love cute little boys...
But for some reason, it
thrills me to torture them
a little bit as well. Hoho~
scripts.translation:
[內哈]
哦呵呵呵呵呵~
我最喜歡可愛的小男孩了...
不過不知為何，稍微折磨他們一下
也讓我很興奮呢。呵呵~

scripts.text:
[Neha]
Finally... My soup!
And you brought me my Whip!
Don't worry, I'll only give you
just one hard spanking. It'll
be over before you know it~
scripts.translation:
[內哈]
終於...我的湯來了！
你還給我帶了鞭子！
別擔心，我只會狠狠打你一巴掌。
眨眼間就結束了~

scripts.text:
[Neha]
Ha!
scripts.translation:
[內哈]
哈！

scripts.text:
[Neha]
Heeyah!!
scripts.translation:
[內哈]
嘿呀！！

scripts.text:
[Neha]
Ooh, did I accidentally
whip you twice? Heh heh...
Well, I'm satisfied. I'll go
ahead and tell Celette that
you did a good job... I hope
you come deliver my soup again~
scripts.translation:
[內哈]
噢，我是不是不小心抽了你兩下？嘿嘿...
算了，我很滿意。我會告訴塞萊特你做得不錯...
希望下次還能收到你送的湯~

scripts.text:
[Neha]
^FF00001 Fish Cake Soup^000000...
^FF00001 Whip^000000... Is that too
much for a girl to ask?
I'm hungry, and I want to
hit somebody! What's wrong
with that, huh? Now hurry up!
scripts.translation:
[內哈]
^FF00001串湯^000000...
還有^FF00001鞭子^000000...這對一個女孩來說要求過分嗎？
我餓了，而且我想揍人！這有什麼不對嗎？快點！

scripts.text:
[Neha]
Oh ho ho ho ho ho~
I just love cute little boys...
But for some reason, it
thrills me to torture them
a little bit as well. Hoho~
scripts.translation:
[內哈]
哦呵呵呵呵呵~
我最喜歡可愛的小男孩了...
不過不知為何，稍微折磨他們一下
也讓我很興奮呢。呵呵~

scripts.text:
[Maewan]
Oh, finally, I've been
waiting for my order of
Fish Cake Soup from Cellette!
Aaaah, it smells oh so delicious~
scripts.translation:
[梅萬]
噢，終於來了，我訂的塞萊特的串湯！
啊，聞起來好香~

scripts.text:
[Maewan]
Argh, but you're late!
This is your fault, you
know that, right? Well,
it's not a big deal, but
I can forgive you if you
help me with my collection.
scripts.translation:
[梅萬]
啊，你遲到了！
你知道這是你的錯嗎？好吧，
雖然不是什麼大事，但如果你能幫我收集東西，
我就原諒你。

scripts.text:
[Maewan]
Just bring me
1 Bookclip in Memory,
alright? Oh, and don't
eat my soup before
you deliver it to me!
scripts.translation:
[梅萬]
給我帶1個回憶書籤，
好嗎？哦，還有，
在送給我之前別偷喝我的湯！

scripts.text:
[Maewan]
I like to think of
myself as a man of
eclectic taste. I love
collecting strange and
unique items, and learning
all sorts of new things~
scripts.translation:
[梅萬]
我覺得自己是個品味廣泛的人。我喜歡收集
奇怪又獨特的物品，也喜歡學習各種新知識~

scripts.text:
[Maewan]
Great, you really brought
me a Bookclip in Memory!
Yes, this'll make a fine
addition to my collection~
Oh, and give me my soup.
Thanks again for delivering~
scripts.translation:
[梅萬]
太好了，你真的給我帶了回憶書籤！
是的，這將是我收藏中很棒的補充~
哦，還有，把我的湯給我。
再次感謝你的配送~

scripts.text:
[Maewan]
I know it sounds unfair
of me to ask you to bring
^FF00001 Bookclip in Memory^000000 with
my ^FF0000Fish Cake Soup^000000, but well...
scripts.translation:
[梅萬]
我知道讓你在我的^FF0000串湯^000000之外
再帶^FF00001回憶書籤^000000聽起來有點不公平，但是...

scripts.text:
[Maewan]
I'd feel left out if
I didn't do it. I know
all of Cellette's other
customers are asking the
people delivering their soup
for all sorts of crazy things.
scripts.translation:
[梅萬]
如果我不這麼做，我會覺得自己被落下了。我知道
塞萊特的其他顧客都在讓送湯的人
帶各種奇怪的東西。

scripts.text:
[Maewan]
I like to think of
myself as a man of
eclectic taste. I love
collecting strange and
unique items, and learning
all sorts of new things~
scripts.translation:
[梅萬]
我覺得自己是個品味廣泛的人。我喜歡收集
奇怪又獨特的物品，也喜歡學習各種新知識~

scripts.text:
[Layoma]
You're here to deliver
my Fish Cake Soup?
How could you be so late?!
Don't you know that your
incompetence also reflects
on Cellette and her shop?!
scripts.translation:
[拉約瑪]
你是來送我的串湯的？
你怎麼能這麼晚？！
難道你不知道你的無能也會
反映在塞萊特和她的店鋪上嗎？！

scripts.text:
[Layoma]
I can't let you continue
delivering for Cellette
unless you prove that you're
dependable to me. Erm, bring
me ^FF00001 Mushroom Spore^000000, and
I'll forget this whole thing.
scripts.translation:
[拉約瑪]
除非你向我證明你是可靠的，否則我不能讓你
繼續為塞萊特送湯。嗯，給我帶
^FF00001香菇芽孢^000000，我就當這件事沒發生過。

scripts.text:
[Layoma]
I love singing songs,
and I love eating mushrooms.
For a person living in Hugel,
that's a pretty exciting life!
scripts.translation:
[拉約瑪]
我喜歡唱歌，也喜歡吃蘑菇。
對於一個住在毀葛的人來說，
這算是相當充實的生活了！

scripts.text:
[Layoma]
Great! You brought me
1 Mushroom Spore! This
will taste perfect with my
bowl of Fish Cake Soup~
scripts.translation:
[拉約瑪]
太好了！你給了我1個香菇芽孢！
這搭配我的串湯味道一定很棒~

scripts.text:
[Layoma]
Alright, maybe I can
count on you to work
for my roommate Cellette
a little while longer. Oh, and
please tell her to not to come home so late all the time, okay?
scripts.translation:
[拉約瑪]
好吧，也許我可以讓你再為我的室友塞萊特
工作一段時間。哦，還有，
請告訴她不要總是這麼晚回家，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Layoma]
Hey! I thought you
wanted to prove that
you're a reliable and
trustworthy person! Go
and bring me 1 Mushroom
Spore with my Fish Cake Soup!
scripts.translation:
[拉約瑪]
嘿！我以為你想證明
你是一個可靠且值得信賴的人！
去給我帶1個香菇芽孢
和我的串湯一起過來！

scripts.text:
[Layoma]
I love singing songs,
and I love eating mushrooms.
For a person living in Hugel,
that's a pretty exciting life!
scripts.translation:
[拉約瑪]
我喜歡唱歌，也喜歡吃蘑菇。
對於一個住在毀葛的人來說，
這算是相當充實的生活了！

scripts.text:
[Erjan]
Well, I thought you'd
never come to deliver
my Fish Cake Soup. You're
awfully late, you know that?
Still, the smell is just so appetizing, I can barely resist...
scripts.translation:
[埃爾揚]
我還以為你永遠不會
把我的串湯送過來呢。
你來得可真夠晚的，知道嗎？
不過，這香味真是誘人，
我幾乎忍不住要吃了...

scripts.text:
[Erjan]
Hm, but as the first son
of the Franchefeschu family,
I cannot eat this soup unless
it is suitably prepared. Go!
I command you to bring me
the commoner's ^FF0000China^000000!
scripts.translation:
[埃爾揚]
嗯，但作為法蘭切·費舒家族
的長子，如果餐具不體面，
我是不會喝這碗湯的。去吧！
我命令你去給我拿
平民用的^FF0000瓷器^000000來！

scripts.text:
[Erjan]
Realize that I'm compromising
with you by asking you to bring
me regular China... I always
enjoy my meals on the finest
glass and tableware available.
That's how we noblemen live~
scripts.translation:
[埃爾揚]
你要知道，我讓你拿普通的
瓷器，這已經是對你的一種
妥協了。我向來只使用
最精美的玻璃器皿和餐具
用餐。這才是貴族的生活~

scripts.text:
[Erjan]
I am Erjan, first son of
the noble Franchefeschu
family. Commoner, if you
do not have any business
with me, then leave me be,
and do whatever it is you do.
scripts.translation:
[埃爾揚]
我是埃爾揚，高貴的
法蘭切·費舒家族的長子。
平民，如果你沒有正事，
就請離開，去做你該做的事吧。

scripts.text:
[Erjan]
Ah, so you've delivered
my Fish Cake Soup with some
proper China. Yes, this pleases
me. Now, I may enjoy this meal
in a manner befitting the
Franchefeschu family.
scripts.translation:
[埃爾揚]
啊，看來你終於把
配有合適瓷器的串湯送來了。
很好，這讓我很滿意。
現在，我可以以符合
法蘭切·費舒家族身份的方式
享用這頓飯了。

scripts.text:
[Erjan]
Although this China is
below my standards, I also
understand that this is the
best you can do. Yes, to accept
this is my... noblesse oblige.
scripts.translation:
[埃爾揚]
雖然這瓷器
低於我的標準，
但我也理解這已經是
你能做到的極限了。
是的，接受它，是我的...
貴族義務。

scripts.text:
[Erjan]
You are dismissed.
Please take your leave,
and return to Cellette
with my noble thanks.
scripts.translation:
[埃爾揚]
你可以退下了。
請離開，並替我
向塞萊特轉達
我高貴的謝意。

scripts.text:
[Erjan]
Must I repeat myself?
Bring me my ^FF0000Fish Cake Soup^000000
with ^FF00001 China^000000 so that I may
properly enjoy my meal.
scripts.translation:
[埃爾揚]
需要我再說一遍嗎？
把我的^FF0000串湯^000000和
^FF00001個瓷器^000000拿來，
這樣我才能好好享用這頓飯。

scripts.text:
[Erjan]
I am Erjan, first son of
the noble Franchefeschu
family. Commoner, if you
do not have any business
with me, then leave me be,
and do whatever it is you do.
scripts.translation:
[埃爾揚]
我是埃爾揚，高貴的
法蘭切·費舒家族的長子。
平民，如果你沒有正事，
就請離開，去做你該做的事吧。

scripts.text:
[Euslan]
^333333*Cough Cough*
*Haaaaaaack*
*C-cough* *Sob*^000000

[Euslan]
^333333*Cough Cough*
*Haaaaaaack*
*C-cough* *Sob*^000000
Ignore
scripts.translation: 無視

scripts.text: Speak to Euslan
scripts.translation: 與尤斯蘭對話

scripts.text:
[Euslan]
^333333*Sniff*
*Huff Huff*
*Cough Cough*^000000

[Euslan]
*Huff Huff*
*Cough Cough*^000000
scripts.translation:
[尤斯蘭]
*呼哧呼哧*
*咳咳*^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFEusan is seized
with emotion: it's
been so long since
someone has tried
to speak to her.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF尤斯蘭情緒激動：
已經很久沒有人
試圖和她對話了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Euslan]
^333333*Sniff* *Cough
*Cough Cough*
*Sob* *Sniff*^000000
Ignore
scripts.translation: 無視

scripts.text: Speak to Euslan
scripts.translation: 與尤斯蘭對話

scripts.text:
[Euslan]
^333333*Sniff*
*Huff Huff*
*Cough Cough*^000000

[Euslan]
^333333*Sniff*
*Huff Huff*
*Cough Cough*^000000

[Euslan]
Oh...
Hello, wh-what
^333333*Cough cough*^000000 did
you want? ^333333*Sniff*^000000
Nothing!
scripts.translation: 沒什麼！

scripts.text: Are you alright?
scripts.translation: 你還好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Euslan]
Oh, I'm s-sorry...
^333333*Cough Cough*^000000 I must
have been mistaken...

[Euslan]
Th-thank you so much
for your concern. My
^333333*Cough*^000000 name is Euslan,
and it's nice to meet you.
scripts.translation:
[尤斯蘭]
謝...謝謝你關心。
我^333333*咳*^000000 叫尤斯蘭，
很高興認識你。

scripts.text:
[Euslan]
I've just been waiting here
for my fiancee to return, but
I'm starting to worry since
I haven't heard from him in
days. I really want to go out
and find him on my own. ^333333*Cough*^000000
scripts.translation:
[尤斯蘭]
我一直在這裡等我的未婚夫回來，
但好幾天沒收到他的訊息，
我開始擔心了。我真的很想
自己出去找他。 ^333333*咳*^000000

scripts.text:
[Euslan]
I really want to see my
Thierry. If only I wasn't
so sick, then I wouldn't have
these problems. ^333333*Sob*^000000 Where
is he? ^333333*Sniff*^000000 Where's my
Thierry? I want to see him...
scripts.translation:
[尤斯蘭]
我真的好想見我的
蒂埃裡。如果我不這麼病弱，
就不會有這些麻煩了。 ^333333*抽泣*^000000 他
在哪裡？ ^333333*吸鼻子*^000000 我的
蒂埃裡在哪裡？我想見他...

scripts.text: Leave her alone
scripts.translation: 讓她一個人待著

scripts.text: Offer to find Thierry
scripts.translation: 提議去找蒂埃裡

scripts.text:
[Euslan]
Thierry... ^333333*Sob*^000000
When are you
coming home?
I'm so worried...
^333333*Cough Cough*^000000

[Euslan]
...Are you really willing to
go out and look for Thierry
for me? Oh, thank you so
much! You don't know how
much your kind offer means
to me. Now, let's see...
scripts.translation:
[尤斯蘭]
...你真的願意
出去幫我找蒂埃裡嗎？
太感謝你了！你不知道
你的好意對我來說
有多重要。那麼，讓我想想...

scripts.text:
[Euslan]
^333333*Cough*^000000 Right, Thierry
went on a trip, traveling
on one of the Airships, to
find some medicine that the
doctors say I need for my
illness. ^333333*Cough Cough*^000000
scripts.translation:
[尤斯蘭]
^333333*咳*^000000 對了，蒂埃裡
為了給我找醫生說的
治療我病情的藥，
乘飛空艇出發了。 ^333333*咳咳*^000000

scripts.text:
[Euslan]
I know it's like searching
for a needle in a haystack,
but the only way I can think
of finding Thierry is to ask
the Airship Crewmen if they
might know where my fiancee is.
scripts.translation:
[尤斯蘭]
我知道這就像大海撈針，
但我能想到的唯一找到蒂埃裡的方法，
就是問問飛空艇的船員，
看他們是否知道我的未婚夫在哪裡。

scripts.text:
[Euslan]
^333333*Cough*^000000 Oh, right...
My fiancee was planning on
searching the Schwarzwald
Republic, so maybe the crewmen
on the Schwarzwald Republic domestic flights might know him.
scripts.translation:
[尤斯蘭]
^333333*咳*^000000 哦，對了...
我的未婚夫計劃去
修瓦魯茲巴魯德共和國，
所以也許修瓦魯茲巴魯德國內航線的
船員會認識他。

scripts.text:
[Euslan]
If you manage to find
where Thierry might have
gone, then please let me
know as soon as you can,
okay? Thanks for cheering
me up, {0}.
scripts.translation:
[尤斯蘭]
如果你能找到蒂埃裡
可能去的地方，
請儘快告訴我，好嗎？
謝謝你讓我振作起來，{0}。

如果你能找到蒂埃裡
