請儘快告訴我，好嗎？
謝謝你讓我振作起來，{0}。

scripts.text:
^333333Euslan is still patiently
waiting for Thierry's return.
You should keep your promise
to her by asking the crewmen on
the Schwaltvalt Republic domestic flights about Euslan's fiancee.^000000
scripts.translation:
^333333尤斯蘭仍在耐心地
等待蒂埃裡回來。
你應該信守承諾，
去詢問修瓦魯茲巴魯德國內航線的船員
關於尤斯蘭未婚夫的事。^000000

scripts.text:
[Euslan]
Oh, you're back!
^333333*Cough*^000000 Maybe it's too
much to hope for, but did
you learn anything about
where my fiancee might be?
scripts.translation:
[尤斯蘭]
哦，你回來了！
^333333*咳*^000000 也許是我
奢望了，但你有沒有
打聽到我未婚夫
可能在哪兒？

scripts.text: Well, I met Kaci on the Airship.
scripts.translation: 我在飛空艇上遇到了凱西。

scripts.text:
[Euslan]
Oh, Kaci works on the
Airship? It's been so long
since I've seen her. I guess
we've lost touch ever since
I've gotten sick... Still, I'm
glad to have heard from her.
scripts.translation:
[尤斯蘭]
哦，凱西在飛空艇上工作？
好久沒見她了。我想
自從我生病後就
失去聯絡了... 不過，
能聽到她的訊息真好。

scripts.text:
[Euslan]
Oh, how fortunate! So Kaci
knows where Thierry might be?
^333333*Cough*^000000 Ah, he went to Hugel.
I have a brother that lives
there, though it's been a while
since I've heard from him...
scripts.translation:
[尤斯蘭]
哦，真幸運！那凱西
知道蒂埃裡可能在哪兒？
^333333*咳*^000000 啊，他去了毀葛。
我有個哥哥住在那裡，
雖然好久沒聯絡他了...

scripts.text:
[Euslan]
Um, if you don't mind, would
you please do another favor
for me? If you travel to Hugel,
would you find Thierry and tell
that I'm alright? He must be
so worried about he by now...
scripts.translation:
[尤斯蘭]
那個，如果不麻煩的話，
能再幫我一個忙嗎？如果你去毀葛，
請找到蒂埃裡，告訴他我很好。
他現在一定很擔心我...

scripts.text:
[Euslan]
^333333*Cough Cough*^000000 It might
be a good idea to ask my
brother Eukran, who's working
as a Bingo game coordinator
in Hugel, since he might know
where Thierry is. ^333333*Cough*^000000
scripts.translation:
[尤斯蘭]
^333333*咳咳*^000000 也許可以問問
我的哥哥尤克蘭，他在毀葛
擔任賓果遊戲協調員，
他可能知道蒂埃裡在哪裡。 ^333333*咳*^000000

scripts.text:
[Euslan]
I know that it's a lot
to ask, so please don't
trouble yourself if it's out
of your way. Still, I'd really
appreciate your help if you
happen to pass through Hugel.
scripts.translation:
[尤斯蘭]
我知道這要求有點多，
如果太麻煩就別費心了。
不過，如果你正好經過毀葛，
我會非常感激你的幫助。

scripts.text:
[Euslan]
If you get the chance,
please visit my brother
Eukran in Hugel, and ask
him where my Thierry might be.
Thank you again for your kindness.
scripts.translation:
[尤斯蘭]
如果有機會，
請去毀葛拜訪我的哥哥尤克蘭，
問問他我的蒂埃裡可能在哪兒。
再次感謝你的好意。

scripts.text:
^3355FFEuslan is waiting for
you to bring her news from
her fiancee Thierry. You better
go back to Hugel to find him.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF尤斯蘭在等你
帶回來關於未婚夫蒂埃裡的訊息。
你最好回毀葛去找他。

scripts.text:
[Euslan]
Oh, you've returned!
^333333*Cough*^000000 Were you able to
speak to my brother and
find my fiancee Thierry?
scripts.translation:
[尤斯蘭]
哦，你回來了！
^333333*咳*^000000 你見到我哥哥了嗎？
找到我的未婚夫蒂埃裡了嗎？

scripts.text:
^333333You tell Euslan that you
were able to find Thierry,
and that he has managed to
procure some medicine for
her. You give Euslan the
medicine as Thierry requested.^000000
scripts.translation:
^333333你告訴尤斯蘭，
你找到了蒂埃裡，
而且他設法為她
弄到了藥。你按照蒂埃裡的要求
把藥交給了尤斯蘭。^000000

scripts.text:
[Euslan]
*Sniff* I don't deserve
such a wonderful man. Why
did that silly fool go through
so much trouble for a useless
woman like me. *Cough* I still don't understand it... I don't...
scripts.translation:
[尤斯蘭]
*吸鼻子* 我不配擁有這麼優秀的男人。
那個傻瓜為什麼要為一個像我這樣沒用的人
費這麼大的勁呢。*咳嗽* 我還是不明白... 我不...

scripts.text:
[Euslan]
Thank you so much for
your help, adventurer, and
for bringing me this medicine.
I'll be waiting for Thierry to
come back home, and do my
best to get better. ^333333*Cough*^000000
scripts.translation:
[尤斯蘭]
非常感謝你的幫助，冒險者，
還有你為我帶來的藥。
我會等蒂埃裡回家的，
並盡我所能好起來。^333333*咳嗽*^000000

scripts.text:
[Euslan]
{0}...
I'll never forget what
you've done for Thierry and
me. I'll always be praying for
your safety in your adventures.
Take care of yourself...
scripts.translation:
[尤斯蘭]
{0}...
我永遠不會忘記你為蒂埃裡和我所做的一切。
我會一直為你在冒險中的平安祈禱。
請保重...

scripts.text:
^3355FFEuslan is still waiting
for her fiancee to return
home, but she appears
much more relieved and
relaxed than she used to be.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF尤斯蘭仍在等待未婚夫回家，
但她看起來比之前
更加安心和放鬆了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Arcade Owner]
Welcome to the
Bingo Game Arcade.
Would you like to
play a game?
scripts.translation:
[遊戲廳老闆]
歡迎來到賓果遊戲廳。
你想玩一局嗎？

scripts.text: I want to meet the game coordinator.
scripts.translation: 我想見見遊戲協調員。

scripts.text:
[Arcade Owner]
I'm sorry, but if he's on
duty, we can't really let you
meet him unless you come
here to play a game. Our
game coordinators tend
to be pretty busy...
scripts.translation:
[遊戲廳老闆]
很抱歉，如果他在值班，
除非你來玩遊戲，否則我們真的
不能讓你見他。我們的
遊戲協調員通常都很忙...

scripts.text:
[Eukran]
Oh, weren't you just
in the bingo room?
I hope you enjoyed
the game. Now, can
I help you with anything?
scripts.translation:
[尤克蘭]
哦，你剛才不是
在賓果遊戲室嗎？
希望你玩得開心。那麼，
有什麼我可以幫你的嗎？

scripts.text: Talk about Euslan
scripts.translation: 談談尤斯蘭

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou tell Eukran about his
sister's illness, and that
she has sent you to search
for her fiancee Thierry.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你告訴尤克蘭他妹妹的病情，
以及她派你去尋找
她的未婚夫蒂埃裡。^000000

scripts.text:
[Eukran]
*Sob* I had no idea
that my sister Euslan
was so sick! No wonder
Thierry looked so depressed
the last time I saw him. Why
didn't he tell me anything?
scripts.translation:
[尤克蘭]
*抽泣* 我完全不知道
我妹妹尤斯蘭病得這麼重！
難怪上次見到蒂埃裡時
他看起來那麼沮喪。他為什麼
什麼都不告訴我？

scripts.text:
[Eukran]
You see, Thierry passed by
here about a month ago, and
told me that he had to visit
the Odin Shrine. I wasn't
sure then, but now I think
he's trying to help my sister.
scripts.translation:
[尤克蘭]
你看，蒂埃裡大約一個月前
路過這裡，
告訴我他必須去拜訪奧丁神龕。
當時我不太確定，但現在我覺得
他是在試圖幫助我妹妹。

scripts.text:
[Eukran]
There must be something
there that can help my
sister recover. Why else
would Thierry go to such a
dangerous place? No one goes to the Odin Shrine for no reason.
scripts.translation:
[尤克蘭]
那裡一定有什麼
能幫助我妹妹康復的東西。
否則蒂埃裡為什麼要去
那麼危險的地方？沒有人會無緣無故
去奧丁神龕的。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou can hear two
people talking to
each other a short
distance away.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你能聽到不遠處
兩個人在交談。^000000

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
You sure your research
is progressing? I haven't
seen anything that even
resembles real results!
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
你確定你的研究
有進展嗎？我還沒看到
任何像樣的結果！

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
I'm telling you, this isn't
like the last project. There's
no other way around it, it's
going to take some time.
You just have to be patient...
scripts.translation:
[年輕男子]
我告訴你，這不像
上一個專案。沒有其他捷徑，
這需要一些時間。
你只能耐心等待...

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
Fine. That's fine by me.
But what about your fiancee?
I know she's near death's door:
can you really afford to wait
this long? Think about it.
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
好吧。這對我沒問題。
但你的未婚妻呢？
我知道她命懸一線：
你真的能等這麼久嗎？想想吧。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
Just finish this as
soon as you can. For
your fiancee's sake.
And your own sake.
Catch my meaning?
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
儘快完成它。
為了你的未婚妻。
也為了你自己。
明白我的意思嗎？

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
...I understand.
scripts.translation:
[年輕男子]
...我明白了。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou hear the sound of
footsteps steadily becoming
fainter and fainter. One of the
men must be walking away.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你聽到腳步聲逐漸變得微弱，
其中一個人正走遠了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
Hm? Oh, an adventurer.
There's more and more
of you coming to visit this
Odin Shrine nowadays.
scripts.translation:
[年輕男子]
嗯？哦，是位冒險者。
最近來這座奧丁神龕參觀的
人越來越多了。

scripts.text: Mr. Thierry?
scripts.translation: 蒂埃裡先生？

scripts.text:
[Thierry]
...?!
H-how do you
know my name?
Do I know you
from somewhere?
scripts.translation:
[蒂埃裡]
...？！
你...你怎麼知道我的名字？
我認識你嗎？

scripts.text: Tell him about Euslan
scripts.translation: 告訴他尤斯蘭的事

scripts.text:
[Thierry]
Oh, Euslan sent you to me?
I'm so sorry that you had to
go through so much trouble.
Still, I'm glad to hear from her. Please let her know that I'm
coming home soon, would you?
scripts.translation:
[蒂埃裡]
哦，是尤斯蘭派你來的？
真抱歉讓你費心了。
不過聽到她的訊息我很高興。
請告訴她我很快就回家，好嗎？

scripts.text: What are you doing here?
scripts.translation: 你來這裡做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Thierry]
Well, um, I'm sorry.
I can't really go into the
details, but I'm doing this
work to find a cure for
Euslan's disease. It's not
curable by modern medicine...
scripts.translation:
[蒂埃裡]
嗯，抱歉。
我不能透露太多細節，
但我做這份工作是為了尋找
尤斯蘭疾病的治癒方法。
現代醫學無法治癒它...

scripts.text:
[Thierry]
I can't tell you more
than that. Please just
trust me on this. In the
meantime, would you tell
Euslan that I should be
coming home very soon?
scripts.translation:
[蒂埃裡]
我無法告訴你更多。
請相信我。在此期間，
你能告訴尤斯蘭我很快就會
回家嗎？

scripts.text:
[Thierry]
Oh, I thought you
already left Odin Shrine.
You don't have anything 
else to tell me, do you?
scripts.translation:
[蒂埃裡]
哦，我以為你已經離開
奧丁神龕了。
你沒有什麼別的事要告訴我
吧？

scripts.text: Warn Thierry about Suspicious Men
scripts.translation: 警告蒂埃裡關於可疑男子

scripts.text:
[Thierry]
What?! It's just what
I thought! They were just
using me this whole time...!
Still, I can't leave this
place just yet... I can't...
scripts.translation:
[蒂埃裡]
什麼？！正是我想的！
他們一直在利用我...！
但我現在還不能離開這裡... 我不能...

scripts.text:
[Thierry]
I guess it all started when
Euslan contracted that weird
disease. None of the doctors
knew what it was, none of them
could do anything about it.
It was totally devastating...
scripts.translation:
[蒂埃裡]
我想一切始於尤斯蘭
患上那種奇怪的疾病。
醫生們都不知道那是什麼，
誰也沒辦法。
那真是毀滅性的打擊...

scripts.text:
[Thierry]
Finally, I took her to see
Mawong, who told us that he
actually met someone that had
that disease, and that there
was a way for me to cure it.
I had to take my chances...
scripts.translation:
[蒂埃裡]
最後，我帶她去找了毛翁，
他說他遇到過患有這種病的人，
並且有辦法治癒它。
我只能賭一把...

scripts.text:
[Thierry]
Mawong told me that the cure
was somewhere near the Odin
Shrine in Hugel. As you already
know, this place is incredibly
dangerous. But I don't care.
I'll do anything for Euslan.
scripts.translation:
[蒂埃裡]
毛翁告訴我，治癒方法
在毀葛的奧丁神龕附近。
如你所知，這個地方極其危險。
但我不在乎。
為了尤斯蘭，我什麼都願意做。

scripts.text:
[Thierry]
Of course, I only told Euslan
that I'd be looking around the
Schwarzwald Republic... If she
knew I was at the Odin Shrine,
she'd worry too much about me.
scripts.translation:
[蒂埃裡]
當然，我只告訴尤斯蘭
我在修瓦魯茲巴魯德共和國
附近尋找... 如果她知道我在
奧丁神龕，她會過度擔心我。

scripts.text:
[Thierry]
Once I got here, I didn't
know what to do, or what I was
even looking for. Then, I ran
into these strange men, and
told them my story out of my
frustration over my situation.
scripts.translation:
[蒂埃裡]
來到這裡後，我不知道該做什麼，
甚至不知道我在找什麼。
然後，我遇到了那些奇怪的男子，
出於對處境的沮喪，我告訴了他們我的故事。

scripts.text:
[Thierry]
It seemed like a miracle
when they said that they knew
how to cure Euslan. They told
me that they were a research
team working on a project
related to my dilemna.
scripts.translation:
[蒂埃裡]
當他們說知道如何治癒尤斯蘭時，
這似乎是個奇蹟。他們告訴我
他們是一個研究團隊，正在從事
與我的困境相關的專案。

scripts.text:
[Thierry]
I didn't even think twice
about it: I immediately
accepted their offer to
join them. I did whatever
research they asked while
I searched for Euslan's cure...
scripts.translation:
[蒂埃裡]
我甚至沒有多想：我立即
接受了他們的邀請加入他們。
我做了他們要求的所有研究，
同時尋找尤斯蘭的治癒方法...

scripts.text:
[Thierry]
Later, I overheard them
talking, and I learned that
they were really Rekenber
Corporation agents. Their
project had nothing to do
with medicine or my Euslan...
scripts.translation:
[蒂埃裡]
後來，我偷聽到他們的談話，
發現他們其實是雷肯貝爾公司的
特工。他們的專案與醫學或我的
尤斯蘭毫無關係...

scripts.text:
[Thierry]
Their true goal is to improve
their guardian technology by
finding the remains of some
giant beneath the Odin Shrine.
Still, working with them gave
me access to so many resources.
scripts.translation:
[蒂埃裡]
他們的真正目標是通過尋找
奧丁神龕下某個巨人的遺骸來
改進他們的守衛技術。
儘管如此，與他們合作讓我
獲得了大量資源。

scripts.text:
[Thierry]
I've actually been able to
find a cure for Euslan's
illness through my research
with those men, so I can't
quit now. I still need to make
that medicine for Euslan!
scripts.translation:
[蒂埃裡]
實際上，通過與那些人的研究，
我已經找到了尤斯蘭疾病的治癒方法，
所以我不能現在放棄。
我仍然需要為尤斯蘭製作那種藥！

scripts.text:
[Thierry]
So, behind their backs, I've
been using their guardians to
gather the ingredients needed
for my fiancee's medicine. But
if they're planning to get rid of me, I've just run out of time.
scripts.translation:
[蒂埃裡]
所以，在他們背後，我一直在利用他們的守衛
來收集我未婚妻藥物所需的材料。
但如果他們打算除掉我，
我的時間已經不多了。

scripts.text:
[Thierry]
It doesn't matter what
happens to me, but I must
save Euslan. I only need
^FF00005 Runes of the Darkness^000000 to
finish that medicine. Please
help me get them, adventurer...
scripts.translation:
[蒂埃裡]
無論發生什麼，我都必須拯救尤斯蘭。
我只需要^FF00005個黑暗符文^000000
來完成那種藥。
請幫我拿到它們，冒險者...

scripts.text:
[Thierry]
You're the only one I can
trust to save Euslan. In the
meantime, I'll be hiding from
those men right over here.
If they get me, I'll never be
able to make the medicine!
scripts.translation:
[蒂埃裡]
你是唯一能讓我信任去拯救尤斯蘭的人。
在此期間，我會躲在這裡，
避開那些男人。
如果他們抓到我，我就永遠無法制作那種藥了！

scripts.text:
[Thierry]
I understand that gathering
materials here in the Odin
Shrine is difficult, but try to
get me ^3355FF5 Runes of the Darkness^000000
as soon as you can. My Euslan
really needs that medicine...
scripts.translation:
[蒂埃裡]
我理解在奧丁神龕這裡收集材料很困難，
但請儘量快一點給我^3355FF5個黑暗符文^000000。
我的尤斯蘭真的很需要那種藥...

scripts.text:
[Thierry]
Oh! You really brought me
the Runes of the Darkness!
I can finally make the medicine
that will save my dear Euslan.
I... I can't thank you enough
for this. I'm so happy...
scripts.translation:
[蒂埃裡]
哦！你真的給我帶來了黑暗符文！
我終於可以製作拯救我親愛的尤斯蘭的藥了。
我...我感激不盡。
我太高興了...

scripts.text:
[Thierry]
Please give me a moment:
I want to make this right
away. Let's see, ah, here
are my research notes...
scripts.translation:
[蒂埃裡]
請給我一點時間：
我想馬上製作。讓我看看，啊，
這是我的研究日誌...

scripts.text:
[Thierry]
It's finally done. This
medicine will cure Euslan.
If you'd do one last thing
for me, please bring this to
her. I've got to sneak away
later after things calm down.
scripts.translation:
[蒂埃裡]
終於完成了。這種藥能治癒尤斯蘭。
如果你能再幫我最後一件事，
請把這個帶給她。
等事情平息後，我必須偷偷離開。

scripts.text:
[Thierry]
Please understand that
I want to see her as soon
as I can, but I have to wait
until those Rekenber agents
stop searching for me. And let
Eslan know I'll come home soon.
scripts.translation:
[蒂埃裡]
請理解，我想盡快見到她，
但我必須等到那些雷肯貝爾特工
停止尋找我。並告訴尤斯蘭
我會很快回家。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou received the
medicine that Thierry
has made to give to Euslan.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你收到了蒂埃裡製作的
給尤斯蘭的藥。^000000

scripts.text:
[Thierry]
Please give that
medicine to Euslan as
soon as you can: her life
depends on it. Please let
her know that I'm coming
home as soon as I can.
scripts.translation:
[蒂埃裡]
請儘快把那種藥給尤斯蘭：
她的生命取決於它。請告訴她
我會盡快回家。

scripts.text:
[Researcher]
I'm sorry, Euslan...
Please just wait for
me a little while longer.
I swear I'll come home to you!
scripts.translation:
[研究員]
對不起，尤斯蘭...
請再等我一會兒。
我發誓我會回家找你！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou hear the voice of
the suspicious man that
was speaking to Thierry
a little while ago. You
carefully listen to what
he is saying...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你聽到了剛才與蒂埃裡說話的那個
可疑男子的聲音。你仔細傾聽
他在說什麼...^000000

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
Thierry seems to have
caught on to what we're
really up to. I think that's why he's slowing down on his
research. We better get rid
of him before it's too late.
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
蒂埃裡似乎已經察覺到我們
真正在做什麼。我想這就是他
研究進度變慢的原因。我們最好在
為時已晚之前除掉他。

scripts.text:
[Very Suspicious Man]
Sure. Just let me
know when you
want him dead.
Then I'll kill him.
No problem.
scripts.translation:
[非常可疑的男子]
當然。只要告訴我
你想讓他死的時候。
然後我會殺了他。
沒問題。

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis isn't good!
Thierry's in danger, so
you better go tell him
about this right now!^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF情況不妙！
蒂埃裡處於危險之中，所以你最好
馬上告訴他這件事！^000000

scripts.text:
[Kurupe]
Could Burupu be hiding
from me again? He's been
wanting to ditch work more
and more ever since he wanted
to become a Swordman. If only
I could hire someone else...
scripts.translation:
[庫魯佩]
布魯普是不是又在躲著我？
自從他想成為劍士以來，
他就越來越想逃避工作。要是
我能僱到別人就好了...

scripts.text:
[Kurupe]
Unfortunately, he's the
only one I can find that
can actually milk my cow,
Booboo! If you can find
Burupu for me, I'll be sure
to pay you for your effort.
scripts.translation:
[庫魯佩]
不幸的是，他是唯一能
給我的奶牛布布擠奶的人。
如果你能幫我找到布魯普，
我一定會為你的努力支付報酬。

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 當然。

scripts.text: Sorry, I'm busy.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我很忙。

scripts.text:
[Kurupe]
Thank you, you're a
lifesaver! I need to get the
milk delivered by tomorrow,
so I really need Burupu back!
You should be able to find him
somewhere just outside of town.
scripts.translation:
[庫魯佩]
謝謝你，你真是救星！我需要
在明天之前把牛奶送出去，
所以我真的很需要布魯普回來！
你應該能在鎮外找到他。

scripts.text:
[Kurupe]
N-no...!
If I can't find
Burupu, then there's no
way I'd be able to deliver
the milk orders by tomorrow!
Great, what am I gonna do?
scripts.translation:
[庫魯佩]
不...！
如果我找不到布魯普，
我就無法在明天之前交付牛奶訂單！
天哪，我該怎麼辦？

scripts.text:
[Kurupe]
Burupu, I need you
to come to work! Maybe
you can find him practicing
with his sword right outside
of town. I hope you can find
that lazy guy for me...
scripts.translation:
[庫魯佩]
布魯普，我需要你來上班！
也許你能在鎮外找到他，
他可能正在那裡練習劍術。
希望你能幫我找到那個懶鬼...

scripts.text:
[Kurupe]
Burupu is making demands?!
I guess I don't have a choice.
You wouldn't happen to know
how much Rapiers cost, do you?
Why does Burupu want to become
a Swordman so much, huh?
scripts.translation:
[庫魯佩]
布魯普竟然提要求了？！
看來我別無選擇。
你知道刺劍要多少錢嗎？
布魯普為什麼那麼想成為劍士呢？

scripts.text:
[Kurupe]
Oh, you're going to
help me milk the cow?
Great, great, thanks so
much! Please milk Booboo
right away, and get me
some delicious milk~
scripts.translation:
[庫魯佩]
哦，你要幫我給奶牛擠奶？
太好了，太感謝了！
請立刻給布布擠奶，
給我弄些美味的牛奶~

scripts.text:
[Kurupe]
Hmm, how about this?
If you can actually milk
Booboo the cow, then I'll
give you some food. Does
that sound fair? Anyway,
please get to work soon~
scripts.translation:
[庫魯佩]
嗯，這樣如何？
如果你能給布布擠奶，
我就給你一些食物。
這樣公平吧？總之，
請快點開始工作~

scripts.text:
[Kurupe]
Great! Now that you've
milked Booboo, I can go
and make my deliveries
tomorrow! Here's a little
something to eat as my way
of saying, ''Thanks a lot~''
scripts.translation:
[庫魯佩]
太好了！既然你幫布布擠了奶，
我明天就可以去送貨了！
這裡有一點吃的，
算是我對你說的“非常感謝~”

scripts.text:
[Kurupe]
Wait a minute!
Currently you are carrying
too many items with you.
Please come back again
after you store some items into kafra storage.
scripts.translation:
[庫魯佩]
等一下！
你身上攜帶的物品太多了。
請先去卡普拉倉庫存放一些物品，
然後再回來。

scripts.text:
[Kurupe]
I always need
someone to help me
milk Booboo, especially
when Burupu doesn't feel
like doing it, so please come
by and help me when you can~
scripts.translation:
[庫魯佩]
我總是需要有人幫我給布布擠奶，
尤其是當布魯普不想幹活的時候，
所以請在你方便的時候來幫我~

scripts.text:
[Kurupe]
Oh, it's you again!
Did you want to help me
out by milking Booboo the
cow? I can always use a
dependable person like you.
scripts.translation:
[庫魯佩]
哦，又是你！
你是想幫我給布布擠奶嗎？
我隨時都需要像你這樣可靠的人。

scripts.text: Sure, I'll milk Booboo.
scripts.translation: 好的，我來給布布擠奶。

scripts.text: What'll pay me this time?
scripts.translation: 這次給我什麼報酬？

scripts.text: Nah, just dropping by.
scripts.translation: 不，只是順便來看看。

scripts.text:
[Kurupe]
Great, great! If you want
to milk Booboo, first tell
Burupu that he doesn't need
to come in today, and then
come back to me. Then, I'll
let you milk Booboo the cow.
scripts.translation:
[庫魯佩]
太好了，太好了！如果你想給布布擠奶，
先告訴布魯普他今天不用來上班，
然後再回來找我。然後，
我就讓你給布布擠奶。

scripts.text:
[Kurupe]
Let's see...
Milk Booboo for me this
time, and I'll randomly
choose one of the following
sets of rewards to give you.
scripts.translation:
[庫魯佩]
讓我看看...
這次你幫布布擠奶，
我會從以下獎勵中隨機
選擇一組給你。

scripts.text:
1 set of 5 Milk,
1 set of 3 Honey,
1 set of 5 Orange Potions,
1 set of Yellow Potions, or
1 Bundle of Food. Hmmm...
That sounds fair, right?
scripts.translation:
1組5瓶牛奶，
1組3瓶蜂蜜，
1組5瓶赤色藥水，
1組黃色藥水，或者
1個食物保鮮袋。嗯...
這樣聽起來很公平，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Kurupe]
Ahahahah, it's good
to see you! Now, don't
be a stranger, alright?
Burupu could learn a
couple things from you...
scripts.translation:
[庫魯佩]
哈哈，見到你真好！
別見外，好嗎？
布魯普可以從你身上
學到很多東西...

scripts.text:
[Kurupe]
For now, go talk
to Burupu and let him
know that he doesn't need
to come into work today~
scripts.translation:
[庫魯佩]
現在，去和布魯普談談，
告訴他今天不用來上班~

scripts.text:
[Kurupe]
Ah, you spoke to
Burupu already? Good,
now would you please
milk Booboo the cow?
Thanks once again~
scripts.translation:
[庫魯佩]
啊，你已經和布魯普談過了？
很好，那麼請幫我給布布擠奶好嗎？
再次感謝~

scripts.text:
[Kurupe]
Please go and milk
Booboo the cow as
soon as you can, okay?
scripts.translation:
[庫魯佩]
請儘快去給布布擠奶，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kurupe]
Ah, you've done a good
job of milking Booboo the
cow for me. Let's see, let's
see, what would be good to
give you as payment. Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[庫魯佩]
啊，你幫布布擠奶的工作做得很好。
讓我想想，讓我想想，
給你什麼作為報酬比較好呢。嗯...

scripts.text:
[Kurupe]
You know what?
Why don't you have
some Milk? It's only
fitting, after all. Besides,
it's really good for you!
Thanks again for your help~
scripts.translation:
[庫魯佩]
你知道嗎？
不如你喝點牛奶吧？
畢竟很合適。而且，
它對你身體真的很好！
再次感謝你的幫助~

scripts.text:
[Kurupe]
Wait a minute!
Currently you are carrying
too many items with you.
Please come back again
after you store some items into kafra storage.
scripts.translation:
[庫魯佩]
等一下！
你身上攜帶的物品太多了。
請先去卡普拉倉庫存放一些物品，
然後再回來。

scripts.text:
[Kurupe]
Ah, I've got it!
You like Orange Potions,
right? Come on, you looove
Orange Potions! Here, you can
have a bunch as my way of saying thanks for milking Booboo the cow~
scripts.translation:
[庫魯佩]
啊，我想到了！
你喜歡赤色藥水，對吧？
沒錯，你肯定超愛赤色藥水！
來，給你一大把，
就當是我感謝你幫布布擠奶的謝禮~

scripts.text:
[Kurupe]
Wait a minute!
Currently you are carrying
too many items with you.
Please come back again
after you store some items into kafra storage.
scripts.translation:
[庫魯佩]
等一下！
你身上攜帶的物品太多了。
請先去卡普拉倉庫存放一些物品，
然後再回來。

scripts.text:
[Kurupe]
Oooh, I could give you
some Yellow Potions, Yes,
that's a good idea. Please
take these Yellow Potions
as a token of my gratitude
for milking old Booboo.
scripts.translation:
[庫魯佩]
噢，我可以給你一些黃色藥水，
對，這是個好主意。
請收下這些黃色藥水，
作為我感謝你幫老布布擠奶的心意。

scripts.text:
[Kurupe]
Wait a minute!
Currently you are carrying
too many items with you.
Please come back again
after you store some items into kafra storage.
scripts.translation:
[庫魯佩]
等一下！
你身上攜帶的物品太多了。
請先去卡普拉倉庫存放一些物品，
然後再回來。

scripts.text:
[Kurupe]
Hey, why don't you
take some fresh Honey?
Yes, it's sweet, delicious,
it's everything you could
ever want! Thanks for
milking Booboo for me~
scripts.translation:
[庫魯佩]
嘿，你要不要嚐嚐新鮮的蜂蜜？
對，它又甜又美味，
是你想要的一切！
謝謝你幫我給布布擠奶~

scripts.text:
[Kurupe]
Wait a minute!
Currently you are carrying
too many items with you.
Please come back again
after you store some items into kafra storage.
scripts.translation:
[庫魯佩]
等一下！
你身上攜帶的物品太多了。
請先去卡普拉倉庫存放一些物品，
然後再回來。

scripts.text:
[Kurupe]
Here, why don't you
have some of this really
delicious food? I don't
remember what I packed in
here, but I'm sure it tastes
good, and it's good for you~
scripts.translation:
[庫魯佩]
來，嚐嚐這個特別好吃的食物吧？
我不記得我裝的是什麼了，
但肯定很好吃，而且對你身體有益~

scripts.text:
[Kurupe]
Wait a minute!
Currently you are carrying
too many items with you.
Please come back again
after you store some items into kafra storage.
scripts.translation:
[庫魯佩]
等一下！
你身上攜帶的物品太多了。
請先去卡普拉倉庫存放一些物品，
然後再回來。

scripts.text:
[Kurupe]
Aww, nuts...!
I've got so many
Milk deliveries to do
tomorrow, but what can
I do without any Milk?!
scripts.translation:
[庫魯佩]
哎呀，糟糕...
明天我有好多牛奶要送，
但沒有牛奶我該怎麼辦啊？！

scripts.text:
[Kurupe]
Oh no, what am I gonna
do?! I need to deliver the
milk tomorrow, but Burupu
still hasn't arrived yet!
scripts.translation:
[庫魯佩]
天哪，我該怎麼辦？！
明天要送牛奶，
但布魯普還沒到！

scripts.text:
[Kurupe]
When is he coming
to work? Burupu,
where are you?!
scripts.translation:
[庫魯佩]
他什麼時候來上班？
布魯普，你在哪裡？！

scripts.text:
[Kurupe]
Why hasn't Burupu
arrived yet? If he
doesn't come soon,
how will I get the milk
delivered by tomorrow?
scripts.translation:
[庫魯佩]
布魯普怎麼還沒到？
如果他再不快點來，
我明天怎麼把牛奶送出去？

scripts.text:
[Burupu]
What? Kurupe wants me
to come in to work again?
Man, does it look like I want
to milk Booboo all my life?
Forget that, I'm gonna be
a Swordman! Tally-hoooe!
scripts.translation:
[布魯普]
什麼？庫魯佩想讓我再去上班？
拜託，難道我想一輩子給布布擠奶嗎？
算了吧，我要當劍士！
出發咯！

scripts.text:
[Burupu]
Yeah, ever since that
Airship landed in our
town, and I saw all those
Swordmen, I knew it'd be
my destiny! Forget ranching, I'm gonna wield a frickin' sword!
scripts.translation:
[布魯普]
是啊，自從那艘飛空艇降落在我們城鎮，
我看到那些劍士後，
我就知道這是我的命運！
別管放牧了，我要去揮舞一把像樣的劍！

scripts.text:
[Burupu]
Hey, that equipment of
yours looks plenty expensive.
I think I'll need something
like that if I wanna become
a Swordman. Hey, I know
how we can help each other~
scripts.translation:
[布魯普]
嘿，你那套裝備看起來挺貴的。
我覺得想當劍士的話，我也需要那樣的東西。
嘿，我知道我們怎麼互相幫助了~

scripts.text:
[Burupu]
I'll help you with milking
Booboo the cow if you can get
me some proper Swordman
equipment. Let's see... Why not
give me 1 Rapier with 2 Slots? That's not too much to ask, right?
scripts.translation:
[布魯普]
如果你能給我弄一套像樣的劍士裝備，
我就幫你給布布擠奶。
讓我想想...不如給我一把帶2個槽位的細劍？
這要求不過分吧？

scripts.text: Alright.
scripts.translation: 好的。

scripts.text: Whoa, that's too much!
scripts.translation: 太貴了！

scripts.text:
[Burupu]
I'm glad you agree~
Okay then, try to bring
me a Rapier with 2 Slots
as soon as you can! I can't
wait to start training with it!
scripts.translation:
[布魯普]
很高興你同意了~
那麼，請儘快給我弄一把帶2個槽位的細劍！
我都等不及要開始用它訓練了！

scripts.text:
[Burupu]
You think so...?
Well, it's the only
thing I can think of
that I really want...
scripts.translation:
[布魯普]
你覺得是嗎...？
嗯，這是我能想到的
我真正想要的唯一東西了...

scripts.text:
[Burupu]
Hey, weren't you
supposed to bring me
a Rapier with 2 Slots?
If you want me to milk
Booboo the cow, then keep
your end of our bargain~
scripts.translation:
[布魯普]
嘿，你不是應該給我帶一把帶2個槽位的細劍嗎？
如果你想讓我給布布擠奶，
那就履行我們的約定~

scripts.text:
[Burupu]
Oh, wow...!
That's such a beautiful
Rapier! Look, it's got
2 Slots and everything!
I'm gonna start training
with it right now!
scripts.translation:
[布魯普]
噢，哇...
這把細劍真漂亮！
看，它還有2個槽位呢！
我要馬上開始用它訓練！

scripts.text:
[Burupu]
You know what?
I've changed my mind.
Screw milking that dumb cow!
Still, a Swordman is supposed
to keep his promises, huh?
Okay then, how about this?
scripts.translation:
[布魯普]
你知道嗎？
我改變主意了。
去給那頭蠢牛擠奶吧！
不過，劍士總得信守承諾，對吧？
好吧，那這樣如何？

scripts.text:
[Burupu]
I hid my secret instructions
for milking Booboo the cow
under the ground just northeast
of her. Read them carefully, and you should be able to milk her
yourself. You can do it, right?
scripts.translation:
[布魯普]
我把給布布擠奶的秘訣
藏在她東北方向的地下了。
仔細讀一讀，你應該就能自己給她擠奶了。
你能做到的，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Burupu]
Anyway, don't forget
to find and read those
instructions. Oh, and
thanks again for the Rapier~
scripts.translation:
[布魯普]
總之，別忘了去找並閱讀那些說明。
哦，還有，再次感謝你的細劍~

scripts.text:
[Burupu]
Hmm? You wanna milk
Booboo today? Great,
that means I've got more
time to work on my fencing.
All right, now I can focus
completely on my training!
scripts.translation:
[布魯普]
嗯？你今天想給布布擠奶？太好了，
這樣我就有更多時間練習擊劍了。
好，現在我可以專心訓練了！

scripts.text:
[Burupu]
I'm gonna become the
best Swordman in the
world! But first, I gotta
learn how to use this thing!
Heeeeee-YAH! How's that? That was almost a Magnum Break, right?
scripts.translation:
[布魯普]
我要成為世界上最好的劍士！
但首先，我得學會怎麼用它！
嘿——呀！怎麼樣？剛才那招差點就是怒爆了吧？

scripts.text:
[Burupu]
Heeeyah!
Yaaaaaaaah!
Wh-whooooooosh!
scripts.translation:
[布魯普]
嘿呀！
呀——！
呼——！

scripts.text:
[Burupu]
Crap! Why do I have
to have such a crappy
sword?! I mean, I'm getting
tired of making all my own
whooshing sounds and effects.
scripts.translation:
[布魯普]
該死！為什麼我用的劍這麼爛？！
我是說，我自己發出那些呼呼聲和特效，我都聽膩了。

scripts.text:
[Burupu]
Heeeyah!
Yaaaaaaaah!
Yeeeeeeeyoooop!
scripts.translation:
[布魯普]
嘿呀！
呀——！
耶——！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou've found a small^000000
^3355FFnotebook on the ground.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你在地上發現了一本^000000
^3355FF小筆記本。^000000

scripts.text:
^804000This small notebook^000000
^804000contains Burupu's detailed^000000
^804000instructions for milking^000000
^804000Booboo the cow. Although^000000
^804000it is written by hand, it^000000
^804000is very well organized.^000000

[Table of Contents]
 
Chapter 1: How to Milk Booboo
Chapter 2: How to Treat Booboo
Chapter 3: Before You Begin
scripts.translation:
[目錄]
 
第一章：如何給布布擠奶
第二章：如何照顧布布
第三章：開始之前

scripts.text: Chapter 1
scripts.translation: 第一章

scripts.text: Chapter 2
scripts.translation: 第二章

scripts.text: Chapter 3
scripts.translation: 第三章

scripts.text:
[Chapter 1]
Booboo is a very emotionally
sensitive cow that expresses
herself through the power of
song. You must listen to her
song, determine how she feels,
and then comb her just right.
scripts.translation:
[第一章]
布布是一頭情感非常敏感的奶牛，
她通過歌聲來表達自己。
你必須傾聽她的歌聲，
判斷她的情緒，
然後恰到好處地梳理她的毛髮。

scripts.text:
[Chapter 1]
Basically, depending on
how Booboo feels, you must
give her the number of brush
strokes that correspond to
her song. I'll explain more
about that in Chapter 2.
scripts.translation:
[第一章]
基本上，根據布布的情緒，
你需要梳理與她歌聲對應的次數。
我會在第二章詳細解釋這一點。

scripts.text:
[Chapter 2 Contents]
 
Part 1: How to Respond to
Booboo the Cow's Feelings
Part 2: Booboo's Songs
scripts.translation:
[第二章目錄]
 
第一節：如何回應布布的情緒
第二節：布布的歌聲

scripts.text: Part 1
scripts.translation: 第一節

scripts.text: Part 2
scripts.translation: 第二節

scripts.text:
[Chapter 2, Part 1]
Booboo the Cow usually
expresses five different
feelings through her songs:
these are joy, sadness, anger,
love, and neutral contentment.
scripts.translation:
[第二章 第一節]
布布通常通過歌聲表達五種不同的情緒：
分別是喜悅、悲傷、憤怒、
愛意，以及平靜的滿足感。

scripts.text:
[Chapter 2, Part 1]
^800080She is so happy^000000!
When Booboo the Cow
feels joy, then you go
ahead and brush her
hair 3 times before
you can milk her.
^800080 3 times^000000.
scripts.translation:
[第二章 第一節]
^800080她很開心^000000！
當布布感到喜悅時，
你需要先梳理她的毛髮3次，
然後才能擠奶。
^800080 3次^000000。

scripts.text:
[Chapter 2, Part 1]
^800080She is as usual^000000.
When she feels so-so, you need to
comb her hair ^800080 5 times^000000.
scripts.translation:
[第二章 第一節]
^800080她情緒平常^000000。
當她感覺一般時，
你需要梳理她的毛髮^800080 5次^000000。

scripts.text:
[Chapter 2, Part 1]
If Booboo the cow feels
sad, then you need to make
her feel more loved. How
do you do this? Just brush
her hair at least 10 times.
scripts.translation:
[第二章 第一節]
如果布布感到悲傷，
你需要讓她感到被關愛。
該怎麼做呢？
只需梳理她的毛髮至少10次。

scripts.text:
[Chapter 2, Part 1]
Now, remember that when
Booboo the cow is angry,
you shouldn't touch her
at all. Just say, ''No!'' to
brushing her hair, okay?
scripts.translation:
[第二章 第一節]
請記住，當布布感到憤怒時，
你絕對不要觸碰她。
選擇“不”來拒絕梳理她的毛髮，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Chapter 2, Part 1]
If you happen to see
Booboo the cow in love,
then just brush her hair
once. Just look for the
hearts, and you'll know
that she's in love, okay?
scripts.translation:
[第二章 第一節]
如果你看到布布處於戀愛中，
只需梳理她的毛髮1次。
只要看到愛心，你就知道她正在戀愛，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Chapter 2, Part 1]
Whenever Booboo the
cow is just feeling
neutral contentment,
then just brush her
5 times. That's all~
scripts.translation:
[第二章 第一節]
當布布感到平靜的滿足時，
只需梳理她的毛髮5次。
就是這樣~

scripts.text:
[Chapter 2, Part 2]
Booboo the cow will
always sing this song.
Keep these sounds in
mind when she sings them...
scripts.translation:
[第二章 第二節]
布布總是會唱這首歌。
當她唱這些聲音時，請牢記在心...

scripts.text:
^ff0000Brr~ Brrbrr~ Boobooboo~^000000
^0000ffBrrrrrr~ Booboo~ Boorrboo~^000000
^ff0000Booruboorubrr~ Rrrrboo~^000000
^0000ffRrrr~ Booboorrrr~ Boobooru~^000000
^ff0000Boobooboo~ Rururu~ Booruboorub~^000000
^0000ffBoo! B! Boo~^000000
scripts.translation:
^ff0000Brr~ Brrbrr~ Boobooboo~^000000
^0000ffBrrrrrr~ Booboo~ Boorrboo~^000000
^ff0000Booruboorubrr~ Rrrrboo~^000000
^0000ffRrrr~ Booboorrrr~ Boobooru~^000000
^ff0000Boobooboo~ Rururu~ Booruboorub~^000000
^0000ffBoo! B! Boo~^000000

scripts.text:
[Chapter 2, Part 2]
When you try to milk
Booboo, she will sing this
song with a slight difference.
Look for the difference in
Booboo's song, and then
hum the correct word to her.
scripts.translation:
[第二章 第二節]
當你嘗試給布布擠奶時，
她會唱一首略有不同的歌。
找出布布歌聲中的不同之處，
然後向她哼唱正確的詞。

scripts.text:
[Chapter 3]
If you want to milk
Booboo the cow, you
must first get permission
from Kurupe. You will also
need 3 Concentration Potions
to insert into Booboo's comb.
scripts.translation:
[第三章]
如果你想給布布擠奶，
必須先從庫魯佩那裡獲得許可。
你還需要3瓶集中藥水，
插入布布的梳子中。

scripts.text:
[Booboo]
Boop boop boo~
Booboo Boop boo!
scripts.translation:
[布布]
Boop boop boo~
Booboo Boop boo!

scripts.text:
^804000It seems that
Booboo the cow
has something that
she wants to tell you.^000000
scripts.translation:
^804000看起來布布
有話想告訴你。^000000

scripts.text: Attempt to Milk Booboo
scripts.translation: 嘗試給布布擠奶

scripts.text: It's not the right time!
scripts.translation: 現在不是時候！

scripts.text:
^3355FFTo use this comb to
brush Booboo the cow,
you will need to insert
3 Concentration Potions.
You can only brush Booboo
with this luxurious magic comb.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF要使用這把梳子梳理布布，
你需要插入3瓶集中藥水。
你只能用這把奢華的魔法梳子梳理布布。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFMaybe you should learn more
about Booboo the cow, and
get more information before
you can attempt to milk her.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF也許你應該多瞭解一些關於布布的事情，
在嘗試給她擠奶之前獲取更多資訊。^000000

scripts.text:
[Booboo]
Booo~Boooo!!
Boobooboo Booo~~~
Booboo Boop~
scripts.translation:
[布布]
Booo~Boooo!!
Boobooboo Booo~~~
Booboo Boop~

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis giant magic comb was
specially ordered from Geffen's
Magic Academy. It is designed
to operate after inserting
3 Concentration Potions
into its special slots.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這把巨大的魔法梳子
是專門從吉芬魔法學院訂購的。
它被設計為在插入3瓶集中藥水
到其特殊插槽後執行。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFOnce you place your
3 Concentration Potions
into the comb, it begins
to chime, and Booboo the
cow beings to express her^FFFFFF ^3355FF feelings in the center of Hugel.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF一旦你將3瓶集中藥水
放入梳子中，它開始發出鈴聲，
布布開始在毀葛中心表達她的^FFFFFF ^3355FF 情緒。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFNow it's time for you
to brush Booboo the cow.
Depending on her mood,
you need to brush her a
certain number of times.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF現在是你梳理布布的時候了。
根據她的心情，
你需要梳理她一定次數。^000000

and is singing a serenade.^000000
scripts.translation:

^3355FFHurry, respond to Booboo's song! Look for the word that is slightly
different than Booboo's normal
song in Burupu's notes, and then tell her the correct world without
the tilde character (''~'').^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF快一點，回應布布的歌！在布魯普的筆記中，找出那個與布布平時歌聲略有不同的詞，然後告訴她正確的詞（不要帶波浪號“~”）。^000000

scripts.text:

is quite happy, and
you were able to milk
her. Now, you should
report to Kurupe.^000000
scripts.translation:
