布布看起來非常開心，
你成功擠出了牛奶。
現在，你應該去彙報給庫魯佩。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFUh oh...
Booboo the cow is starting
to snort violently! She seems
pretty angry with you, so you
better get away for now...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF糟糕...
布布開始劇烈地噴鼻息了！
她似乎對你很生氣，
你最好先離開這裡...^000000

scripts.text:
**Recruitment Notice**
 
We are now hiring recruits
for the Odin Shrine Expedition.
 
- Shrine Expedition Dept.
scripts.translation:
**招募公告**
 
我們正在招募奧丁神龕探險隊的成員。
 
- 神龕探險部

scripts.text:
**Recruitment Notice**
 
Join our magician
community, and make
all your days a festival!
 
- Hugel Magician Community
scripts.translation:
**招募公告**
 
加入我們的魔法師社群，
讓每一天都成為節日！
 
- 毀葛魔法師社群

scripts.text:
[Alex]
Whatever you're
trying to sell me,
I'm not interested!
Now get out of here!
scripts.translation:
[亞歷克斯]
不管你想賣給我什麼，
我都不感興趣！
現在給我滾出去！

scripts.text:
[Alex]
Huh...?
What do you want?
scripts.translation:
[亞歷克斯]
嗯...？
你想要什麼？

scripts.text: Excuse me...
scripts.translation: 打擾一下...

scripts.text: I saw the recruitment notice and...
scripts.translation: 我看到了招募公告...

scripts.text:
[Alex]
Whatever you're
trying to sell me,
I'm not interested!
Now get out of here!
scripts.translation:
[亞歷克斯]
不管你想賣給我什麼，
我都不感興趣！
現在給我滾出去！

scripts.text:
[Alex]
Oh, so you saw the
recruitment notice for the
Odin Shrine Expedition, eh?
Hmmm... Alright, you look
like you're strong enough.
Yeah, I think you qualify.
scripts.translation:
[亞歷克斯]
哦，你是看到了奧丁神龕探險隊的招募公告啊？
嗯...好吧，你看起來足夠強壯。
是的，我認為你符合條件。

scripts.text:
[Alex]
Oh, so you saw the
recruitment notice for the
Odin Shrine Expedition, eh?
Well, I dunno. I think that
kind of expedition would
eat you alive. No offense...
scripts.translation:
[亞歷克斯]
哦，你是看到了奧丁神龕探險隊的招募公告啊？
嗯，我不知道。我覺得那種探險會把你吃掉的。別介意...

scripts.text:
[Alex]
Look, I'll reconsider
whether you qualify after
you get train a little more,
develop your skills, you know,
get stronger. For now, though,
I don't think we can use you.
scripts.translation:
[亞歷克斯]
聽著，等你再訓練一下，
提升一下技能，你知道的，
變得更強壯之後，我會重新考慮你是否符合條件。
但現在，我覺得我們還用不上你。

scripts.text:
[Alex]
I'm Alex Helmut, and I'm
in charge of the expedition.
See that guy over there? That's
my younger brother Julian who's
also working on the excavation.
scripts.translation:
[亞歷克斯]
我是亞歷克斯·赫爾穆特，
負責這次探險。
看到那邊那個人了嗎？那是
我的弟弟朱利安，他也在參與挖掘工作。

scripts.text:
[Alex]
Our main goal in this
excavation is to retrieve
some extremely valuable
item inside the shrine. However, it's too dangerous to go in there
if you're not strong enough.
scripts.translation:
[亞歷克斯]
我們這次挖掘的主要目標是
取回神龕內部一件極其珍貴的物品。
但是，如果你不夠強壯，
進去太危險了。

scripts.text:
[Alex]
Anyway, if you'd like to
help us, please take a look
around the shrine and see
if you'd want to work for us.
Please talk to the Boatman
to travel to the shrine, okay?
scripts.translation:
[亞歷克斯]
總之，如果你想幫我們的忙，
請先去神龕周圍看看，
考慮一下是否願意為我們工作。
請去找船伕，讓他帶你過去，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Alex]
You really oughtta
check out the shrine
for yourself first. Just talk
to the Boatman so that
he take you over there.
scripts.translation:
[亞歷克斯]
你真的應該先親自去看看神龕。
只要找船伕，
讓他帶你過去就行了。

scripts.text:
[Alex]
Oh, so you've gone
and seen the shrine
already. So will you help
us in our expedition?
scripts.translation:
[亞歷克斯]
哦，看來你已經
去過神龕了。那麼，
你願意參加我們的探險嗎？

scripts.text: Who are the people in the next room?
scripts.translation: 隔壁房間裡的人是誰？

scripts.text: Well...
Yes, I do.
scripts.translation: 有的，我有。

scripts.text:
[Alex]
Oh... Them.
They're officially my
co-workers, but quite
frankly, they were forced
upon me by the Rune-Midgarts
Kingdom. It can't be helped...
scripts.translation:
[亞歷克斯]
哦...他們。
名義上是我的同事，
但說實話，他們是盧恩·米德加茲王國
強塞給我的。我也沒辦法...

scripts.text:
[Alex]
Anyway, I have to accept
them to help international
relations or something silly
like that. They say they're here to research religious relics,
but I just don't trust them.
scripts.translation:
[亞歷克斯]
總之，為了維護國際關係之類的
無聊理由，我不得不接受他們。
他們說是來研究宗教聖物的，
但我就是不信。

scripts.text:
[Alex]
In fact, I think it's
obvious that they're here
for something else, though
I'm not sure what it may be.
And that gray haired lady...
She totally creeps me out!
scripts.translation:
[亞歷克斯]
事實上，我覺得很明顯
他們另有目的，
雖然我不確定具體是什麼。
還有那個灰髮女士...
她讓我渾身不自在！

scripts.text:
[Alex]
Yeah, well, I know
it might be a tough
decision to make. Well,
take your time. I understand
that you have to weigh the
risks and everything.
scripts.translation:
[亞歷克斯]
是啊，我知道
這可能很難決定。嗯，
慢慢來。我理解
你需要權衡風險之類的。

scripts.text:
[Alex]
Great! In that case, your
first assignment is to bring
me ^3355FF5 Runes of the Darkness^000000
from the shrine. Don't worry,
I'll make sure that you're
rewarded for your efforts.
scripts.translation:
[亞歷克斯]
太好了！既然如此，
你的第一個任務是去神龕
給我帶^3355FF5 5個黑暗符文^000000回來。
別擔心，
我會確保給你相應的報酬。

scripts.text:
[Alex]
This is your chance
to show me that your
dependability and sense
of responsibility. Then,
we can move on to the
more important stuff.
scripts.translation:
[亞歷克斯]
這是你向我證明
你的可靠性和責任感的機會。
然後，
我們才能進入更重要的環節。

scripts.text:
[Alex]
What are you still
doing here? Shouldn't
you be headed to the
shrine already?
scripts.translation:
[亞歷克斯]
你還在這裡幹什麼？
你不應該已經去神龕了嗎？

scripts.text: What was I supposed to gather?
scripts.translation: 我本來要收集什麼？

scripts.text: I'm leaving, I'm leaving!
scripts.translation: 我走了，我走了！

scripts.text:
[Alex]
You've forgotten
already? I asked you
to bring me ^3355FF5 Runes
of the Darkness^000000. Okay,
now hurry up and get to it.
scripts.translation:
[亞歷克斯]
你忘了？我讓你
給我帶^3355FF5 5個黑暗符文^000000回來。好了，
快去快回。

scripts.text:
[Alex]
That's fine...
Just keep in mind that
we're running behind
schedule. If only that
grey haired crone wasn't
here... We'd be done by now!
scripts.translation:
[亞歷克斯]
那好吧...
請記住，我們的進度
已經落後了。要是那個
灰髮老太婆不在就好了...
我們現在早就完工了！

scripts.text:
[Alex]
Well, it's about
time you came back.
So did you bring me
^3355FF5 Runes of the Darkness^000000?
scripts.translation:
[亞歷克斯]
嗯，你終於回來了。
那麼，你帶^3355FF5 5個黑暗符文^000000回來了嗎？

scripts.text: Er, not yet...
scripts.translation: 呃，還沒有...

scripts.text: There you go!
scripts.translation: 給你！

scripts.text:
[Alex]
Wh-what?!
You came here just to
tell me that? Come back
when you're done and
don't waste my time!
scripts.translation:
[亞歷克斯]
什-什麼？！
你跑來這裡就為了告訴我這個？
等你辦完事再來，
別浪費我的時間！

scripts.text:
[Julian]
Hey, you know what,
Alex? You can't push
people around like that.
Besides, this adventurer
isn't a pushover, you know?
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
嘿，亞歷克斯，你知道嗎？
你不能這樣對人呼來喝去的。
而且，這位冒險者
可不是好欺負的，你知道嗎？

scripts.text:
[Alex]
What was that...?
Are you trying to
make me mad, Julian?
scripts.translation:
[亞歷克斯]
你剛才說什麼...？
朱利安，你是想惹我生氣嗎？

scripts.text:
[Julian]
All I'm saying is that
most adventurers know that
you can't pay them what they're
worth. That's why so many of
them are going in and out
of the other room, you know.
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
我只是想說，大多數冒險者都知道，
你給不起他們應得的報酬。
所以才會有那麼多人
在那間屋子裡進進出出，你知道嗎。

scripts.text:
[Alex]
That... grey... haired...!
N-no... Calm down, Alex...
Lose your head, you lose
everything... D-don't stoop
down to her level.
scripts.translation:
[亞歷克斯]
那個...灰頭髮的女人...！
不...不...冷靜點，亞歷克斯...
一旦失去理智，就會失去一切...
不...不要降格到和她一樣的水平。

scripts.text:
[Alex]
Alright, I'm not in any
position to make demands
of you... But I would really
appreciate it if you would
bring me 5 Runes of the
Darkness as soon as possible.
scripts.translation:
[亞歷克斯]
好吧，我現在也沒資格對你提要求...
但如果你能儘快
給我帶來5個黑暗符文，
我會非常感激的。

scripts.text:
[Alex]
Oh! Thank you
so much, I'm sure
these Runes will help
us in our research. I know
this isn't much, but please
accept this Old Blue Box.
scripts.translation:
[亞歷克斯]
哦！非常感謝，
我相信這些符文
會對我們的研究有幫助。
雖然這不算什麼，
但請收下這個神秘箱子。

scripts.text:
[Julian]
Wait...
Research?
Since when did
you do research?
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
等等...
研究？
你什麼時候
開始做研究了？

scripts.text:
[Alex]
Gosh, Julian,
will you just
shut up for a bit?
scripts.translation:
[亞歷克斯]
天哪，朱利安，
你能不能
閉嘴一會兒？

scripts.text:
[Julian]
Why? I'm the one who
does all the grunt work
and actual research.
You think you're so
big just ''supervising...''
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
為什麼？明明是我
在做所有的粗活和實際研究。
你以為自己
只是“監督”就很了不起嗎...

scripts.text:
[Alex]
J-Julian!
scripts.translation:
[亞歷克斯]
朱-朱利安！

scripts.text:
[Julian]
Right, right, we've
got a visitor. Yeah,
okay, sorry about that.
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
好了好了，
有客人在。對，
好的，抱歉剛才失態了。

scripts.text:
[Alex]
I'm sorry about all
this. If you don't mind,
we'll continue our research
and hopefully finish our
project soon. Thanks once
again for all of your help.
scripts.translation:
[亞歷克斯]
很抱歉剛才的失態。
如果不介意的話，
我們會繼續研究，
希望能儘快完成專案。
再次感謝你的幫助。

scripts.text:
[Alex]
Hm? Oh, this isn't
enough Runes of the
Darkness. I asked you
to bring me 5 of them...
scripts.translation:
[亞歷克斯]
嗯？哦，黑暗符文
不夠。我讓你帶5個來...

scripts.text:
[Alex]
...Darn it! I think I might
have miscalculated. Maybe
I really do need more of
these. What am I gonna do?
And what is that grey haired
crone thinking? Hmmmm...
scripts.translation:
[亞歷克斯]
...該死！我可能
算錯了。也許我確實
需要更多這些。我該怎麼辦？
還有那個灰頭髮的老太婆在想什麼？
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Alex]
O-Oh! I had no idea that
you were there! Y-you
didn't hear anything
s-strange, did you?
Hahahahahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[亞歷克斯]
哦-哦！我不知道
你在那裡！你...你
沒有聽到什麼奇怪的話吧？
哈哈哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Alex]
Excuse me?
The grey haired crone
offered you a part time
job, but won't pay you?
scripts.translation:
[亞歷克斯]
你說什麼？
那個灰頭髮的老太婆
給你提供了一份兼職，
卻不付你錢？

scripts.text:
[Alex]
She's really shameless!
We don't have much to pay
volunteers, but we should
at least give them something!
How can she do this?! Oh, er,
let me introduce myself first.
scripts.translation:
[亞歷克斯]
她真是一點廉恥都沒有！
我們雖然沒什麼錢付給志願者，
但至少要給點東西吧！
她怎麼能這樣？哦，那個，
讓我先自我介紹一下。

scripts.text:
[Alex]
I'm Alex Helmut, and I'm
in charge of the expedition.
See that guy over there? That's
my younger brother Julian who's
also working on the excavation.
scripts.translation:
[亞歷克斯]
我是亞歷克斯·赫爾穆特，
負責這次探險。
看到那邊那個人了嗎？那是
我的弟弟朱利安，他也在參與挖掘工作。

scripts.text:
[Alex]
As supervisor of this
operation, I'm ashamed to
say that the excavation is
proceeding behind schedule.
If only that grey haired crone
in the next room weren't here!
scripts.translation:
[亞歷克斯]
作為這次行動的監督，
我很慚愧地承認，
挖掘工作已經落後於計劃了。
要是隔壁那個灰頭髮的老太婆
不在這裡就好了！

scripts.text:
[Alex]
I can't work with
her at all! She's
manipulative, greedy,
selfish, and two faced!
There's got to be another
reason why she's here...!
scripts.translation:
[亞歷克斯]
我完全無法和她共事！
她心機深沉、貪婪、
自私，而且兩面三刀！
她來這裡肯定還有別的原因...！

scripts.text:
[Alex]
Hm? Did you need
something? I'm sorry,
but I can't help you
right now. I'm pretty
busy, so I just want to
be left alone for a while.
scripts.translation:
[亞歷克斯]
嗯？你需要什麼嗎？
抱歉，我現在幫不了你。
我很忙，所以想
一個人靜一靜。

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Hm? What are you doing
here? Ashe, Ashe! Get
this person out of here!
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
嗯？你在這裡做什麼？
阿什，阿什！
把這個人趕出去！

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Hm? Oh, you must be
here in response to our
recruitment notice, yes?
Let me take a look at you...
Oh, you're all skin and bone!
I can't use someone like you.
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
嗯？哦，你一定是看到我們的招募告示才來的吧？
讓我看看你...
哎呀，你瘦得只剩皮包骨了！
我可不能用你這樣的人。

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Hm? Oh, you must be
here in response to our
recruitment notice, yes?
I'm Laura Laurence, the
Rune-Midgarts Kingdom rep
for the Odin Shrine Expedition.
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
嗯？哦，你一定是看到我們的招募告示才來的吧？
我是勞拉·勞倫斯，
盧恩·米德加茲王國在奧丁神龕探險隊的代表。

scripts.text:
[Laura]
My assistant, Ashe
Milton, is right over
there. Say, 'Hello,' Ashe.
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
我的助手阿什·米爾頓就在那邊。
阿什，打個招呼吧。

scripts.text:
[Ashe]
Hello!
scripts.translation:
[阿什]
你好！

scripts.text:
[Laura]
As you may already know,
we're here to uncover relics
from the Odin Shrine. However,
the shrine is infested with
powerful creatures that a weak
woman like me can never defeat.
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
你可能已經知道了，
我們在這裡是為了發掘奧丁神龕的遺物。然而，
神龕裡充斥著強大的生物，
像我這樣柔弱的女子是絕對無法戰勝它們的。

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Would you let a poor
fragile woman like me go
in there alone? Someone like
you must go in there for me.
Hence, the recruitment notice.
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
你會讓像我這樣柔弱的女子
獨自進去嗎？像你這樣的人
必須替我進去。所以，才有了招募告示。

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Now, we can't actually pay
you for your work. In fact,
we have absolutely nothing to
give you. But you'd be doing
a great service your country,
the Rune-Midgarts' Kingdom.
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
現在，我們實際上無法支付你的報酬。
事實上，我們沒有任何東西可以給你。
但你將為你的國家，
盧恩·米德加茲王國，做出巨大的貢獻。

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Think about it!
You'd be making a great
contribution, helping us
learn more about the age
when the gods showed
themselves to humans!
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
想想看！
你將做出巨大的貢獻，
幫助我們瞭解眾神
向人類顯現的那個時代！

scripts.text: Nah, forget it.
scripts.translation: 不了，算了

scripts.text: Yes, I'll do it!
scripts.translation: 是的，我答應！

scripts.text:
[Laura]
W-Wait! Think about
the importance of learning
about the age of gods! If you
don't help us, then who will?
We need to work together to
build a better future, right?
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
等-等等！想想了解神代的重要性！
如果你不幫助我們，那誰來做？
我們需要共同努力，
建設更美好的未來，對吧？

scripts.text: But you can't pay me.
scripts.translation: 但你付不起錢。

scripts.text: Alright, I'll do it.
scripts.translation: 好吧，我答應。

scripts.text:
[Laura]
You're right.
It's like I said
before. I don't have
anything to pay you.
...............................

[Laura]
Curses! If this project had
more funding, we'd have more
than a cheesy recruitment ad,
and some professional staff
like those rich Schwarzwald
Republic boys in the next room!
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
該死！如果這個專案有更多資金，
我們就不止有一張廉價的招募廣告，
還有像隔壁修瓦魯茲巴魯德共和國那些
有錢的男孩一樣的專業職員了！

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Fine, it's your choice
whether you want to work
for us. I'm just disappointed
that someone like you won't
help us. I mean, don't you
have any patriotism at all?
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
好吧，是否為我們工作由你決定。
我只是很失望，像你這樣的人
不幫助我們。我是說，你難道
一點愛國心都沒有嗎？

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Perfect! Now, you first
you need to go to the shrine
and survey the area for your
own benefit. Talk to the Boatman, and he'll take you there, okay?
Hurry up and come back soon!
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
太好了！現在，你首先
需要去神龕，為了你自己的利益
勘察一下區域。去找船伕，他會帶你去，好嗎？
快點去，快點回來！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me, but
what are you guys
doing over here?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
打擾一下，
你們在這裡做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Laura]
What are we doing...?
This is the shrine expedition
office. You know, we're doing
research on the artifacts found
in the Odin Shrine on behalf
of the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom.
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
我們在做什麼...？
這是神龕探險辦公室。你知道的，我們代表
盧恩·米德加茲王國，
研究在奧丁神龕發現的文物。

scripts.text: About Alex and Julian
scripts.translation: 關於亞歷克斯和朱利安

scripts.text: Alright, now I understand.
scripts.translation: 好的，我現在明白了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
These people in the other
room, Alex and Julian, are
they also working in this same
expedition in the Odin Shrine?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
隔壁房間的那些人，亞歷克斯和朱利安，
他們也是在這個奧丁神龕的探險隊裡工作嗎？

scripts.text:
[Laura]
...Oh. You must be working
for those rich Schwaltvalt
Republic kids. I can't work
with that impudent girl, at
all, so we're actually working
in separate offices.
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
...哦。你一定是為那些富有的修瓦魯茲巴魯德共和國的人工作的吧。
我完全無法和那個傲慢無禮的女孩共事，
所以我們實際上是在不同的辦公室工作的。

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Sorry, let me introduce
myself. I'm Laura Laurence,
the leader of the Odin Shrine
expedition for the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom. Ashe Milton is my
assistant for this excavation.
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
抱歉，讓我自我介紹一下。我是勞拉·勞倫斯，
代表盧恩·米德加茲王國領導奧丁神龕探險隊的首領。
阿什·米爾頓是我這次發掘工作的助手。

scripts.text:
[Ashe]
Hello!
scripts.translation:
[阿什]
你好！

scripts.text:
[Laura]
If you'd rather do
a service for your
country and quit working
for those wealthy snobs, then
come back here and let me know.
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
如果你寧願為你的國家服務，
並辭去為那些富家闊少工作，
那就回到這裡告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Hey, I know you...
You're a volunteer for the
other office's expedition,
right? Your timing couldn't
be more perfect. Why don't
you help us for a while?
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
嘿，我認識你...
你是另一間辦公室探險隊的志願者，
對吧？你的時機再好不過了。你為什麼不暫時幫幫我們呢？

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Basically, I want you
to spy on that snobby girl,
Alex of the Schwarzwald
Republic office, and report
what she's actually doing to me.
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
基本上，我想讓你去監視那個傲慢的女孩，
修瓦魯茲巴魯德共和國辦公室的亞歷克斯，
並向我彙報她實際上在做什麼。

scripts.text:
[Laura]
I have to know...
I need to know whether
they discovered ''that thing''
already. They can't have found
it before us. It's impossible!
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
我必須知道...
我需要知道他們是否已經發現了“那個東西”。
他們不可能在我們之前找到它。這是不可能的！

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Anyway, just eavesdrop
on the Schwaltvalt Office
by putting your ear really
close to the door, and listen
to them talk. Will you do that?
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
總之，只要把耳朵緊緊貼在門上，
偷聽修瓦魯茲巴魯德辦公室的人說話，
聽聽他們在說什麼。你願意這麼做嗎？

scripts.text:
[Laura]
...............................
Of course, you're
going to do it. Right?

[Laura]
RIGHT?!
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
對吧？！

scripts.text: Yeah, yeah, whatever.
scripts.translation: 是，是，隨便吧。

scripts.text: Sure thing.
scripts.translation: 沒問題。

scripts.text: I s-s-s-suppose...!
scripts.translation: 我...我想...好吧！

scripts.text: Yes, Ma'am!
scripts.translation: 遵命，女士！

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Good.
Now do it!
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
很好。
現在去做吧！

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Ask the Boatman to take
you to the Odin Shrine so
that you can actually see it
for yourself. If you don't think you can handle the expedition,
then you can just let me know.
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
讓船伕帶你去奧丁神龕，
這樣你就可以親眼看看了。
如果你覺得無法勝任這次探險，
那就直接告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Have you been to the
Odin Shrine already?
I know it's scary, but we
need to finish our research
for the good of mankind.
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
你已經去過奧丁神龕了嗎？
我知道那裡很可怕，但為了人類的福祉，
我們必須完成我們的研究。

scripts.text: Yeah, yeah, whatever.
scripts.translation: 是，是，隨便吧。

scripts.text: I see.
scripts.translation: 我明白了。

scripts.text: You're right, Ma'am.
scripts.translation: 您說得對，女士。

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Well, then.
Did you happen to
find anything while
you were there?
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
那麼。
你在那裡有沒有碰巧發現什麼？

scripts.text: Jellopies.
scripts.translation: 果凍派。

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Laura]
You can freakin' find
Jellopy anywhere! I meant,
did you find anything special
while you were at the shrine!
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
傑勒比結晶哪裡都找得到！我是說，你在神龕那裡有沒有發現什麼特別的東西！

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Well, that's fine.
I did tell you to just
take a look around, so
I didn't expect you to
bring me anything.
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
好吧，沒關係。
我本來只是讓你去那裡看看，
所以也沒指望你能帶什麼東西回來。

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Anyway, are you still willing
to help us? I know that I said
that we can't pay you, but to
be fair, I can offer you something from my special collection.
How does that sound?
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
總之，你還願意幫我們嗎？我知道我說過我們付不起報酬，但為了公平起見，我可以從我的私人收藏中拿一樣東西給你。
你覺得怎麼樣？

scripts.text: Who are the guys in the other room?
scripts.translation: 隔壁房間的那些人是誰？

scripts.text: Well...
Yes!
scripts.translation: 準備好了！

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Oh, those are the
Schwarzwald Republic
representatives for this
Odin Shrine expedition.
Personally, I think they're
just a bunch of rich phonies.
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
哦，那些是修瓦魯茲巴魯德共和國派來參加這次奧丁神龕考察的代表。
就我個人而言，我覺得他們只是一群裝腔作勢的有錢人。

scripts.text:
[Laura]
And that Alex girl...
She may seem polite,
but she's always giving
these dirty looks, and
greets me with a fake
smile. I hate her!
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
還有那個叫亞歷克斯的女孩...
她表面上看起來很禮貌，
但總是用那種輕蔑的眼神看我，
還對我假笑。我討厭她！

scripts.text:
[Ashe]
Ms. Laurence...!
Stop it, please!
It's embarassing to
hear you talk about
a colleague like that.
scripts.translation:
[阿什]
勞倫斯小姐...！
請別這樣了！
聽你這樣談論同事，
真的很讓人尷尬。

scripts.text:
[Laura]
C-colleague?! No way!
I despise that spoiled brat,
and she doesn't deserve the
position that her rich daddy
probably bought for her! Grrr!
Come back later, I'm too mad!
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
同...同事？！絕對不行！
我鄙視那個被寵壞的丫頭，
她那個位置肯定是她有錢的爸爸買來的！哼！
你稍後再來吧，我現在太生氣了！

scripts.text:
[Laura]
If you're having second
thoughts, it might not be
the best idea to work for me.
I mean, I believe in following
your gut instincts, you know?
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
如果你還在猶豫，
也許為我工作並不是個好主意。
我是說，我相信要聽從你的直覺，你知道的？

scripts.text:
[Laura]
That's what I've been
waiting to hear! Alright,
please fetch me ^3355FF5 Runes of
the Darkness^000000 from the Odin
Shrine. Go now, adventurer~
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
這正是我想聽到的！好的，
請去奧丁神龕為我取回^3355FF5黑暗符文^000000。
現在就去吧，冒險者~

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Hm? You've got a job
to do, don't you? What
are you still doing here?
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
嗯？你有工作要做，不是嗎？
還在這裡幹什麼？

scripts.text: What was I supposed to gather?
scripts.translation: 我本來要收集什麼？

scripts.text: Don't worry, I'm leaving.
scripts.translation: 別擔心，我這就走。

scripts.text:
[Laura]
You're supposed
to bring me ^3355FF5 Runes
of the Darkness^000000. Now,
don't forget this time!
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
你應該帶^3355FF5黑暗符文^000000給我。
這次可別忘了！

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Well, try to hurry up
if you can. I'm already
behind schedule because
we have to work with those
snobby rich kids in the
other office. ^333333*Sigh...*^000000
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
如果可以的話，儘量快點。
因為要和隔壁辦公室那些勢利的有錢人打交道，
我的日程已經延誤了。^333333*嘆氣...*^000000

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Oh, you've come back.
So where are the Runes
of the Darkness you brought?
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
哦，你回來了。
那你帶來的黑暗符文在哪裡？

scripts.text: Er, I don't have them yet...
scripts.translation: 呃，我還沒拿到...

scripts.text: Right here!
scripts.translation: 就在這裡！

scripts.text:
[Laura]
This isn't really one
of those jobs where you
can take your time. Sure, I didn't give you a deadline, but
we can't make progress on our research until you make progress.
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
這可不是那種可以慢慢來的工作。雖然我沒給你設定期限，但在你取得進展之前，我們的研究也無法推進。

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Oooh, nice job. It's good
that we have more of these
to study. Though, it seems
that the more we research,
the quicker it seems that
we're not getting anywhere...
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
哦哦，幹得好。很高興我們能有更多這些符文來研究。不過，看起來我們研究得越多，似乎越沒有進展...

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Hey...
Ashe. Why aren't we
making any progress?
What exactly have you
been doing? None of those
runes have any writing?
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
嘿...
阿什。為什麼我們沒有取得任何進展？
你到底在做什麼？那些符文上都沒有文字嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ashe]
Well, I think there's
supposed to be writing,
but these runes are pretty
old. I've got to polish this
gunk off without damaging
any writing that's there...
scripts.translation:
[阿什]
我想上面應該是有文字的，
但這些符文太古老了。
我得在不損壞文字的前提下，
把這些汙垢清理乾淨...

scripts.text:
[Laura]
By the way, what have the other guys been doing?
What, they don't do anything but wasting their time?
Ah~ I see. They are thinking that this is the perfect excuse
for them to relax and rest.
Well, somehow they are the citizens of this country, you know.
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
順便問一下，其他人都在幹什麼？
難道他們除了浪費時間什麼也不做嗎？
啊~我明白了。他們覺得這是放鬆休息的完美藉口。
畢竟，他們也是這個國家的市民嘛。

scripts.text:
[Laura]
What do you think those
Schwarzwald snobs are doing?
They must think this project
is an excuse for them to relax
and slack off! They can afford to, obviously. Hmpf! Rich people!
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
你覺得那些修瓦魯茲巴魯德的勢利眼在幹什麼？
他們肯定覺得這個專案是偷懶的藉口！
反正他們有的是錢。哼！有錢人！

scripts.text:
[Laura]
They've got things so easy,
while we're barely covering
our research expenses!
In fact, we've had to cut
so many corners, skip
meals and amenities...
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
他們過得那麼輕鬆，
而我們連研究經費都快付不起了！
事實上，我們不得不縮減開支，
甚至要省飯錢和日用品...

scripts.text:
[Ashe]
I know! How can we
carry on professional
research in a shack?
We're literally living at
poverty standards here...
Are we still researchers?
scripts.translation:
[阿什]
我知道！
在這種破棚屋裡，
我們怎麼能進行專業的研究？
我們簡直是在赤貧中生活...
我們還算是研究員嗎？

scripts.text:
[Laura]
I know that!
I know that already!
S-stop bringing it up!
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
我知道！
我早就知道了！
別...別再提了！

scripts.text:
[Laura]
This is pathetic.
I can't even afford the
energy to continue this
conversation. You too,
why don't you take a rest?
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
這太可悲了。
我連繼續這場對話的精力都沒有了。
你也是，
為什麼不休息一下呢？

scripts.text:
[Laura]
..................
What is this?!
You're supposed to
bring me 5 of them!

[Laura]
Is this your way of
saying that you don't
want to work for us?
Why don't you say it
to my face, eh?
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
這是你想表達你不想為我們工作嗎？
為什麼不直接當著我的面說呢？

scripts.text:
[Ashe]
Ms. Laurence, please,
calm down! We're in no
position to yell at anyone,
especially volunteers! You
of all people should know
that they're doing us a favor!
scripts.translation:
[阿什]
勞倫斯小姐，請冷靜一下！
我們沒有資格對任何人發火，
尤其是對志願者！
你應該最清楚，
是他們幫了我們的忙！

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Okay, Ashe, I get it!
And as for you, I'll give
you another chance. Next
time you see me, bring
5 Runes of the Darkness!
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
好吧，阿什，我懂你的意思了！
至於你，我再給你一次機會。
下次見到我時，
帶5個黑暗符文來！

scripts.text:
[Laura]
...Only one?
Look at me. I asked
you for five. I know that
one is better than nothing...
But it's pretty darn close. Go
get me 4 more this instant!
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
...只有一個？
看著我。我讓你帶5個。
我知道一個總比沒有好...
但這差不多就是沒有。立刻去給我找4個！

scripts.text:
[Laura]
One, two...
Huh? Th-that's all?!
When I ask for 5 Runes
of the Darkness, I mean
5, not 2. Now hurry up
and just do what I asked!
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
一，二...
嗯？就...就這些？！
當我讓你帶5個黑暗符文時，
我是說5個，不是2個。快點，
照我說的做！

scripts.text:
[Laura]
One, two, three...
That's it? Don't you
know how to count to 5?
Go and get me more of those
Runes of the Darkness now!
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
一，二，三...
就這些？你不知道怎麼數到5嗎？
現在馬上去給我弄更多黑暗符文來！

scripts.text:
[Laura]
I wonder how much progress
those pampered Schwarzwald
snobs actually made. They've
got the funds, so they could
actually be further ahead
than we are right now...
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
我想知道那些被嬌慣的修瓦魯茲巴魯德勢利眼到底取得了多少進展。
他們有資金，
所以可能比我們領先很多...

scripts.text:
[Laura]
I have to know...
I need to know whether
they discovered ''that thing''
already. They can't have found
it before us. It's impossible!
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
我必須知道...
我需要知道他們是否已經發現了“那個東西”。
他們不可能在我們之前找到它。這是不可能的！

scripts.text:
[Laura]
...Hey, you.

[Laura]
Hey, hey!
Hey hey hey!
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
嘿，嘿！
嘿，嘿，嘿！

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Basically, I want you
to spy on that snobby girl,
Alex of the Schwarzwald
Republic office, and report
what she's actually doing to me.
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
基本上，我想讓你去監視那個傲慢的女孩，
修瓦魯茲巴魯德共和國辦公室的亞歷克斯，
並向我彙報她實際上在做什麼。

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Anyway, just eavesdrop
on the Schwaltvalt Office
by putting your ear really
close to the door, and listen
to them talk. Will you do that?
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
總之，只要把耳朵緊緊貼在門上，
偷聽修瓦魯茲巴魯德辦公室的人說話，
聽聽他們在說什麼。你願意這麼做嗎？

scripts.text:
[Laura]
...............................
Of course, you're
going to do it. Right?

[Laura]
RIGHT?!
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
對吧？！

scripts.text: Yeah, yeah, whatever.
scripts.translation: 是，是，隨便吧。

scripts.text: Sure thing.
scripts.translation: 沒問題。

scripts.text: I s-s-s-suppose...!
scripts.translation: 我...我想...好吧！

scripts.text: Yes, Ma'am!
scripts.translation: 遵命，女士！

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Good.
Now do it!
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
很好。
現在去做吧！

scripts.text:
[Laura]
What are you standing
around here for? Go and
eavesdrop on those snobs
next door! I must know
what they're really up to!
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
你站在這裡幹什麼？
去隔壁偷聽那些勢利眼在說什麼！
我必須知道他們到底在搞什麼鬼！

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Frankly, I know I'm paying
you nothing to be spy, but
please tell me what you
learned about the Schwarzwald
Republic Research Team.
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
說實話，我知道我沒付你什麼間諜費，
但請告訴我，你從修瓦魯茲巴魯德共和國研究團隊那裡
打聽到了什麼。

scripts.text: Giantes
scripts.translation: 巨人

scripts.text: Ymir's Heart
scripts.translation: 尤彌爾之心

scripts.text: Nothing
scripts.translation: 沒什麼

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm guessing that you're
already familiar with the
creature known as Giantes
since you're an archaeologist.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想，既然你是考古學家，
你應該已經熟悉被稱為巨人的生物了。

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Of course! It's an
ancient beast on which
the Guardians were inspired.
N-no way...! Are they here to
finish their guardian research?
What else did you learn?
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
當然！它是古代巨獸，
守護者的靈感正是來源於此。
不...不會吧...！他們是來這裡
完成守護者研究的嗎？
你還打聽到了什麼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, have you
ever heard of Ymir's...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，你聽說過尤彌爾的...

scripts.text:
[Ashe]
...Heart?
Ymir's Heart, right?
scripts.translation:
[阿什]
...心？
是尤彌爾之心吧？

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Ashe, you know about
this? What exactly
is Ymir's Heart?
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
阿什，你知道這個？
尤彌爾之心到底是什麼？

scripts.text: It's candy.
scripts.translation: 那是糖果。

scripts.text: It's a book.
scripts.translation: 那是一本書。

scripts.text: It's a place.
scripts.translation: 那是一個地方。

scripts.text: Ymir was a giant...
scripts.translation: 尤彌爾是個巨人...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It's this...
Um, really...

[{0}]
Er, you see...
A lot of people know
about Ymir's Heart...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
呃，你看...
很多人都聽說過尤彌爾之心...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You know the expression,
''Home is where the heart
is?'' Er, well, Ymir's Heart...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你知道那句“心之所在，即為家”嗎？
呃，總之，尤彌爾之心...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The truth is,
Ymir was this giant...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
事實是，
尤彌爾是個巨人...

scripts.text:
[Ashe]
Ymir's Heart?
That's a clothing
brand, isn't it? Yeah,
it's popular amongst
the trendy crowd in the
Schwarzwald Republic.
scripts.translation:
[阿什]
尤彌爾之心？
那是個服裝品牌，對吧？是的，
它在修瓦魯茲巴魯德共和國的時尚人群中很受歡迎。

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Clothing brand?
You mean those snobs
are just spending their
time talking about fashion
in there? Huh. Don't they
have better things to do?
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
服裝品牌？
你是說那些勢利眼在裡面
只是花時間談論時尚嗎？哼。他們難道沒有更正經的事要做嗎？

scripts.text:
[Laura]
In the meantime, would
you do one more favor for
me? I'd like you to go to
the shrine one last time.
I hear that it's built on
two connected islands...
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
在此期間，你能再幫我一個忙嗎？
我想讓你最後再去一次神龕。
我聽說它建在兩個相連的島嶼上...

scripts.text:
[Laura]
I want you to check the
inner island, and see
what you can find while
I investigate the Schwarzwald
Research Team. I'm sorry, but
you're the only one I can ask.
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
我想讓你檢查內島，看看你能找到什麼，
同時我去調查修瓦魯茲巴魯德研究團隊。抱歉，
你是唯一能拜託的人。

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Nothing...?
Are you sure that's
all you learned?
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
什麼都沒有...？
你確定這就是你瞭解到的全部嗎？

scripts.text:
[Laura]
I wonder...
What could be going on?
Hopefully I'll be able
to find the answers...
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
真是的...
到底發生了什麼？
希望能找到答案...

scripts.text:
[Julian]
Say, are you here
for a job? We're looking
for someone that's passionate
about ancient history. If you
want to make money, then this
this the wrong place for you~
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
喂，你是來工作的嗎？我們在找對古代史充滿熱情的人。如果你想賺錢，那這裡可不是什麼好地方~

scripts.text:
[Julian]
This is supposed to be
a collaborative excavation,
but the team leaders are too
stubborn and refuse to make
any compromises. It's been
incredibly frustrating...
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
這本來應該是一次聯合發掘，但兩位領隊都太固執，拒絕做任何妥協。真是讓人頭疼...

scripts.text:
[Julian]
Basically, each of our teams
is conducting its own research
for now. Now, we need your help
to find any relics from the Odin Shrine. We'd appreciate it if you
brought as many as you can!
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
基本上，目前我們各自團隊都在獨立進行研究。現在我們需要你的幫助，去奧丁神龕尋找任何遺物。如果你能帶回來越多越好，我們將不勝感激！

scripts.text:
[Julian]
You sure you want
to work for someone
like my boss? Can't
you tell that she's
evil? Escape from this
place while you still can!
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
你確定要為一個像我老闆那樣的人工作嗎？難道你看不出她是邪惡的嗎？趁還來得及，快逃離這個地方吧！

scripts.text:
[Alex]
Julian...!
scripts.translation:
[亞歷克斯]
朱利安...！

scripts.text:
[Julian]
See what I mean?
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
你看，我說的沒錯吧？

scripts.text:
[Julian]
Wow, you must really
like this kind of work,
huh? I didn't really expect
that you'd go to the shrine...
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
哇，看來你真的很喜歡這種工作，是嗎？我沒想到你真的會去神龕...

scripts.text:
[Julian]
I'm amazed to see you
working so hard. You must
like pleasing other people,
I guess, but try not to be too
kind. Wouldn't want that...
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
看到你這麼努力工作，我真是驚訝。看來你很擅長取悅別人，不過試著不要太善良。我可不想看到...

scripts.text:
[Julian]
Geez...
You're a really nice
person, you know that?
Just try not to be taken
for a sucker, okay?
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
天哪...
你真是個好人，你知道嗎？只是別被人當傻子利用，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Julian]
Why are both of our
team leaders so bull
headed? Maybe it has
something to do with
them being old and single.
Don't tell them I said that!
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
為什麼我們兩位領隊都這麼固執？也許這跟她們年紀大且單身有關。別告訴她們我這麼說了！

scripts.text:
[Ashe]
Hello, may I help you?
Please understand that
unauthorized personnel
are prohibited from entering
this area. Have you come to
assist in the expedition?
scripts.translation:
[阿什]
你好，有什麼可以幫你的嗎？請理解，未經授權的人員禁止進入此區域。你是來協助考察的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ashe]
Oh, you've here in response
to the recruitment notice?
Well then, let me give you
a brief idea about the work.
First off, we can't pay you any
money, so you'd be a volunteer.
scripts.translation:
[阿什]
哦，你是看到招募告示來的嗎？那麼，讓我簡單介紹一下工作內容。首先，我們付不起工資，所以你是志願者。

scripts.text:
[Ashe]
Instead, you're allowed to
keep whatever you excavate
in the Odin Shrine, so long
as we don't need it for our
research. This opportunity
might prove worthwhile to you.
scripts.translation:
[阿什]
作為補償，你可以保留在奧丁神龕發掘出的任何物品，只要我們的研究不需要它們。這個機會對你來說可能很有價值。

scripts.text:
[Ashe]
Now, we should be working
together with the Schwaltvalt
Republic's Research Team, but
our leaders aren't getting along at all. There's just a huge
clash of personalities...
scripts.translation:
[阿什]
現在，我們應該與修瓦魯茲巴魯德共和國的研究團隊合作，但我們的領隊們相處得並不融洽。性格衝突非常嚴重...

scripts.text:
[Ashe]
In any case, if you'd
like to join us in our
efforts to uncover the
secrets of the past, then
please speak to Ms. Laurence.
scripts.translation:
[阿什]
總之，如果你願意加入我們一起揭開過去的秘密，請去和勞倫斯女士對話。

scripts.text:
[Ashe]
So you're off to the
Odin Shrine? Good luck,
and be careful, alright?
scripts.translation:
[阿什]
你要去奧丁神龕嗎？
祝你好運，
一定要小心哦。

scripts.text:
[Ashe]
Oh, you're back
earlier than I thought!
I think someone with
your talent can be
a really big help to us!
scripts.translation:
[阿什]
哦，你回來得比我預想的早！
我覺得像你這樣有才能的人，
一定會對我們大有幫助！

scripts.text:
[Ashe]
Hm? You've decided to
help the Schwarzwald Team?
That's fine, but I'm afraid
Ms. Laurence may be a little
upset by that. Well, it's fine
with me. I don't really care.
scripts.translation:
[阿什]
嗯？你決定去幫助修瓦魯茲巴魯德團隊了？
這沒問題，但我擔心勞倫斯女士可能會因此有些不悅。
不過對我來說無所謂，我並不在意。

scripts.text:
[Ashe]
How's the work coming
along? I know the team
leaders hate each other,
but they should recognize
that one person's victory
in research is victory for all.
scripts.translation:
[阿什]
工作進展如何？
我知道兩位領隊互相看不順眼，
但他們應該明白，
研究上一個人的勝利，
就是所有人的勝利。

scripts.text:
[Ashe]
How's the work coming
along? I know the team
leaders hate each other,
but they should recognize
that one person's victory
in research is victory for all.
scripts.translation:
[阿什]
工作進展如何？
我知道兩位領隊互相看不順眼，
但他們應該明白，
研究上一個人的勝利，
就是所有人的勝利。

scripts.text:
[Ashe]
Please keep up
the good work~
scripts.translation:
[阿什]
請繼續保持
良好的工作狀態~

scripts.text:
[Ashe]
Well, it looks like
everything turned out
alright in the end, huh?
Good work getting those runes.
scripts.translation:
[阿什]
看來最後
一切都還好，是吧？
能拿到那些符文，
幹得不錯。

scripts.text:
[Ashe]
Oh, dear, you don't
look very well. Did
something happen?
scripts.translation:
[阿什]
哎呀，你看起來
氣色不太好。
發生什麼事了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ashe]
I know that Ms. Laurence
can be... vocally aggressive,
but I'm sure that she really
appreciates all of your hard
work. Thank you so much for
all of your efforts~
scripts.translation:
[阿什]
我知道勞倫斯女士
說話可能有些...咄咄逼人，
但我相信她其實非常
感激你的辛勤付出。
非常感謝你的努力~

scripts.text:
[Ashe]
Why does Ms. Laurence
have to be this way?
I honestly think this
rivalry is awfully petty...
scripts.translation:
[阿什]
勞倫斯女士
為什麼非要這樣呢？
我真心覺得
這種競爭未免太...小氣了...

scripts.text:
[Ashe]
Ehm...
Don't worry
about it~
scripts.translation:
[阿什]
呃...
別擔心
這些小事~

scripts.text:
[Ashe]
Please don't ask
me about anything...
Besides, I mean
you no harm~
scripts.translation:
[阿什]
請不要問我
任何事情...
而且，我對你
並無惡意~

scripts.text:
[Laura]
So it means that everyone fooled me!
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
原來大家都
在騙我！

scripts.text: == Laura is violently wielding a thick file in the air. ==
scripts.translation: == 勞拉正揮舞著一把厚重的銼刀。 ==

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Wh-what...?!
Does this mean
that everyone has
had me fooled this
whole time?! This is
complete lunacy!
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
什...什麼...？！
難道大家
一直都在騙我？！
這簡直太荒唐了！

scripts.text:
[Alex]
What are you talking
about, you crazy wench?
You saw the shrine on the
other side! That's no secret!
scripts.translation:
[亞歷克斯]
你在胡說什麼，
你這個瘋女人？
你明明看到了對面的神龕！
這又不是什麼秘密！

scripts.text:
[Laura]
I'm not talking about that!
I saw your brother digging
everywhere in town in the
middle of the night!
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
我說的不是那個！
我看到你哥哥
半夜在鎮裡到處挖掘！

scripts.text:
[Alex]
Lies...!
Where the hell did
you get that idea?
What makes you think
there are artifacts buried
around here inside town?
scripts.translation:
[亞歷克斯]
胡說...！
你哪來的這種想法？
你以為鎮內
埋著什麼文物嗎？

scripts.text:
[Alex]
Besides, what makes you
think that my brother would
waste so much time doing
something so ridiculous?
scripts.translation:
[亞歷克斯]
再說了，
你覺得我哥哥會浪費那麼多時間
去做這種荒唐事嗎？

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Hahahaha! Yeah,
defend your brother
as much as you like,
you hypocrite! What do
you care about him, I know
you two really hate each other!
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
哈哈哈哈哈！沒錯，
儘管為你哥哥辯護吧，
你這個偽君子！
你才不在乎他呢，
我知道你們倆其實
互相厭惡！

scripts.text:
[Alex]
What was that...?
I dare you to say
that again! I'll make
sure that you regret it!
scripts.translation:
[亞歷克斯]
你說什麼...？
你敢再說一遍！
我會讓你後悔的！

scripts.text:
[Laura]
I know that you were helping
him in his excavations. There's
no way so much progress can be
done by one man alone! In fact,
I have evidence that proves it!
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
我知道你在幫他進行挖掘。
一個人怎麼可能取得這麼大的進展！
事實上，我有證據證明這一點！

scripts.text:
^3355FFLaura violently
waves a thick file
clasped in her hands.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF勞拉用力揮舞著手中緊握的厚厚檔案袋。^000000

scripts.text:
[Julian]
What...?
Argh, that's--!
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
什...？
啊，那是——！

scripts.text:
[Laura]
That's right.
Now tell me, what the
hell is ''^FF0000Ymir's Heart?^000000''
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
沒錯。
現在告訴我，那個所謂的“^FF0000伊米爾之心^000000”到底是什麼？

scripts.text:
[Alex]
......
Julian!
scripts.translation:
[亞歷克斯]
......
朱利安！

scripts.text:
[Julian]
Uh, this isn't my fault!
Sh-she doesn't have any
right to come into our office!
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
呃，這不是我的錯！
她...她沒資格闖進我們的辦公室！

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Hah! Aren't we supposed to
be equal partners in the same
expedition? That's what I heard
at the beginning! But you guys
have something different in mind!
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
哈！我們不是應該
是同一支探險隊的平等夥伴嗎？
一開始就是這麼說的！
但你們心裡想的顯然不一樣！

scripts.text:
[Laura]
It's awfully suspicious: you
guys are only going out at
night, and you're making so
little progress with the Odin
Shrine excavation. Tell me,
what are your true goals?!
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
這太可疑了：
你們只在晚上外出，
而且奧丁神龕的挖掘進展微乎其微。
告訴我，
你們的真正目的是什麼？！

scripts.text:
[Alex]
I-I don't know what you're
talking about! J-Julian must
have gotten some mission, and
has been carrying it out without my consent! Don't go twisting
the facts, you... you thief!
scripts.translation:
[亞歷克斯]
我...我不知道你在說什麼！
朱利安一定是接到了什麼任務，
並在未經我同意的情況下執行了！
別歪曲事實，你...你這個盜賊！

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Thief...?!
Look who's
talking!
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
盜賊...？！
看看是誰在說這種話！

scripts.text:
^3355FFLaura tossed the file
away, and threateningly
rolled up her sleeves.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF勞拉把檔案袋扔了出去，
並威脅般地捲起了袖子。^000000

scripts.text:
[Ashe]
S-stop!
Both of you!
scripts.translation:
[阿什]
停...停下！
你們兩個都住手！

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Stay out of
this, Ashe!
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
阿什，別插手
這件事！

scripts.text:
[Alex]
Yeah, this is none
of your business!
scripts.translation:
[亞歷克斯]
是啊，這與你無關！

scripts.text:
[Ashe]
Oh... Oh, dear!
scripts.translation:
[阿什]
噢...噢，天哪！

scripts.text:
[Laura]
Hah...!
Did you...
Just hit me?
scripts.translation:
[勞拉]
哈...！
你...剛才打我了？

scripts.text:
[Alex]
You crazy...!
scripts.translation:
[亞歷克斯]
你瘋了嗎...！

scripts.text:
[Ashe]
This...
This doesn't
look good at all!
scripts.translation:
[阿什]
這...這情況
看起來非常不妙！

scripts.text:
^3355FFAshe picked up
the file that Laura
tossed away.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF阿什撿起了勞拉扔掉的檔案袋。^000000

scripts.text:
[Ashe]
Um, I've got a favor
of my own to ask you.
Would you please bring
this file to Morocc? Just
bring it to my comrade
over at the South Gate.
scripts.translation:
[阿什]
嗯，我也有個請求。
請把這個檔案袋帶給莫羅克？
只要把它交給南門的
我的同志就可以了。

scripts.text:
[Ashe]
I'm sorry, but we don't
have much time left. I guess
this is the last time we will
ever see each other, so thank
you for all your help, friend.
scripts.translation:
[阿什]
抱歉，我們沒多少時間了。
我想這大概是我們最後一次見面了，
謝謝你所有的幫助，朋友。

scripts.text:
[Ashe]
Don't worry, my comrade
at Morocc's South Gate will
explain everything once you
find him. Please hurry!
scripts.translation:
[阿什]
別擔心，莫羅克南門的同志
見到你後會把一切都解釋清楚的。
請快一點！

scripts.text:
[Ashe]
Don't worry, my comrade
at Morocc's South Gate will
explain everything once you
find him. Please hurry, and
find him as soon as you can!
scripts.translation:
[阿什]
別擔心，莫羅克南門的同志
見到你後會把一切都解釋清楚的。
請快一點，儘快找到他！

scripts.text:
^3355FFAshe picked up
the file that Laura
tossed away.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF阿什撿起了勞拉扔掉的檔案袋。^000000

scripts.text:
[Ashe]
Um, I've got a favor
of my own to ask you.
Would you please bring
this file to Morocc? Just
bring it to my comrade
over at the South Gate.
scripts.translation:
[阿什]
嗯，我也有個請求。
請把這個檔案袋帶給莫羅克？
只要把它交給南門的
我的同志就可以了。

scripts.text:
[Ashe]
I'm sorry, but we don't
have much time left. I guess
this is the last time we will
ever see each other, so thank
you for all your help, friend.
scripts.translation:
[阿什]
抱歉，我們沒多少時間了。
我想這大概是我們最後一次見面了，
謝謝你所有的幫助，朋友。

scripts.text:
[Ashe]
Don't worry, my comrade
at Morocc's South Gate will
explain everything once you
find him. Please hurry!
scripts.translation:
[阿什]
別擔心，莫羅克南門的同志
見到你後會把一切都解釋清楚的。
請快一點！

scripts.text:
[Julian]
I...
I don't know
what I should do!
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
我...
我不知道該怎麼做！

scripts.text:
[Julian]
I've stopped caring
whether they fight or
not... I'm so not get
involved. If you want,
you can try to stop them...
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
我已經不在乎他們打不打架了...
我不想捲入其中。如果你想的話，
你可以試著去阻止他們...

scripts.text:
[???]
...Silence.

[???]
Don't turn, don't
flinch, don't even
breathe. You're being
followed. Hold on a sec
while I take care of him.
scripts.translation:
[???]
別回頭，別發抖，甚至別呼吸。
有人跟蹤你。稍等一下，
我去處理掉他。

scripts.text:
[???]
...............................
Good. You've done some
good work. Just drop the file
to the ground. And for your
own good, don't turn around.

^3355FFYou drop the file
to the ground, and it
immediately vanishes in
a small whirlwind of sand.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你把檔案袋丟在地上，
它立刻在一陣小旋風中消失了。^000000

scripts.text:
[???]
I know that you've
gotten involved in all
this unexpectedly. Before
I leave, have you got any
questions? Otherwise, I'll go.
scripts.translation:
[???]
我知道你是意外捲入這一切的。
在我離開之前，你還有什麼問題嗎？
如果沒有，我就走了。

scripts.text: Who's Ashe?
scripts.translation: 阿什是誰？

scripts.text: What happened to Laura?
scripts.translation: 勞拉怎麼了？

scripts.text:
[???]
You'll never see her
again. She's already
been assigned to a new
mission. If it makes you
feel better, she's one of the
members of ''Secret Wing.''
scripts.translation:
[???]
你再也見不到她了。她已經被分配
去執行新的任務了。如果你想知道，
她是“秘密之翼”的成員之一。

scripts.text:
[???]
She'll be fine. If you're that
interested in archaeology,
you'll be happy to know that
she'll run the excavation the
way she wants to. Rekenber and Arunafeltz should leave her alone.
scripts.translation:
[???]
她會沒事的。如果你那麼感興趣於考古學，
你會很高興知道她會按自己的方式主持發掘工作。
雷肯貝爾和阿魯納菲茲應該不會打擾她。

scripts.text:
[???]
You're probably curious
about Ashe, and perhaps
myself as well. Now, have you
ever heard of ''Secret Wing?''
scripts.translation:
[???]
你大概對阿什，甚至對我都很好奇。
那麼，你聽說過“秘密之翼”嗎？

scripts.text:
[???]
Secret Wing is a secret
organization that's scattered
now, but some of the members
are still active. Just consider us enemies of Rekenber Corporation
in the Schwarzwald Republic.
scripts.translation:
[???]
秘密之翼是一個秘密組織，現在雖然分散了，
但一些成員仍然活躍。把我們看作雷肯貝爾公司在
修瓦魯茲巴魯德共和國的敵人就好。

scripts.text:
[???]
Everything you saw and
heard is all true. The ghost
of Giantes still remains within
the Odin Shrine. Rekenber wants
it for their ends, as well as
Arunafeltz. It's complicated...
scripts.translation:
[???]
你看到和聽到的一切都是真的。
巨人吉安提斯的幽靈仍然留在奧丁神龕中。
雷肯貝爾想要利用它，阿魯納菲茲也是。情況很複雜...

scripts.text:
[???]
The people of Rune-Midgarts
and Schwarzwald Republic still
don't know what's going on.
A lot of people are just being
used... Like that one lady,
that archaeologist, Laura.
scripts.translation:
[???]
盧恩·米德加茲和修瓦魯茲巴魯德共和國的人們
仍然不知道發生了什麼。很多人只是被利用...
比如那位女士，那位考古學家，勞拉。

scripts.text:
[???]
...Thanks for
the file. Take care.
Always watch your back.
scripts.translation:
[???]
...謝謝你的檔案袋。保重。
永遠小心背後。

scripts.text:
[Boatman]
Ah, hello~
Would you like to sail
to the Odin Shrine? The
fare for 1 passenger is
800 zeny. Shall we board?
scripts.translation:
[船伕]
啊，你好~
你想去奧丁神龕嗎？
單程票價是800 Zeny。
要登船嗎？

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝。

scripts.text: Sure!
scripts.translation: 當然！

scripts.text:
[Boatman]
Ah, alright.
If you change your
mind, I invite you
to return and just
let me know.
scripts.translation:
[船伕]
啊，好的。
如果你改變主意了，
歡迎隨時回來告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Boatman]
Hm? You don't have enough
money to pay the fare. Well,
just come back when you do
have the zeny, and then I'll
take you to the Odin Shrine.
scripts.translation:
[船伕]
嗯？你的錢不夠支付船費。
等你攢夠Zeny再回來吧，
到時候我就帶你去奧丁神龕。

scripts.text:
[Boatman]
Alright then,
climb aboard!
We'll arrive near
the Odin Shrine soon~
scripts.translation:
[船伕]
那麼，請登船吧！
我們很快就會到達奧丁神龕附近~

scripts.text:
[Boatman]
Ah, would you
like to sail back to
Hugel now, or did you
want to explore a bit more?
scripts.translation:
[船伕]
啊，你現在想回毀葛嗎？
還是想再探索一會兒？

scripts.text: I still need to look around...
scripts.translation: 我還需要四處看看...

scripts.text: Yes, take me back to Hugel.
scripts.translation: 是的，帶我回毀葛。

scripts.text:
[Boatman]
Well, alright.
Just let me know
when you're ready to
leave this dangerous place.
scripts.translation:
[船伕]
好吧。
等你準備好離開這個危險的地方時，
再告訴我吧。

scripts.text:
[Boatman]
Alright then,
climb aboard!
We'll arrive near
Hugel very soon~
scripts.translation:
[船伕]
那麼，請登船吧！
我們很快就會到達毀葛附近~

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis place is empty.
Everyone must
have already left.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這裡空無一人。
大家應該都已經離開了。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFA weathered structure
of the Odin Shrine is
half buried beneath the
ground, but it still looks
fairly stable and durable.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF奧丁神龕的一處破舊建築
半埋在地下，
但看起來仍然相當穩固耐用。^000000

scripts.text: Pass
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text: Explore
scripts.translation: 探索

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou decided to pass
by the shrine's remnants.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你決定從神龕的遺蹟旁經過。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou catch a bright
shimmer among the
remnants of the shrine.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你在神龕的遺蹟中發現
一道明亮的閃光。^000000

scripts.text: Ignore
scripts.translation: 無視

scripts.text: Pick it up
scripts.translation: 撿起來

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou decide to continue
searching through the
shrine's ruins.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你決定繼續在神龕的廢墟中搜尋。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find a shining stone
within the ruins, and carefully
put it into your bag.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你在廢墟中發現了一塊閃爍之石，
並小心地放進了包裡。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What...?
What was
that noise?!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什...麼？
那是什麼聲音？！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wa...waaaahhhh!

^3355FFUnfortunately, you
were unable to find
anything in the ruins.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF很遺憾，你沒能
在廢墟中找到任何東西。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFWhen you come back
to your senses, you
find that nothing is
left in this place.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF當你回過神來，
發現這裡已經
什麼都不剩了。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Huh?
What's happening?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
咦？
發生什麼事了？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Waaaaahhhh!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哇啊啊啊啊！

scripts.text:
[Alex]
Haven't you found it yet?
You said that it'd be here!
You told me so many people
are drawn to his place since
Ymir's Heart might really
be buried in this area!
scripts.translation:
[亞歷克斯]
你還沒找到嗎？
你明明說它在這裡的！
你告訴我，自從尤米爾之心
可能真的埋在這片區域以來，
很多人都會被吸引到他的地盤！

scripts.text:
[Julian]
I'm pretty sure it's
around here somewhere,
but I need more time to dig!
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
我很確定它就在
附近某個地方，
但我需要更多時間挖掘！

scripts.text:
[Alex]
I understand why you wanted
to follow me here, but there's
no way to confirm its existence
in this area without digging
it up. Plus, I'm still worried
about the ''Shinokas'' issue...
scripts.translation:
[亞歷克斯]
我理解你想跟著我
來這裡的原因，但如果不挖出來，
就無法確認它是否
存在於這片區域。而且，我還在擔心
“希諾卡斯”的問題...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...Shinokas?

[Alex]
We couldn't find
Ymir's Heart inside
the village, either...
Why don't you just--
scripts.translation:
[亞歷克斯]
我們在村莊裡
也沒找到尤米爾之心...
你為什麼不乾脆——

scripts.text:
[Julian]
Yeah, you think you can do
everything yourself since
you're so much better than
me, huh?! I'm the black sheep
of the family, and father loves
you more than me, right?!
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
是啊，你覺得你
什麼都比我會做，
所以可以一個人搞定，對吧？！
我是家裡的黑羊，神父
更愛你而不是我，對吧？！

scripts.text:
[Alex]
You already know that.
scripts.translation:
[亞歷克斯]
你心裡清楚。

scripts.text:
[Julian]
Wha--?!
Why... I...!
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
什——麼？！
為什麼...我...！

scripts.text:
[Alex]
Geez, you're impatient.
Listen, your ambitions
can ruin everything. You're
not planning on defying me,
are you? Because if you are...
scripts.translation:
[亞歷克斯]
真是的，你太急躁了。
聽著，你的野心
會毀掉一切。你
不會打算違抗我，
對吧？因為如果你敢...

scripts.text:
[Julian]
You can never understand
why I want to find Ymir's
Heart! I'm not going to give
up looking for it, so just
leave me alone!
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
你永遠無法理解
我為什麼想找到尤米爾之心！
我不會放棄尋找它的，
所以別管我了！

scripts.text:
[Alex]
I know you better than
yourself, and I can do
everything better than you
can. Forget Ymir's Heart for
now. Giantes is our highest,
most important priority!
scripts.translation:
[亞歷克斯]
我比你更瞭解你自己，
而且我做的每件事
都比你好。暫時忘掉尤米爾之心吧。
巨人族才是我們
最高、最重要的優先事項！

scripts.text:
[Julian]
You always...!
...............................
Wait... You hear that?

[Alex]
We'll continue this
conversation later.
scripts.translation:
[亞歷克斯]
我們稍後再
繼續這個話題。

scripts.text: ^3355FFThe door is locked.^000000
^3355FFThe door is locked.^000000
